7d3384c5.title: Power BI Developer with Cloud Data Engineering
7d3384c5.description:
**Role** \- Power BI Developer with Cloud Data Engineering Experience

**Experience:** 6–10 Years

**MANDATORY SKILLS**

* **Power BI \& Analytics Delivery**
* **Databricks \& Cloud Data Engineering**
* **AWS**

**Core Technical Skills**

* Power BI Desktop \& Power BI Service
* DAX
* Power Query
* Semantic Modelling
* Dimensional Modelling
* SQL / PL/SQL
* Databricks
* Spark SQL
* Delta Lake
* AWS S3
* Unity Catalog
* Medallion Architecture

JOB OVERVIEW

We are looking for an experienced **Power BI Developer with Cloud Data Engineering Experience** to design, develop, and support enterprise Power BI analytics solutions using Databricks and AWS\-based data platforms.

The role is primarily focused on **Power BI and analytics delivery**, while also contributing to Databricks\-based data engineering activities such as data transformation, analytical data modelling, reporting dataset optimization, and modernization of legacy data logic.

The candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, product owners, data architects, analytics engineers, governance teams, and technical teams to deliver intuitive dashboards, semantic models, governed reporting assets, and actionable insights.

The role covers the end\-to\-end analytics lifecycle, including requirements gathering, data modelling, Power BI development, deployment, performance optimization, governance, documentation, production support, and continuous improvement.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

* Design, develop, test, and deploy enterprise Power BI dashboards, reports, scorecards, semantic models, and reusable analytical solutions.
* Connect and integrate Power BI with Databricks SQL Warehouses, Delta Lake tables, governed views, and composite models.
* Partner with business stakeholders and product owners to translate KPIs, reporting requirements, and analytical questions into technical designs and delivery plans.
* Build scalable semantic models using star schemas, conformed dimensions, reusable measures, and clearly defined business logic.
* Develop advanced DAX measures, calculation groups, time\-intelligence logic, and Power Query transformations.
* Evaluate and optimize star, snowflake, and flattened data structures for performance, usability, and scalability.
* Design intuitive report experiences using drill\-through, bookmarks, tooltips, conditional formatting, mobile layouts, accessibility features, and user\-friendly navigation.
* Optimize Power BI reports and semantic models using **Power BI Performance Analyzer, DAX Studio, VertiPaq Analyzer, aggregations, query diagnostics, and incremental refresh**.
* Implement row\-level security, object\-level security, workspace security, application distribution, and governance controls.
* Publish and manage Power BI workspaces, semantic models, reports, apps, refresh schedules, gateways, and deployment pipelines.
* Develop paginated reports using **Power BI Report Builder** where required.
* Perform data validation, reconciliation, regression testing, UAT support, troubleshooting, and production support.
* Support user enablement and continuous improvement of enterprise reporting solutions.
* Document report specifications, semantic model designs, KPI definitions, measure catalogs, data dictionaries, support guides, and reusable reporting standards.

Databricks \& Cloud Data Engineering

* Analyze existing data warehouse implementations and support migration, modernization, and consolidation initiatives.
* Reverse\-engineer legacy PL/SQL and SQL logic and translate business rules into scalable Spark SQL solutions within Databricks.
* Design and develop analytical data solutions using **AWS S3, Databricks, and Delta Lake**.
* Build and maintain ETL and ELT pipelines, ingestion frameworks, and transformation processes supporting reporting and analytics requirements.
* Collaborate with data architects to implement enterprise ingestion, transformation, and governance frameworks.
* Work with data engineering teams to define gold\-layer datasets and ensure data quality, lineage, and business\-rule consistency.
* Support **Unity Catalog, Medallion Architecture, Delta Lake table design, governed views, and cloud data warehouse design patterns**.
* Tune Spark SQL, Databricks notebooks, SQL Warehouses, pipelines, and table structures for performance, scalability, and reliability.
* Support CI/CD, Git, version control, release automation, DevOps practices, job scheduling, backup coordination, and production support.

Collaboration, Delivery \& Governance

* Participate in Agile ceremonies, roadmap planning, architecture reviews, sprint activities, production readiness reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Work closely with business stakeholders, product owners, data architects, analytics engineers, governance teams, and support teams.
* Mentor developers through design reviews, code reviews, reusable engineering standards, Power BI best practices, and documentation standards.
* Promote consistency across reporting solutions by aligning semantic models, measures, data definitions, security, and release practices.
* Support governance, testing, documentation, and production readiness of enterprise analytics solutions.

REQUIRED SKILLS \& EXPERIENCE

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, Data Analytics, Information Technology, or a related field.
* **6–10 years** of relevant experience across business intelligence, analytics delivery, and data engineering.
* **5\+ years of hands\-on Power BI development experience**, including dashboards, reports, semantic models, DAX, Power Query, Power BI Service, and enterprise deployment practices.
* **3\+ years of Databricks, Spark SQL, and Delta Lake experience** supporting enterprise analytics and reporting solutions.
* Strong experience integrating Power BI with **Databricks SQL Warehouses, Delta Lake tables, governed views, and cloud\-based data platforms**.
* Expert knowledge of **Power BI Desktop, Power BI Service, Power BI Report Builder, DAX, Power Query, semantic modelling, dimensional modelling, and BI performance optimization**.
* Strong SQL and PL/SQL skills, including experience refactoring or migrating legacy warehouse logic into modern cloud analytics platforms.
* Proficiency in **Python, Scala, or Java**, with practical experience supporting data transformation and automation.
* Strong experience with **AWS S3, Databricks, Unity Catalog, Medallion Architecture, ETL/ELT, metadata management, and data warehouse design**.
* Experience with **Import mode, DirectQuery, composite models, query folding, incremental refresh, aggregations, and Power BI performance tuning**.
* Experience with **Git, CI/CD, REST APIs, deployment pipelines, Agile methodologies, governance, testing, and production support**.
* Strong stakeholder communication, requirements analysis, leadership, mentoring, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.

PREFERRED / NICE\-TO\-HAVE SKILLS

* **Microsoft PL\-300 certification** is strongly preferred.
* **Databricks certification** is preferred or considered a strong plus.
* Experience designing enterprise\-scale analytics solutions using Power BI and Databricks.
* Experience supporting migration from legacy data warehouse platforms to modern cloud data platforms.
* Experience working across business intelligence, analytics engineering, and cloud data engineering functions.

Pay: ₹1,500,000\.00 \- ₹2,500,000\.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Bangalore City, Bengaluru, Karnataka

ab18604d.title: Solutions Architect – Okta Identity And Access Management
ab18604d.description:
**Company Description** 
 Altruist Technologies Pvt. Ltd., founded in 2005, is a leading player in the Mobile Social Networking and Mobile Value Added Services (MVAS) space across India, Indonesia, Nigeria, and other emerging markets. The company delivers voice\-based social networks, jobsonphone services, and end\-to\-end mobile and digital strategy for media clients, brands, and content providers. It has expanded into M\-Governance, handset\-based applications, and video sharing platforms, supported by strong technology capabilities and robust voice infrastructure. Altruist is recognized as a market leader in India’s social networking MVAS domain and maintains partnerships with all major Indian telecom operators, reaching more than half of the country’s mobile subscribers. The organization offers voice and web\-based value\-added services, BPO, IT, and interactive communication solutions to carriers, ISPs, CSPs, and corporate clients.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Solutions Architect – Okta Identity and Access Management will design, implement, and maintain secure IAM solutions using Okta for enterprise\-scale environments. This full\-time, on\-site role based in Bengaluru South involves translating business and security requirements into technical architectures, defining integration patterns, and ensuring robust identity lifecycle management. The role includes collaborating closely with security, infrastructure, development, and product teams to integrate Okta with applications and directories, implement SSO, MFA, and access policies, and support compliance and governance needs. The Solutions Architect will create technical documentation, standards, and best practices; troubleshoot complex IAM issues; and guide teams through solution rollout and optimization. The position also requires staying current with IAM trends, evaluating new Okta features, and recommending enhancements to improve security, scalability, and user experience.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong Okta Identity and Access Management expertise, including SSO, MFA, user provisioning, lifecycle management, and policy configuration.
* Candidates should possess skills in identity architecture and security, such as designing IAM frameworks, role\-based access control, zero\-trust principles, and integration with directories (e.g., AD, LDAP).
* Candidates should possess hands\-on experience with cloud and application integration, including REST APIs, OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, SAML, and integrating SaaS and on\-premise applications with Okta.
* Candidates should possess skills in troubleshooting and optimization, including performance tuning, incident resolution, root\-cause analysis, and continuous improvement of IAM solutions.
* Candidates should possess strong documentation and collaboration skills, including writing technical specifications, solution design documents, and effectively communicating with cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Relevant experience in enterprise security, infrastructure, or solution architecture, preferably within telecom, IT services, or digital platforms, is beneficial.
* A bachelor’s degree

ebebe146.title: Senior Cloud & Infrastructure Engineer
ebebe146.description:
**REPORTING RELATIONSHIP** 




 POSITION REPORTS TO: ASSOCIATE DIRECTOR IT
 



 DEPARTMENT: TECHNOLOGY
 



 POSITION LOCATION: VADODARA (
 **HYBRID)** 




  





**POSITION SUMMARY** 




 The position is offered through Company. This is a hands\-on, breadth\-oriented role for an engineer who wants to run a real production environment, modernize how infrastructure is built and operated, and work closely with security and development to ship and run software safely. As lead infrastructure engineer for Omni’s multi\-tenant Azure estate and Windows server fleet, this role works in close daily partnership with Omni’s Senior Security Infrastructure Engineer, who acts as the technical sounding board, security reviewer, and sign\-off authority on significant infrastructure decisions. This role operates under a matrix reporting structure, with a functional reporting line to the CTO, Omni Agent Solutions (USA) and an administrative reporting line to the Associate Director IT (India).
 



  





**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES** 




 • Operate as the lead infrastructure engineer in close daily partnership with Omni’s Senior Security Infrastructure Engineer, who provides technical direction, conducts security review, and signs off on significant infrastructure decisions before they reach production.
 



 • Run and modernize Omni’s Azure environment, including compute, networking, identity, Azure App Services, Azure SQL, Microsoft WAF, Azure Virtual Desktop and Windows 365, and Azure Monitor.
 



 • Own the Windows Server fleet end\-to\-end: provisioning, patching cadence, Group Policy and Active Directory operations, lifecycle planning, and end\-of\-support migrations.
 



 • Own Microsoft 365 license allocation and Azure subscription management across Omni’s multi\-tenant environment, including license assignment and recovery, subscription and tenant governance, cost visibility, and ongoing right\-sizing.
 



 • Modernize the infrastructure\-as\-code practice. Propose tooling and patterns for joint review with the Senior Security Infrastructure Engineer, and incrementally bring infrastructure under code with security guardrails built in from the start.
 



 • Partner with the senior developer and broader development team to extend modern CI/CD patterns from application code into infrastructure deployment, and to design systems that scale securely as the business grows.
 



 • Work closely with Omni’s security team and managed SOC on hardening, vulnerability remediation, identity controls, endpoint protection through SentinelOne, and compliance evidence.
 



 • Cross\-train into the security workstreams the Senior Security Infrastructure Engineer manages day\-to\-day, including endpoint detection and response, SASE and ZTNA networking, SIEM, and the managed SOC’s tooling, so the two roles can back each other up across disciplines.
 



 • Manage observability across Datadog and Azure Monitor, including alerting, on\-call signal hygiene, and runbook development.
 



 • Maintain the homegrown line\-of\-business application infrastructure (Azure App Services, Azure SQL, and Microsoft WAF).
 



 • Run day\-to\-day business continuity and disaster recovery operations within Omni’s defined RPO and RTO targets. Maintain DR runbooks and run periodic failover and tabletop exercises.
 



 • Build and maintain runbooks, architecture diagrams, and change records so the environment can be supported by anyone on the team.
 



 • Partner with Omni’s co\-managed MSP as a shared delivery team across day\-to\-day operations and escalations, rather than treating the MSP as an outside vendor.
 



 • Provide escalation support to internal end users for infrastructure\-impacting tickets routed through the helpdesk and the co\-managed MSP.
 



 • Participate in an after\-hours rotation covering monthly maintenance windows and incident response, and co\-lead
 



 post\-incident reviews. Formalizing the rotation is part of the role, in partnership with the Senior Security Infrastructure Engineer.
 



  





**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES** 




 • 8\+ years of cloud engineering experience, with significant Azure depth.
 



 • 3\+ years' operating Windows Server environments at production scale.
 



 • Hands\-on experience with hybrid identity, including Active Directory, Group Policy, and Entra ID, in a Windows\-centric environment.
 



 • Strong cloud and hybrid networking experience, including firewall change management, network segmentation, cross\-tenant routing, IPsec and SSL VPN, NSGs, and subnet design.
 



 • Experience operating to defined RPO and RTO targets, including DR runbook maintenance and failover testing.
 



 • Strong infrastructure\-as\-code experience. Terraform preferred, with openness to Azure\-native equivalents such as Bicep or ARM templates.
 



 • Demonstrated ability to modernize engineering practices in close collaboration with security counterparts, partnering on the final shape of the practice rather than dictating it.
 



 • Comfort operating in a role where a security peer reviews and signs off on significant infrastructure decisions, and where outcomes are defined jointly rather than independently.
 



 • Comfort cross\-training across infrastructure and security disciplines, holding a primary area of focus while providing secondary coverage of the other.
 



 • Track record of partnering closely with security and development teams to ship and operate software safely and at scale.
 



  





**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** 




 • Familiarity with Microsoft 365 Copilot or other enterprise AI rollouts.
 



  





 • Exposure to NIST CSF, CIS Controls, or ISO/IEC 27001, and how these frameworks apply to both cloud and on\-
 



 premises or Group Policy deployment.
 



  





 • Familiarity with SOC 2 control operation and evidence collection.
 



 • Working knowledge of California privacy regulation (CCPA / CPRA). HIPAA exposure also a plus.
 



 • Microsoft partnership program exposure (CSP, Solutions Partner designations).
 



 • Secondary cloud and SaaS familiarity beyond Azure, including Google Workspace, Google Cloud Storage, and Wasabi object storage.
 



 • Exposure to thin\-client deployments and cloud browser management.
 



 • Cloudflare familiarity (edge, DNS, security).
 



 • Next\-generation firewall platform experience (Palo Alto Networks, Fortinet FortiGate, or comparable).
 



 • Enterprise backup and DR platform experience (Veeam, Axcient, Azure Backup, or comparable).
 



 • Experience migrating workloads from traditional VMs to serverless or cloud\-native application platforms.
 



 • SQL Server DBA exposure for day\-to\-day database operations (not a primary focus of the role).
 



 • IIS management experience.
 



 • AWS, Kubernetes, or serverless experience.
 



 • Experience operating in a small infrastructure team where breadth matters more than depth in any one area.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


The role holder is responsible for identifying and developing new BPO service opportunities by bridging market demands with scalable operational solutions. This role engages cross\-functional teams and external stakeholders, including vendors, sellers, and clients, to uncover systemic pain points and translate them into high\-value service offerings and commercial models.  

  

Key job responsibilities

Opportunity Identification \& Assessment  

* Stakeholder Discovery: Conduct structured engagements with vendors, sellers, and internal operations teams to identify pain points, inefficiencies, and unmet needs within fulfillment workflows.
* Voice of the Customer (VoC) Synthesis: Consolidate feedback from external stakeholders and internal teams to surface recurring themes and prioritize high\-impact opportunity areas.
* Service Opportunity Definition: Translate stakeholder insights into structured problem statements and service hypotheses that inform the FaaS product roadmap.
* Market Intelligence: Monitor industry trends, competitive landscapes, and evolving stakeholder needs to proactively identify emerging service opportunities.
* Opportunity Sizing \& Prioritization: Collaborate with Product, Finance, and Strategy to evaluate market viability and strategic fit, and develop supporting business cases.


Stakeholder Engagement \& Relationship Management  

* External Advisory: Serve as a trusted advisor to sellers and vendors, guiding them in articulating operational challenges and solution requirements.
* Cross\-Functional Alignment: Collaborate with Product, Operations, Delivery, and Sales to ensure proposed solutions align with organizational capabilities.
* Executive Communication: Present business cases, findings, and solution frameworks to C\-suite and senior leadership with clarity and confidence.
* Pre\-Sales Engagement: Lead and support prospect discovery calls, pitch presentations, and solution demonstrations to articulate value and advance deal progression.


Solution Design \& Go\-to\-Market Development

* Framework Development: Define scope of work (SoW), service level agreements (SLAs), staffing models, and technology requirements for new service offerings.
* Commercial Modeling: Partner with pricing teams to develop commercial structures that demonstrate measurable ROI for prospective clients.
* Proposal Development: Develop proposals, RFP/RFI responses, and solution presentations that clearly communicate capabilities, differentiation, and expected outcomes.

* 8\+ years of experience in BPO solution design, consultative sales, management consulting, or strategic account management.
* Demonstrated domain expertise in e\-commerce, logistics, marketplace operations, or vendor management ecosystems.
* Track record of launching new BPO service lines or securing large\-scale enterprise engagements through tailored solutions.
* Experience leading end\-to\-end pre\-sales cycles, including RFP/RFI responses, solution presentations, and proposal development.
* Working knowledge of process modeling methodologies (e.g., BPMN, UML) and emerging AI orchestration patterns (e.g., agentic workflows, RAG pipelines).
* Strong consultative skills with the ability to identify root\-cause problems through effective questioning and active listening.
* Analytical capability to synthesize qualitative stakeholder feedback with quantitative operational data to inform decision\-making.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complex operational concepts for technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Ability to thrive in ambiguous, fast\-paced environments and adapt to evolving market conditions.
* Direct experience with seller/vendor ecosystems, marketplace platforms, or fulfillment and logistics services.

  

Preferred Qualifications  

* Experience with ML platforms such as Amazon SageMaker, Vertex AI, or equivalent.
* Familiarity with process mining tools and intelligent automation platforms (e.g., UiPath, Automation Anywhere).
* Understanding of responsible AI frameworks, risk assessment methodologies, and relevant regulatory requirements (e.g., EU AI Act).
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5\+ years of developing, negotiating and executing business agreements experience
* 5\+ years of solving problems with technology in the Global Financial Services Industry experience
* 5\+ years of Go\-To\-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting experience
* 5\+ years of working with Data \& AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience explaining complex technical concepts to various business and technical audiences

----------------------------

* Experience interpreting data and making business recommendations

3310576b.title: Program Manager – Agile Delivery & RTE - Workday Financials/HCM
3310576b.description:
**Role: Program Manager – Agile Delivery \& Release Train Engineering** 




**Location: Remote** 




**Work Timing: 8:00 AM CST to 5:00 PM CST/ 6:30 PM – 3:30 AM IST** 




**Immediate Joiners** 




  





**Must Have Skills:** 



* Enterprise Program Leadership
* Has led large, cross\-functional technology programs from planning through implementation.
* Experience coordinating multiple teams, business stakeholders, technical teams, vendors, and dependencies—not just managing a single project.
* Release Train Engineer (or SAFe Program\-Level Agile Leadership)
* Has served as an RTE or equivalent, facilitating PI Planning, Scrum of Scrums, dependency management, and program\-level execution.



**Top 3 Required Skills** 



* Program \& Release Train Leadership – Proven experience leading complex enterprise technology programs and serving as a Release Train Engineer (RTE) or in a similar Agile program leadership role.
* Cross\-Functional Delivery Management – Ability to coordinate multiple teams, manage dependencies, risks, vendors, integrations, and drive initiatives from planning through implementation.
* Workday Financials/HCM Experience – Hands\-on experience leading Workday Financials, HCM, and integration programs (implementation, modernization, enhancements, or ongoing delivery).



**Top 3 Nice\-to\-Have Skills** 



* SAFe Experience \& Certifications – Experience facilitating PI Planning and other SAFe ceremonies, with certifications such as SAFe RTE, PMP, PMI\-ACP, or CSM.
* Enterprise ERP/ITSM \& Third\-Party Integration Experience – Experience managing enterprise ERP, HCM, or ITSM platforms and coordinating implementation partners and system integrations.
* Delivery Tools \& Agile Platforms – Proficiency with Azure DevOps, Jira, ServiceNow, or similar tools for Agile planning, tracking, and reporting.



**Role Overview:** 




 We are seeking an experienced Program Manager / Release Train Engineer to lead complex, cross\-functional technology delivery while helping establish scalable Agile delivery practices across Digital Solutions.
 



**Job Description:** 




**Program Planning \& Delivery Leadership** 




 • Lead complex technology programs and initiatives spanning multiple teams, workstreams, enterprise applications, and business functions.
 



 • Establish and maintain integrated program plans, milestones, delivery roadmaps, scope, objectives, and success measures.
 



 • Translate strategic priorities into coordinated execution plans and ensure teams understand commitments, sequencing, and expected outcomes.
 



 • Drive work to completion by establishing ownership, monitoring progress, resolving delivery gaps, and ensuring actions are followed through to closure.
 



 • Adapt planning and delivery practices across Agile, iterative, hybrid, and traditional delivery models based on organizational and program needs.
 



**Cross\-Team Coordination, Dependencies \& Integration** 




 • Coordinate delivery across product teams, platform teams, architecture, security, infrastructure, QA, business stakeholders, and third\-party vendors.
 



 • Identify, track, and actively manage cross\-team dependencies, integration points, constraints, risks, issues, and decisions.
 



 • Connect business processes, enterprise applications, and technical workstreams to ensure issues are evaluated beyond the immediate symptom or originating system.
 



 • Establish clear engagement points, handoffs, and escalation paths across teams and organizational boundaries.
 



 • Facilitate timely resolution of blockers and ensure the appropriate technical and business participants are engaged.
 



**Scaled Agile \& Release Train Leadership** 




 • Perform Release Train Engineer or equivalent program\-level Agile leadership responsibilities as delivery structures mature.
 



 • Plan and facilitate Program Increment (PI) Planning, ART Syncs, Scrum of Scrums, System Demos, Inspect \& Adapt workshops, and other large\-scale planning and coordination events, as applicable.
 



 • Partner with Product Management, Product Owners, Scrum Masters, and technical leaders to improve backlog and feature readiness, planning effectiveness, and alignment to program objectives.
 



 • Support teams in identifying and managing risks, dependencies, impediments, and commitments across planning and execution cycles.
 



 • Help establish scalable delivery cadences and operating practices without forcing process beyond the maturity or needs of the organization.
 



**Governance, Reporting \& Stakeholder Alignment** 




 • Establish fit\-for\-purpose governance, planning cadences, status reporting, decision\-making forums, and escalation practices.
 



 • Provide concise, decision\-oriented reporting on program health, milestones, delivery confidence, risks, dependencies, issues, and required leadership actions.
 



 • Maintain program documentation and ensure plans, decisions, actions, and delivery commitments remain current and transparent.
 



 • Communicate effectively with executives, portfolio leaders, business stakeholders, technical leaders, delivery teams, and vendors.
 



 • Influence without authority to create alignment, clarify accountability, and sustain momentum across diverse stakeholder groups.
 



**Resource, Vendor \& Delivery Readiness Management** 




 • Coordinate the people, capabilities, environments, and supporting resources required to meet delivery objectives.
 



 • Validate estimates, capacity assumptions, sequencing, and readiness across participating teams and workstreams.
 



 • Partner with third\-party vendors on implementations, integrations, deliverables, risks, and contractual commitments.
 



 • Anticipate delivery needs and identify gaps early enough for leadership to make informed staffing, prioritization, or sequencing decisions.
 



 • Support release planning and readiness by ensuring business, technical, testing, operational, and organizational dependencies are addressed.
 



**Continuous Improvement \& Delivery Excellence** 




 • Use meaningful program and delivery metrics to improve predictability, flow, planning effectiveness, dependency management, and outcomes.
 



 • Identify systemic delivery impediments and partner with leadership to remove organizational barriers.
 



 • Assess delivery practices and recommend pragmatic improvements that strengthen execution without adding unnecessary process.
 



 • Promote collaboration, accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement across teams and leadership.
 



 • Contribute to the evolution of Program Management, Release Train Engineering, and broader Delivery Management standards and practices.
 



  





**Required Qualifications** 




 • 8\+ years of experience leading complex technology projects or programs within enterprise environments.
 



 • Demonstrated experience in both program/project management and Agile program\-level delivery leadership, including Release Train Engineer or equivalent responsibilities.
 



 • Experience leading technical programs involving Workday Financials, HCM and integrations, including implementation, modernization, enhancement, or ongoing platform delivery.
 



 • Experience coordinating delivery at scale across multiple teams, workstreams, enterprise applications, integrations, and organizational functions.
 



 • Strong understanding of software delivery lifecycles and Agile, iterative, hybrid, and traditional delivery methodologies.
 



 • Demonstrated experience managing program plans, scope, milestones, risks, issues, dependencies, resources, vendors, and executive reporting.
 



 • Strong facilitation, communication, negotiation, problem\-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
 



 • Ability to understand technical delivery at a level sufficient to connect systems, integrations, business processes, dependencies, and delivery risks without serving as the technical implementer.
 



 • Experience working with delivery lifecycle management tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, ServiceNow, or similar platforms.
 



**Preferred Qualifications** 




 • Experience with enterprise ERP, HCM, or IT Service Management (ITSM) platforms, including coordination of cross\-functional delivery teams, business stakeholders, and implementation partners.
 



 • Experience leading delivery within a SAFe environment, including PI Planning and cross\-team execution.
 



 • Project Management Professional (PMP), SAFe Release Train Engineer (RTE), PMI\-ACP, Certified Scrum Master (CSM), or comparable certification.
 



 • Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
 



 • Experience coordinating third\-party implementation partners and enterprise system integrations.
 



**Key Competencies** 




 • Technical Program Leadership
 



 • Release Train \& Scaled Agile Leadership
 



 • Cross\-Team Coordination
 



 • Dependency, Risk \& Issue Management
 



 • Enterprise Systems Thinking
 



 • Executive Communication
 



 • Stakeholder Alignment \& Influence
 



 • Planning, Governance \& Follow\-Through
 



 • Vendor \& Integration Management
 



 • Pragmatic Application of Delivery Frameworks
 



 • Continuous Improvement
 



  





**What Success Looks Like in This Role** 




 • Complex initiatives have clear plans, ownership, governance, milestones, and reliable follow\-through from initiation through implementation.
 



 • Leadership has timely, accurate visibility into delivery progress, risks, dependencies, decisions, and actions requiring attention.
 



 • Cross\-team dependencies and enterprise application integration points are identified early and actively managed through resolution.
 



 • Business, product, technical, and delivery stakeholders remain aligned on priorities, responsibilities, sequencing, and expected outcomes.
 



 • Program planning and execution become increasingly predictable as teams adopt scalable delivery cadences and effective Agile practices.
 



 • The role evolves fluidly between Program Manager and Release Train Engineer responsibilities as the delivery model matures.
 



 • Delivery teams and leaders experience less coordination burden because the role proactively connects work, closes gaps, and sustains momentum across the program.

1caa1162.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION – ARCHITECT

**Company:** Talati \& Partners LLP  
**Position:** Architect  
**Experience:** Minimum 4 Years  
**Industry:** Architecture \& Design  
**Project Type:** Residential \& Commercial  
**Employment Type:** Full Time

JOB OVERVIEW

Talati \& Partners LLP is looking for an experienced and creative **Architect** with a minimum of **4 years of professional experience in residential and commercial architectural design**.

The ideal candidate should have strong design and technical skills, along with the ability to manage projects from **concept development through design documentation and construction coordination**.

The Architect will work closely with clients, consultants, engineers, interior designers, contractors, and project teams to deliver functional, aesthetically strong, and technically sound architectural solutions.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES1\. Architectural Design \& Concept Development

* Understand client requirements, project briefs, site conditions, budgets, and design objectives.
* Develop **conceptual designs, sketches, architectural plans, elevations, sections, and design proposals**.
* Develop innovative and practical architectural solutions for residential and commercial projects.
* Prepare design presentations, 3D models, and architectural visualizations.
* Ensure design concepts are aligned with project requirements and architectural standards.
* Incorporate sustainability, energy efficiency, and environmental considerations where appropriate.

2\. Design Development \& Documentation

* Develop architectural designs from **concept stage through detailed design and construction documentation**.
* Prepare detailed architectural drawings, working drawings, specifications, and schedules.
* Coordinate architectural drawings with structural, MEP, landscape, interior, and other consultants.
* Ensure drawings are accurate, coordinated, and suitable for execution.
* Review drawings and incorporate necessary design modifications.

3\. Client Coordination

* Communicate regularly with clients to understand requirements and provide project updates.
* Present **design concepts, drawings, 3D views, and proposals** to clients.
* Understand and incorporate client feedback while maintaining the overall design intent.
* Participate in client meetings, design reviews, and project discussions.
* Build and maintain professional relationships with clients and project stakeholders.

4\. Project \& Consultant Coordination

* Coordinate with **structural engineers, MEP consultants, interior designers, landscape consultants, contractors, and vendors**.
* Ensure smooth integration of various project components.
* Participate in coordination meetings and resolve design\-related issues.
* Track design deliverables and ensure timely completion of project milestones.
* Assist in maintaining project timelines and documentation.

5\. Site Coordination \& Construction Oversight

* Conduct regular **site visits** to monitor construction progress and implementation of architectural designs.
* Review workmanship and ensure construction follows approved drawings and specifications.
* Address design\-related queries and site issues in coordination with project teams.
* Review shop drawings, samples, materials, and mock\-ups where required.
* Identify discrepancies between drawings and site execution and provide appropriate design solutions.

6\. Research \& Design Innovation

* Stay updated with current **architectural trends, materials, technologies, and construction practices**.
* Research innovative materials, design techniques, and sustainable solutions.
* Explore new approaches to improve functionality, aesthetics, and project outcomes.
* Apply creative problem\-solving to architectural and technical challenges.

QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in **Architecture (B.Arch / M.Arch)** from a recognized institution.
* Minimum **4 years of professional experience** in architectural design.
* Strong experience in **residential and commercial architectural projects**.
* Previous experience working with an **architectural firm or design consultancy** preferred.
* Professional registration/licensure will be an added advantage.
* Strong understanding of architectural design principles and construction practices.
* Good knowledge of **building codes, regulations, zoning requirements, and construction standards**.

SOFTWARE SKILLS

Proficiency in relevant architectural software such as:

**AutoCAD \| Revit \| SketchUp \| 3D Visualization Software \| Adobe Photoshop \| Adobe Illustrator \| MS Office**

CANDIDATE PROFILE

* Strong architectural design sensibility and creative thinking.
* Excellent technical and conceptual design skills.
* Strong understanding of construction details and execution.
* Excellent **communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills**.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with clients, consultants, contractors, and internal teams.
* Strong attention to detail and design quality.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities.
* Proactive, organized, and committed to delivering high\-quality architectural work.

KEY SKILLS

**Architectural Design \| Residential Architecture \| Commercial Architecture \| Concept Design \| Design Development \| Working Drawings \| Construction Documentation \| AutoCAD \| Revit \| SketchUp \| Client Coordination \| Consultant Coordination \| Site Coordination \| Construction Supervision \| Building Codes \| Architectural Detailing \| Project Coordination**

Pay: ₹50,000\.00 \- ₹99,000\.00 per month

79137bc9.title: AWS Cloud Architect
79137bc9.description:
**Job Description**
 We are looking for an experienced Senior AWS Cloud Architect to lead the design and evolution of our enterprise cloud platform Fleethub on Amazon Web Services (AWS).
   

  

 In this role, you will define cloud architecture standards, shape cloud strategy, and guide teams in building secure, scalable, and cost‑efficient cloud‑native solutions. You will work at the intersection of technology, business, and delivery, combining hands‑on architectural expertise with strong leadership and stakeholder collaboration.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Cloud Architecture \& Strategy**
* Design scalable, secure, and cost‑optimized AWS architectures aligned with business and technical requirements
* Define system components, service boundaries, data flows, and integration patterns
* Establish architecture principles for high availability, fault tolerance, and disaster recovery
* Drive cloud standardization, reference architectures, and best practices


**Solution Delivery \& Enablement**
* Lead the implementation of AWS services such as EC2, VPC, S3, RDS, Lambda, EKS, MSK and related platform services
* Guide teams in using Infrastructure as Code (CloudFormation, Terraform, AWS CDK), Terraform is a must
* Work closely with DevOps teams to enable CI/CD pipelines and cloud‑native delivery models. Knowledge of Jenkins is needed
* Support cloud migrations, application modernization, and legacy decompositions


**Security, Compliance \& Governance**
* Design architectures that follow AWS Well‑Architected Framework and security best practices
* Ensure compliance with internal policies and external standards (e.g., OWASP, ISO 27001, SOC 2\)


**Cost, Performance \& Reliability**
* Optimize performance, availability, and cost using CloudWatch, Trusted Advisor, Cost Explorer, and FinOps principles
* Proactively identify risks and architectural improvement opportunities


**Collaboration \& Technical Leadership**
* Partner with software engineers, DevOps, product owners, and stakeholders to align architecture with business goals
* Act as a technical authority and mentor, reviewing designs and coaching engineering teams
* Contribute to end‑to‑end solution design across integrated enterprise systems


**Documentation \& Communication**
* Maintain clear architecture diagrams, technical documentation, and decision records
* Effectively communicate architectural decisions to both technical and non‑technical audiences


**Experience And Skills Required**
* 8–12 years of experience in software or cloud engineering
* 2\+ years in a senior technical leadership or architecture role
* Deep hands‑on experience with AWS services and cloud architecture patterns
* Strong background in designing and building cloud‑native applications (AWS preferred)
* Proficiency in modern application stacks, for example:
* Backend: Python 3\.X, Django 3\.2\.x, Django Rest Framework 3\.14\.x (edited), Celery, Flask, Node.js
* Frontend: Docker Swarm (replacement with Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service is planned), React or comparable frameworks
* Expert understanding of DevSecOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code
* Solid knowledge of cloud security architectures and operational best practices
* Experience with observability, monitoring, and cost management (e.g., CloudWatch, Datadog, FinOps)


 Goodyear is one of the world's largest tire companies. It employs about 68,000 people and manufactures its products in 51 facilities in 19 countries around the world. Its two Innovation Centers in Akron, Ohio, and Colmar\-Berg, Luxembourg, strive to develop state\-of\-the\-art products and services that set the technology and performance standard for the industry. For more information about Goodyear and its products, go to Goodyear.com.
   

  

 Goodyear is an equal employment opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by law.

d3c38208.title: Salesforce Industry Success Architect
d3c38208.description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
 Job Category
   

  

 Customer Success
   

  

 Job Details
   

  

**About Salesforce**
 Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
   

  

 Cloud Success is a specialized team within Customer Success, bringing together technical architects, customer support engineers, and product advisors. This team delivers expert guidance on optimizing and demonstrating Salesforce technology to drive long\-term business success, in addition to resolving technical issues.
   

  

 Success Architects are a pivotal part of the Cloud Success team, supporting Salesforce’s most critical and strategic customers. They provide expert guidance on solution design, focusing on scalability, security, and adherence to standard methodologies. By assessing system performance, they help to optimize efficiency and reliability while proactively identifying risks and recommending improvements to maintain technical health. Success Architects empower businesses to maximize their Salesforce investment by aligning technology with core business goals.
   

  

 The Industry Success Architect collaborates across Customer Success and the Product organization to drive long\-term customer solutions. This includes resolving immediate technical challenges with support engineers while identifying root causes, partnering with customer success managers on strategic guidance and long\-term technology health, and liaising with product teams to surface customer feedback for product improvements.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 As an Industry Success Architect, you will specialize in multiple Industry Clouds with primary, secondary, and tertiary areas of expertise. You will:
   

  

* Drive Customer Impact \- Partner with our most strategic and high\-priority customers, assessing their Industry Cloud implementations and delivering expert recommendations on technical architecture, solution design, application lifecycle management, reliability, and feature adoption.
* Lead with Multi\-Cloud Expertise \- Serve as a trusted Subject Matter Expert (SME) in your designated Industry Clouds, providing both proactive and reactive guidance on architecture, technology strategy, thought leadership, and product best practices. You will help the team stay at the forefront of Industry Cloud innovations, ensuring they are equipped with the latest product developments and emerging trends.
* Communicate with Clarity \- Simplify complex technical concepts for diverse audiences, from technical teams to executive leadership, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor in key business and technology discussions.
* Innovate \& Solve Problems \- Identify capability gaps and design inefficiencies, recommending product enhancements or creative custom solutions that drive customer success and long\-term adoption.
* Execute Proven Strategies \- Leverage and tailor Success Architect playbooks to meet the unique challenges and opportunities of your Industry Cloud customers.
* Build Strong Relationships \- Collaborate with internal and external partners, fostering connections that drive customer success, product improvement, and overall business growth.


**Required Multi\-Cloud Aptitude**
 We are looking for individuals with expertise spanning multiple Industry Clouds (Primary, Secondary, and Tertiary) from the following list. Prioritization of these clouds is geographically diverse, but we are primarily seeking skills in:
   

  

* Industry Cloud
* Education Cloud
* Loyalty Cloud
* Retail and Consumer Goods/Trade Promotion Management
* Non\-Profit
* Financial Services Cloud


**Basic Requirements**
* Solution Design \& Architecture
* 5\+ years of experience in software, system, or enterprise architecture.
* Expertise in Salesforce products, platform capabilities, technical governance, and best practices.
* Experience with large\-scale, complex implementations, including SaaS, PaaS, multi\-tenancy, and multi\-tiered infrastructure.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise application integration, covering process orchestration, master data management, AI, analytics, and security best practices.
* Communication \& Leadership
* Ability to assess business objectives, propose solution options, and drive stakeholder alignment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical concepts to both business and executive audiences.
* Skilled in creating clear, visually compelling design documents for diverse stakeholders.
* Proven ability to lead discussions, influence decision\-making, and advocate for best practices.
* Strategic Thinking \& Problem Solving
* Ability to identify design inefficiencies, recommend optimizations, and drive customer transformation.
* Provide data\-driven insights on customer success stories and industry trends.
* Passion for continuous learning and staying ahead of emerging technologies.


**Desired Technical Skills**
* Secure \& Scalable Architecture: Expertise in role hierarchy, sharing rules, profiles, permission sets, and security configurations. Proven ability to design scalable, high\-performance architectures aligned with Salesforce best practices, including Large Data Volume (LDV) considerations.
* Salesforce Development: Hands\-on experience with APEX programming, JavaScript, Visualforce, and Lightning Web Components (LWC). Familiarity with governor limits and best practices for efficient code execution.
* Data Management \& Integration: Proficient in designing and managing data models, validation rules, and data governance best practices. Experience with data import/export, ETL tools, and integrating Salesforce with external systems via REST/SOAP APIs and middleware (e.g., MuleSoft).
* System Integration \& Extensibility: Strong understanding of integrating Salesforce with other enterprise systems using APIs, middleware, and event\-driven architectures. Experience working with OAuth, Platform Events, External Objects, and tools like Salesforce Connect.
* OmniStudio Knowledge: Experience with OmniStudio components is required.
* DevOps (Core \+ Industry): Strong understanding of software development and delivery process, assessing environments strategy and requirements in order to implement management solutions.


**Certifications**
* Required: Salesforce Admin, Platform Developer 1 and JavaScript Developer
* Highly Desired: Certified Architect Credentials (Application and System Architect), Platform App Builder, Salesforce Advanced Admin and an Accredited Professional credential in at least one Industry Cloud specialization (e.g., Financial Services Cloud, Education Cloud, or Loyalty Cloud).


 Unleash Your Potential
   

  

 When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
 *be your best* 
 , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
 *do your best* 
 . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
   

  

 Accommodations
   

  

 If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
   

  

 Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

 Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non\-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. 0c36325a.title: Service Delivery Manager - Offshore
0c36325a.description:
**Company Description**
 Nexthink is the leader in digital employee experience management software. The company provides IT leaders with unprecedented insight allowing them to see, diagnose and fix issues at scale impacting employees anywhere, with any application or network, before employees notice the issue. As the first solution to allow IT to progress from reactive problem solving to proactive optimization, Nexthink enables its more than 1,200 customers to provide better digital experiences to more than 15 million employees. Dual headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland and Boston, Massachusetts, Nexthink has 9 offices worldwide.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Service Delivery Manager – MSP (SDM) is the focal point of driving the overall technical services delivery to any MSP customer from Day 1 as the project goes live. SDM is introduced as the SPOC from Technical Services at the beginning of the new logo implementation through any of the packages available with Nexthink. As the project enters the run phase, the SDM manages the delivery of scoped Managed Services (hereafter referred to as “Accelerate”) to Nexthink’s MSP Partner \& their end customer. They play a pivotal role in supporting the MSP \& their customer to realise value from the Nexthink platform. The SDM is supported by one or more Professional Services Consultants (PSC) as well as other support functions like Partner Success Manager, Product Managers, Product Support and more over, backend teams creating new content over the Nexthink platform. The objective of SDM is to ensure that Accelerate services are aligned with the customer success plan, and the value metrics being tracked for the customer, ensuring a continuous value delivery to the customer.
   

  

 The role will coordinate the daily activities of the assigned PSCs, along with the other supporting Accelerate teams located globally and focus on the highest priorities and the biggest impact to the customer, while providing quality assurance, and delivering within the agreed service levels.
   

  

 The role is a combination of technical and business skills; in which the candidate would work with the MSP \& their customer right from doing DEX Management planning, document mutually agreeable success parameters, assigning BAU tasks to Accelerate PSCs and setting a governance to track the achievements of set goals \& ultimately, document and present value achieved to the customer. The candidate should have the ability to assess technical requests, have meaningful discussions with customer on their objectives and map the same back to different product features / packages offered by Nexthink. SDM would be responsible to create and drive the Service Delivery Strategy for the customer and would work internal and external stakeholders across the customer and partner organizations.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for the Managed Service Provider (MSP) and their customer, overseeing all deliverables outlined in the Services contract.
   

  

 Participate actively in Customer Steering Group meetings, collaborating with the MSP to discuss Nexthink's role in the customer's Digital Experience (DEX) strategy, understand the partner / customer’s priorities and effectively, ensure timely and qualitative delivery of services.
   

  

 Provide guidance to the PSC \& MSP to drive the Business as Usual (BAU) operations. Recommend new business use cases and engage with the customer / MSP to increase adoption of Nexthink.
   

  

 Analyze customer’s business needs \& pain areas through regular connects, understanding of TCDs from Service Desk \& various data seen from Nexthink. Identify opportunities to increase automation of issues \& leverage existing as well as custom created contents to deliver value to the customer’s / MSP business.
   

  

 Gain a deep understanding of the customer's business goals and objectives as outlined in the MSP contract, aligning Nexthink's deliverables with these objectives.
   

  

 Comprehend the customer's DEX goals, strategic plans, pain points, and limitations to offer informed advice on leveraging Nexthink effectively.
   

  

 Conduct thorough analysis of Nexthink data and present actionable insights to the customer. Create well documented presentations, capturing insights from data and provide recommendations.
   

  

 Organize and coordinate for regular governance calls with MSP as well as bi\-monthly / quarterly business review meetings with a focus on getting things done, based on CSP and mutually agreed road\-map.
   

  

 Collaboratively plan the Customer Success Plan and strategy with the PSM, Sales team, PSC \& SC regularly; ensure to update the CSP based on the customer’s priorities.
   

  

 Lead and manage the PSC / PSCs assigned to specific projects, ensuring their tasks and goals align with the Customer's Success Plan (CSP).
   

  

 Identify and advocate for automation opportunities that bring value to the customer. Prioritize and request custom automation or report creation as needed, working backend with the other support teams of Accelerate.
   

  

 Develop content tailored to customer requirements, collaborating with the Shared Services team for custom scripting, reports using external tools with Nexthink data, custom NQL queries.
   

  

 Support customer initiatives related to Nexthink operations, including existing and upcoming projects. Encourage customer participation in Technical Previews of new features.
   

  

 Organize regular product roadmap workshops to keep customers informed about new features and modules.
   

  

 Meet Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and take prompt action, including internal escalations or partner notifications, in case of any impacts on SLO achievement.
   

  

 Identify and fulfill agreed\-upon use cases, consistently delivering results quarter after quarter.
   

  

 Validate any new service / content requirements from the partner and raise the records in JIRA ticketing system. Assign tasks to self or PSC, post validation.
   

  

 Establish and maintain a regular communication cadence with the MSP and customer through weekly, monthly, and quarterly meetings, ensuring that progress is tracked by PSCs.
   

  

 Maintain updated Action Trackers \& other relevant documents on OneDrive, including customer related insights and roadmap discussions. Update Salesforce records as required.
   

  

 Prepare all customer\-facing and internal deliverables, ensuring they meet high\-quality standards.
   

  

 Coordinate and communicate with cross\-functional teams, including Sales, Support, and Partner Success, to align Managed Services activities.
   

  

 Increase the footprint of Nexthink across different functions of the customer, within IT as well as non\-IT related usage. Enhance stickiness of Nexthink to ensure smooth renewal and possible product upsells.
   

  

 Escalate issues internally and externally when necessary to ensure prompt resolution. Follow\-up with Product Support or relevant resolver groups to ensure timely resolution of issues raised. Raise RED FLAGS to alert in case of any deviations.
   

  

 Stay informed about product development and releases at a level necessary to fulfill the above responsibilities, and inspire PSCs to innovate continuously to maximize Nexthink's value.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Computer Engineering preferred.


**Experience:**
* 8 \- 10 years of experience in technical consulting, analytics, and automation, with a preference for candidates with this background.
* Consulting\-based approach in previous roles coupled with good project management skills.
* Knowledge of Nexthink / competing products would be an advantage.
* Flexible to work in UK / US shifts


**Key Skills and Attributes:**
* Analytical Expertise: Proficient in analyzing data to identify pain points and opportunities, with a strong commitment to providing actionable insights and driving automation.
* Transformation Experience: Demonstrated experience in transformation projects, such as Win10 and O365 migrations.
* End User Computing (EUC) Mastery: Extensive technical knowledge of end user computing (EUC) management.
* Collaborative Aptitude: Skilled at collaborating with dispersed teams, including CTOs, product management, and support, to deliver the right solutions and innovate based on customer input.
* IT Operations Proficiency: Deep understanding of IT operations.
* Quick Learner: Ability to rapidly acquire knowledge of new technologies.
* Customer\-Centric: Proven ability to gather and manage customer feedback, comprehend customer pain points, and propose practical solutions.
* Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a strong ability to engage with customers and collaborate effectively within a team.
* Problem Management: Exceptional problem\-solving skills to address complex issues effectively.
* Adaptability: Capability to excel in challenging environments and adapt to changing circumstances.
* Enthusiasm for Innovation: Passion for working in an international, collaborative, and fast\-paced environment and eagerness to learn and adopt new technologies.
* Technical Proficiency: Excellent knowledge of Microsoft Windows, Office 365, web browsers, and other standard EUC applications.


**Preferred:**
* Nexthink certified professional / previous experience of working with Nexthink or similar DEM tools.
* Practical knowledge of Windows, Office 365 \& overall EUC insights
* Understanding of SQL, XML, PowerShell, PowerBI would be ideal.
* Practical experience of data integration methods and technologies
+ in any of the following:
+ IT systems
+ Enterprise infrastructure management / Data Centers
+ Application development and management
+ Managed IT Services
+ Security
+ Analytics – EU data

* Project Management skills (ITIL, PMP)


**Additional Information**
 We are the pioneers and trailblazers of a global IT Market Category (DEX) that is shaping the future of how the world works, giving our customers’ IT Teams total digital visibility across their enterprise. Our innovative solutions integrate real\-time analytics, automation, and employee feedback across all endpoints. This enables our IT teams to solve complex technical challenges, create ever more productive workplaces, and deliver happy, satisfied employees in the digital workplace.
   

  

 With over 1000 employees across 5 continents, Nexthink operates as One Team, connecting, collaborating and innovating to continuously grow. We call our employees ‘Nexthinkers’ and our commitment to diversity, inclusion, and equity is second to none. We currently have over 75 nationalities working with us, from all cultures and backgrounds, speaking many different languages.
   

  

 If you are looking for a change and like a nice atmosphere, lots of challenges, and having fun while working, this is a great opportunity for you! Check what we offer:
   

  

* 💼 Permanent Contract and a competitive compensation package.
* 🩺 Health insurance through our partnership with ACKO, including OPD coverage for dental, vision, health check\-ups, consultations, and pharmacy expenses.
* 🏡 Hybrid work model balancing office and remote work, with a structured approach for new hires to foster connections and onboarding.
* 🏖️ Flexible Hours and unlimited vacation (employees have unlimited paid time off on top of the 22 days of holidays we offer). Plus, company\-paid bank holidays (12\), sick days (10\-30\), bereavement leave (5\), and 3 days per year for volunteering.
* 📚 Free access to professional training platforms to explore your interests and enhance your skills.
* 🛡️ Stay covered against accidents, bodily injuries, and disabilities with our personal accident insurance policy, providing assurance with coverage up to three times your annual CTC.
* 🍼 New mothers are entitled to up to 26 weeks of maternity leave, with the flexibility to use up to 8 weeks before the expected delivery and the remaining 18 weeks after. Birth fathers can take 6 weeks of paternity leave, while adoptive parents are eligible for 26 weeks of leave for mothers and 6 weeks for fathers.
* 💰 Under the Payment of Gratuity Act, receive gratuity at the rate of 15 days of basic pay for every completed year of service, provided you've been employed by the company for a minimum of 5 years. Gratuity is payable at retirement or resignation based on your last drawn basic pay.
* 📣  Bonuses for referring successful hires after three months of continuous employment.


*Please note that not all the benefits listed above are available for temporary, contract, and internship roles. To ensure you have the most up\-to\-date information, we recommend checking with your Recruitment Partner.*

19a8ff2c.title: Team Lead – Solution Delivery
19a8ff2c.description:
Job Description – Team Lead – Solution Delivery

**Location:** Bengaluru, Karnataka (Travel Across India Required)  
**Department:** Solution Delivery  
**Reporting To:** VP  
**Experience:** 2–4 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

About the Role

Connect4Sure Technologies is looking for an experienced and technically strong **Team Lead – Solution Delivery** to lead and execute end\-to\-end network and IT infrastructure deployment projects at customer locations across India.

The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience in **Telecom, Network Infrastructure, IT Support, Field Services, or Solution Delivery**, along with strong team\-handling, customer coordination, troubleshooting, and project execution capabilities.

The Team Lead will be responsible for managing field teams, coordinating with customers and vendors, ensuring timely project implementation, maintaining quality standards, and providing technical guidance to the delivery team.

Key Responsibilities1\. Team Leadership \& Project Execution

* Lead and manage Solution Delivery Engineers and field implementation teams.
* Plan, allocate, and monitor daily deployment activities based on project requirements.
* Execute end\-to\-end installation, configuration, testing, and commissioning of network and IT infrastructure solutions.
* Ensure projects are completed within committed timelines and quality standards.
* Monitor team productivity, attendance, field activities, and project progress.
* Provide technical guidance and on\-site support to team members.
* Conduct regular reviews of project progress and identify potential delays or risks.
* Ensure effective resource planning and utilization.

2\. Solution Implementation

* Supervise installation, configuration, and testing of:
* Routers
* Switches
* Access Points
* CCTV systems
* Structured cabling
* LAN/WAN infrastructure
* Networking and IT infrastructure equipment
* Conduct and supervise site surveys and assess technical requirements.
* Ensure implementation is carried out according to project specifications and customer requirements.
* Verify network connectivity, equipment configuration, and system performance.
* Ensure successful testing, commissioning, and handover of completed installations.

3\. Customer \& Client Coordination

* Act as the primary point of contact for customers during project implementation.
* Coordinate with customers, vendors, landlords, contractors, and internal teams.
* Communicate project progress, timelines, and technical updates to customers.
* Handle customer concerns and ensure timely resolution of implementation\-related issues.
* Ensure a high level of customer satisfaction throughout project execution.
* Support project handover and obtain customer confirmation/sign\-off wherever applicable.

4\. Technical Troubleshooting \& Support

* Diagnose and resolve technical issues related to networking and IT infrastructure.
* Troubleshoot LAN/WAN connectivity, routing, switching, cabling, and equipment\-related issues.
* Provide technical support to field engineers during installation and commissioning.
* Escalate complex or unresolved technical issues to the appropriate internal technical team or management.
* Coordinate with OEMs, vendors, and technical teams for issue resolution.
* Ensure minimum downtime and timely restoration of services.

5\. Documentation \& Reporting

* Ensure accurate preparation and submission of:
* Installation reports
* Site survey reports
* Site photographs
* Test reports
* Configuration details
* Project completion reports
* Handover documents
* Maintain project\-wise documentation and records.
* Update project progress and daily work status in company systems.
* Prepare regular project status reports for management.
* Track pending activities, issues, dependencies, and project closures.

6\. Vendor \& Resource Coordination

* Coordinate with vendors, subcontractors, and service partners for project execution.
* Ensure vendors and field teams follow project requirements and company standards.
* Monitor the availability of required equipment, tools, materials, and manpower.
* Coordinate logistics and site requirements for smooth project execution.
* Ensure company assets, tools, and equipment are properly maintained and utilized.

7\. Compliance, Quality \& Safety

* Ensure compliance with company SOPs, project guidelines, and client site policies.
* Ensure all installations meet required quality and technical standards.
* Ensure team members follow workplace and site safety procedures.
* Monitor safe handling and installation of networking and electrical equipment.
* Ensure proper use and maintenance of company assets and tools.
* Represent Connect4Sure Technologies professionally at customer locations.

8\. Reporting \& Performance Management

* Track team performance and project delivery metrics.
* Identify performance gaps and provide appropriate guidance to team members.
* Conduct regular team meetings and communicate project priorities.
* Escalate critical project issues and delays to the VP.
* Provide recommendations for improving project execution, productivity, and service quality.

Required Skills

* Strong knowledge of Networking concepts including **LAN/WAN, IP Addressing, Routing, and Switching**.
* Practical knowledge of network infrastructure deployment and troubleshooting.
* Understanding of structured cabling and IT infrastructure.
* Hands\-on experience with routers, switches, access points, CCTV, and related networking equipment.
* Good understanding of network installation, configuration, testing, and commissioning.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving abilities.
* Good team leadership and people management skills.
* Strong customer coordination and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and field teams simultaneously.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of project deliverables.
* Strong documentation and reporting skills.
* Willingness to travel extensively across India.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet strict project deadlines.

Qualification

* Diploma / Bachelor's Degree in Electronics, Telecommunications, Computer Science, Information Technology, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
* Relevant technical certifications in Networking, Telecom, or IT Infrastructure will be an added advantage.

Experience

**2–4 years of experience** in any of the following areas:

* Telecom
* Network Infrastructure
* IT Support
* Field Services
* Solution Delivery
* Network Installation \& Deployment

Candidates with prior experience in **team handling, customer coordination, field implementation, and project execution** will be preferred.

Salary \& Benefits

* Attractive salary package based on experience, technical skills, and performance.
* Travel allowance and applicable reimbursements as per company policy.
* Performance\-based incentives.
* Professional training and certification support.
* Career growth opportunities.
* Opportunity to work on large\-scale network and digital infrastructure projects across India.

Why Join Connect4Sure Technologies?

At **Connect4Sure Technologies**, we are building the future of connectivity by delivering end\-to\-end digital infrastructure solutions across **15,000\+ pincodes in India**.

We provide a collaborative work environment, continuous learning opportunities, exposure to large\-scale infrastructure projects, and a clear career progression path for professionals looking to build a long\-term career in Solution Delivery and Telecom Infrastructure.

Career Progression

**Team Lead – Solution Delivery → Delivery Manager → Senior Delivery Manager → Head of Delivery**

**Who We Are:**

We foster a culture in which every associate feels welcomed and respected, where leaders and creatives are inspired to shape the world of tomorrow by taking bold action today.
   

  

**JOB MISSION:**
 As a Technical Architect, Quote to Cash (Q2C), you will define, design, and support scalable global solutions for the D365 ERP Sales \& Marketing team across the end\-to\-end quote\-to\-cash lifecycle. This role is responsible for translating business requirements into secure, resilient, and high\-performing technical architectures that support quoting, pricing, order management, fulfillment, invoicing, and integrations with enterprise platforms. You will partner closely with business stakeholders, functional leads, developers, and external vendors to deliver strategic technical capabilities that improve operational efficiency, enable business growth, and strengthen customer experience.
   

  

**MAJOR ACCOUNTABILITIES:**
* Define and govern the end\-to\-end technical architecture for Quote to Cash capabilities within Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations, with a focus on Sales \& Marketing and related enterprise platforms.
* Partners with business stakeholders, product owners, and functional teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical designs, integration patterns, and implementation roadmaps.
* Design and oversee customizations, extensions, data entities, workflows, and integrations that support quoting, pricing, order capture, fulfillment, invoicing, and downstream financial processes.
* Establish technical standards, development best practices, and architecture guardrails to ensure solution quality, security, performance, scalability, and long\-term maintainability.
* Lead technical design reviews and provide architectural guidance to development teams for X\+\+, services, APIs, middleware, and Azure\-based integrations.
* Collaborate with enterprise architecture, infrastructure, security, and application and AI teams to ensure alignment with broader platform, integration, data strategies and agentic engineering practices.
* Support environment strategy, release management, DevOps processes, and deployment planning across development, testing, and production landscapes.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues, drive root cause analysis, and implement sustainable technical solutions to improve platform stability and supportability.
* Document solution architectures, technical designs, integration flows, and key architectural decisions to support delivery, governance, and operational continuity.
* Effectively communicate architecture decisions, risks, dependencies, and trade\-offs to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Mentor developers and technical team members, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Stay current on Dynamics 365, Azure, integration technologies, and emerging best practices to continuously improve the Q2C technology landscape.


**REQUIREMETS FOR SUCCESS:**
* 8\+ years of experience in ERP solution delivery, with significant experience in Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations technical architecture, design, and implementation.
* Strong understanding of Quote to Cash business processes, including quoting, pricing, sales order management, fulfillment, invoicing, and integrations with upstream and downstream systems.
* Deep expertise in D365 F\&O technical architecture, extension frameworks, integrations, data entities, security, and environment management.
* Hands\-on experience with X\+\+, .NET, APIs, OData, business events, middleware, and Azure cloud services.
* Experience designing and supporting integrations across ERP, CRM, commerce, warehouse, tax, billing, and other enterprise applications.
* Strong knowledge of application lifecycle management, release management, CI/CD practices, and Azure DevOps.
* Demonstrated ability to design secure, scalable, and high\-performing enterprise solutions in complex global environments.
* Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills with the ability to resolve complex technical issues.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to business and executive audiences.
* Proven experience leading technical teams, mentoring developers, and influencing architecture decisions across cross\-functional teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience in consumer products, retail, or global supply chain environments is preferred.


**Flexible Work Schedule**
 For decades we have fostered a unique culture founded on our values with a particular focus on in\-person teamwork and collaboration. Our hybrid model encourages rich in\-person experiences, showcasing our commitment to teamwork and connection, while providing high levels of flexibility to associates. North American office\-based associates are expected to come into the office on Wednesdays, with other occasional in\-office days for in\-person meetings and events as needed.
