5b4b4ec3.description:
**About M\&G India**
 We are M\&G India, the strategic innovation and digital hub for M\&G. Established in 2003, we have offices in Mumbai and Pune.
   

  

 Our teams work closely with colleagues across the Group worldwide to drive transformation, build digital capability, and support sustainable growth. By leveraging technology, AI, automation, and process excellence, we bring new ways of thinking to improve outcomes for both customers and colleagues.
   

  

 Grounded in a vibrant culture with strong foundations, we are central to how M\&G is transforming as a business.
   

  

**About M\&G**
 Our purpose is to give everyone real confidence to put their money to work. With a heritage dating back more than 175 years, we have a long history of innovation in savings and investments, combining asset management and insurance expertise to offer a wide range of solutions.
   

  

 Our two distinct operating segments, Asset Management and Life, work together to provide access to balanced, long\-term investment and savings solutions.
   

  

 Through telling it like it is, owning it now, and moving it forward together with care and integrity; we are creating an exceptional place to work for exceptional talent.
   

  

**Accountabilities/Responsibilities :**
**The Role:** 
 We are looking to expand our team through M\&G Global Services to continue to provide the highest levels of service to our end users. The Platform Operations team works to high standards within our growing business by managing critical platforms running our Azure estate and supporting our engineering teams to drive business value in technology.
   

  

 The team support our UK business with extended support for Asia Pacific regions. This means working flexible hours to meet our business needs. Currently split across three geographies and supported by a technology partner we stand by having a one team feel and regularly collaborate and work together to meet the common goals. The Platform Operations team is the centre of all things in cloud. The team is responsible for ensuring the continuous operation and upkeep of our cloud infrastructure and platforms, while being empowered to enhance, automate, and shape the future development of this digital estate.
   

  

**Knowledge, Skills, Experience \& Educational Qualification**
 We always support colleagues to develop their skills but to be successful in this role the following will be required:
   

  

* Minimum of 4\-5 years of experience in Windows administration environment and working in the IT industry.
* You will have in\-depth experience as a hands\-on IT Engineer, with strong knowledge on different cloud technologies and platforms, experience with Azure is essential.
* You will understand cloud governance, best practices, and policies within Azure.
* You must have a problem\-solving mindset and the ability to troubleshoot unknown technical issues.
* Proven track record in providing support and troubleshooting for cloud infrastructure, including incident management and root cause analysis.
* Experience in identifying inefficiencies and implementing automated solutions to overcome these.
* As a senior engineer you will be expected to help build out our presence in M\&G Global Services and as such experience of building / mentoring and guiding teams and individuals is essential
* Strong interpersonal skills for working with cross\-functional teams to support cloud solutions effectively.
* An understanding of inventory management and software assurance, alongside CMDB and /or other asset management tooling
* Familiarity with Agile and DevOps methodologies and technologies – Git, Azure DevOps (or equivalent) and CI / CD Pipelines is desirable.
* Relevant cloud and/or technology experience.
* Scripting in your relevant discipline and/or within Cloud Automation
* Experience in implementing and maintaining robust disaster recovery strategies and ensuring business continuity.
* Experience in overseeing and managing the patching process for Windows and Linux servers, ensuring timely updates and minimal disruption. Utilising tools such as Ivanti or similar patch management systems.


 We have a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture at M\&G Global Services, regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, nationality, disability or long term condition, we are looking to attract, promote and retain exceptional people. We also welcome those who take part in military service and those returning from career breaks.

77a4b5fd.description:
**Job Description \- Azure AI/M365 Copilot Search Architect**
 \*\*Key Responsibilities\*\*
   

  

* Design and implement enterprise GenAI search architectures leveraging Azure AI Search and Microsoft 365 Copilot search to deliver reliable, scalable, and intelligent discovery experiences across the organization.
* Architect retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) patterns and semantic search solutions, selecting appropriate vector search, hybrid ranking, and grounding strategies for enterprise knowledge bases.
* Analyze business requirements from diverse stakeholder groups and translate them into detailed search solution designs that balance relevance, latency, security, and cost.
* Configure and optimize indexing pipelines for structured and unstructured data, ensuring consistent ingestion, enrichment, skillset application, and normalization across multiple content repositories.
* Develop search relevance strategies including semantic ranking, vector embeddings, scoring profiles, synonym management, and domain\-specific tuning to improve precision and recall for business\-critical queries.
* Configure Microsoft 365 Copilot search connectors, semantic index integration, and Graph\-based retrieval to surface organizational knowledge within Copilot experiences.
* Collaborate with application engineering teams to integrate search and GenAI capabilities into web portals, internal tools, and customer\-facing applications using appropriate SDKs and APIs.
* Define and implement security and access models, ensuring search results respect data access policies, sensitivity labels, regulatory constraints, and privacy requirements.
* Lead client\-facing architecture and consulting engagements, presenting solution designs, conducting technical workshops, and advising stakeholders on GenAI search strategy and roadmap.
* Monitor search system health by tracking relevance metrics, query latency, index freshness, and grounding quality, and recommend remediation to maintain high availability.
* Conduct capacity planning and performance testing for search and GenAI workloads, predicting growth patterns and optimizing resource utilization across cloud environments.
* Create detailed technical documentation for architectures, configurations, and runbooks, enabling operations teams to support and evolve search platforms efficiently.
* Provide guidance on migration strategies from legacy search platforms to Azure AI Search and Copilot\-based solutions, minimizing disruption and ensuring continuity of critical services.
* Mentor junior engineers and architects on GenAI search technologies, design patterns, and best practices, fostering a culture of technical excellence and knowledge sharing.


 \*\*Required Skills\*\*
   

  

* Hands\-on expertise with Azure AI Search (index design, skillsets, semantic and vector search, scoring profiles).
* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot search, Graph connectors, and semantic index integration.
* Proven experience designing GenAI search solutions, including RAG architectures and embedding\-based retrieval.
* Strong background in search architecture and solution design for enterprise environments.
* Demonstrated client\-facing architecture and consulting engagement experience.


 The Key Skills are
 **Azure AI Search, Microsoft 365 Copilot Search**
 along with GenAI search solutions, Search Architecture , Solution Design, Client\-facing architecture, and consulting engagements.

d97d0736.description:
**About The Company**
 HCLTech is a global technology services company that empowers organizations to reimagine their businesses for the digital age. With a rich history of innovation and a commitment to delivering cutting\-edge solutions, HCLTech offers a comprehensive suite of services including IT consulting, enterprise transformation, and digital engineering. The company operates across various industries such as banking, retail, healthcare, telecom, manufacturing, and technology, ensuring tailored solutions that meet the unique needs of each client. HCLTech’s focus on fostering a collaborative and inclusive work environment has established it as a trusted partner for enterprises seeking to leverage technology for competitive advantage.
   

  

**About The Role**
 HCLTech is seeking a highly skilled Google Cloud Solutions Engineer / Architect to join their team across India. This role is pivotal in accelerating the adoption of Google Cloud Platform (GCP) at the enterprise level, focusing on solution design, technical leadership, and strategic client engagement. The successful candidate will lead opportunities related to cloud migration, modernization, data engineering, and AI\-driven automation, working closely with Fortune 2000 clients across diverse industries including banking, retail, healthcare, and telecom. The role involves collaborating with global sales teams, technical architects, and partners to craft compelling go\-to\-market strategies and technical solutions that align with the client’s business objectives. This is an excellent opportunity for professionals with a strong background in cloud architecture and a passion for innovative solutions to make a significant impact in a dynamic environment.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 The ideal candidate will possess a B.E. / B.Tech degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related fields. They should have between 5 to 7 years of total IT experience, with at least 2\-3 years specifically working on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Technical proficiency in GCP services such as Compute, Storage, and Networking is essential, along with high\-level expertise in Data Engineering, including tools like BigQuery and Looker. A foundational understanding of AI/ML platforms such as Vertex AI and Gemini Enterprise, as well as familiarity with Large Language Models (LLMs), is preferred. Proven experience in working with global system integrator (GSI) partners to develop joint solutions and scale go\-to\-market initiatives is highly valued. Soft skills such as executive presence, whiteboarding capabilities, and the ability to translate technical concepts into business value are crucial for success in this role. Certifications like Google Cloud Certified Professional Cloud Architect, Data Engineer, or Machine Learning Engineer are advantageous.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with global sales teams and Google Cloud architects to respond to RFIs and RFPs, ensuring alignment with customer requirements and strategic objectives.
* Develop ROI models and hyperscale funding strategies that demonstrate TCO benefits and drive cloud adoption initiatives.
* Design industry\-specific use cases for IT managed services, focusing on cloud migration, modernization, and automation.
* Lead technical workshops and create reference architectures for data center migration, cloud modernization, and enterprise cloud adoption.
* Design and implement Google Cloud native applications and data engineering stacks utilizing BigQuery, Looker, and Vertex AI to meet enterprise needs.
* Innovate and design AI solutions such as Gemini Enterprise Agentic AI and generative AI (GenAI) to enhance enterprise automation and cloud operations.
* Partner with GSI and industry domain experts to build joint solutions, scale go\-to\-market efforts, and expand solution footprints.
* Maintain a high level of industry domain knowledge, particularly in BFSI, RCPG, Telecom, Healthcare, and Manufacturing sectors, to tailor solutions effectively.


**Benefits**
 HCLTech offers a competitive compensation package along with comprehensive benefits including health insurance, retirement plans, and paid leave. Employees have access to ongoing learning and development programs to enhance their skills and stay abreast of the latest technological advancements. The company promotes a flexible work environment and provides opportunities for international collaboration and career growth. Additionally, employees are encouraged to participate in innovation initiatives and are supported through mentoring and leadership development programs. HCLTech fosters a culture of inclusion, diversity, and continuous improvement, ensuring a rewarding and engaging workplace experience.
   

  

 Equal Opportunity
   

  

 HCLTech is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment for all employees. We celebrate diversity and are dedicated to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to contribute their best. We do not discriminate based on race, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. Our hiring practices are designed to provide equal opportunities for all qualified candidates, and we encourage individuals from diverse backgrounds to apply and join our team.

a82e907c.title: Cybersecurity Sales Engineer (Presales)
a82e907c.description:
**About Us**
 At Check Point, what you do matters. Every day, we protect over 100,000 organizations worldwide from increasingly sophisticated cyber and AI\-driven threats, securing their AI transformation.
   

  

 Our prevention\-first approach safeguards hybrid networks, cloud environments, digital workspaces, and AI systems, stopping attacks before they happen.
   

  

 This is where innovation meets real\-world impact. You’ll help customers across industries operate with confidence in a rapidly changing digital world, working alongside smart, curious people who take ownership, challenge assumptions, and solve complex problems.
   

  

 We’re proud to be recognized by TIME, Newsweek, and Forbes for excellence and workplace culture.
   

  

 What really sets Check Point apart is the opportunity to grow, contribute, and help companies navigate their AI transformation securely.
   

  

 If you’re excited to work at the forefront of AI\-driven security on a global scale, this is the place to do it.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Your role in a nutshell:**
 No two days are the same. You’ll work hands\-on with market\-leading technologies, diagnose customers’ toughest security challenges, and design solutions alongside partners—playing a central role in high\-impact projects from discovery through delivery.
   

  

**Major Responsibilities**
* Drive sales wins by partnering with partner sales teams: identify prospects, progress opportunities, and demonstrate Check Point’s value proposition.
* Present Check Point at partner\-led customer events, workshops, and industry forums.
* Lead and co\-execute POCs and assessments with partner technical and presales teams for prospective customers.
* Lead value\-driven conversations to identify business problems and propose winning technical solutions.
* Act as a trusted cybersecurity advisor for partner technical communities, answering technical questions and presenting solution benefits.
* Maintain strong knowledge of cybersecurity trends and competitive landscapes to inform sales engagements.
* Support partners with RFIs/RFPs, share best practices, and manage POCs to deliver excellent customer experience through the sales cycle.
* Enable partners and customers on the latest security technologies through training and enablement activities.
* Position Check Point products to maximize cross\-sell and upsell within partner accounts.
* Deliver solution designs, high\-impact proposals, and customer engagements that reinforce Check Point’s leadership.
* Represent Check Point at cybersecurity events and demos.


**Qualifications**
**Desired Background**
* 8\+ years in technology organizations; 4–6\+ years in systems engineering, presales, or partner engineering roles.
* Strong customer\-centric mindset and commitment to excellent customer experience.
* Hands\-on attitude; willing to roll up sleeves to resolve technical blockers.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Solid understanding of networking technologies, application architectures, and solution design.
* Experience creating end\-to\-end security solutions across network, endpoint, and cloud.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Relevant certifications preferred (e.g., CCNP, CISSP, CCSA, CCSE).
* Engineering degree in Computer Science, Electronics, or related discipline.

a4deaed6.title: AI Solutions Architect
a4deaed6.description:
**Why WWT?**
 World Wide Technology (WWT) strives to make a new world happen. WWT's work benefits clients and partners as much as it does its people and community across the globe.
   

  

 Founded in 1990, WWT brings together strategy, deep technical expertise and world\-class partnerships to help public and private sector organizations design, build and scale intelligent AI, digital, cybersecurity, cloud and infrastructure solutions. Through its Advanced Technology Center (ATC) \- a collaborative ecosystem featuring state\-of\-the\-art hardware and software \- WWT enables clients and partners to conceptualize, test and validate innovative technology and then deploy solutions at scale using its global integration and distribution capabilities.
   

  

 With more than 14,000 team members and over 60 locations globally, WWT's culture—grounded in core values and leadership philosophies—has been recognized by Fortune® and Great Place to Work for its commitment to innovation, trust and creating a great place to work for all.
   

  

 WWT provides products and services to large enterprise, global service provider and public sector clients in up to 130 countries across six continents. Softchoice, a World Wide Technology company, supports commercial and SMB markets in the U.S. and Canada.
   

  

 The AI Solutions Architect is the technical pre\-sales partner within each regional AI POD. This role brings hands\-on architectural expertise into customer engagements during the pre\-sales phase, translating customer business requirements into concrete AI solution designs, reference architectures, and technical proposals that give WWT credibility and differentiation in competitive pursuits.
   

  

 This is not a delivery or post\-sales engineering role. The AI Solutions Architect operates in a revenue\-generating context, working alongside the AI Solutions Executive to win deals by providing the technical depth that enterprise customers require before committing to AI investments. The role demands the ability to whiteboard an end\-to\-end AI architecture in a customer meeting, coordinate proof\-of\-concept engagements through WWT’s Advanced Technology Center (ATC), and ensure that what is sold can be built, scoped accurately, and transitioned cleanly to delivery teams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities\-**
**Technical Pre\-Sales \& Solution Design**
* Serve as the technical counterpart to the AI Solutions Executive in all customer\-facing engagements, providing architectural depth, solution credibility, and technical validation.
* Translate customer business problems into AI solution architectures spanning GPU/compute infrastructure, data platforms, AI/ML frameworks, networking for AI, storage, and application layers.
* Design and present technical proposals, reference architectures, and proof\-of\-concept plans that accelerate customer decision\-making and de\-risk complex AI deployments.
* Conduct technical discovery sessions with customer platform engineering, data science, and infrastructure teams to assess environment readiness (including space, power, cooling), workload requirements, and integration complexity.


**NVIDIA \& Partner Technical Alignment**
* Work directly with NVIDIA resources aligned with target accounts on GPU/compute\-specific design validation, NVAIE software stack integration, and DGX/HGX configuration optimization.
* Maintain deep technical currency across the NVIDIA ecosystem: DGX/HGX systems, CUDA, AI Enterprise, NeMo, Omniverse, etc. and partner integration patterns.
* Collaborate with cloud provider and infrastructure partner teams (AWS, Azure, GCP, Dell, HPE, Cisco, NetApp, Pure Storage, Vast Data, \+) on hybrid and multi\-cloud AI architecture design.


**Pre\-Sales to Delivery Handoff**
* Bridge the gap between pre\-sales and delivery: ensure that solution architectures are technically feasible, scoped accurately, and documented for clean transition to services and engineering teams.
* Participate in scope reviews and SOW validation alongside the AI Services Consultant to ensure alignment between what is proposed and what will be delivered.
* Provide post\-handoff technical consultation as needed to support delivery teams during implementation of complex architectures.


**POD \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Operate as an integrated member of the three\-person regional POD (AI Solutions Executive, AI Solutions Architect, AI Services Consultant), participating in weekly POD cadence, joint pipeline reviews, and account planning.
* Operate as a trusted AI subject matter resource to field sales teams, embedding into account planning and strategy sessions to surface AI opportunities.
* Build strong working relationships with field sales teams across the assigned region, earning inclusion in customer conversations and account reviews through consistent value delivery.


 ,
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* Minimum 10 years in technical pre\-sales, solutions architecture, or advanced engineering roles at a solutions provider, OEM, cloud provider, or consulting firm.
* Hands\-on experience designing AI/ML infrastructure and platforms. Must be able to whiteboard an end\-to\-end AI architecture from GPU cluster design through networking, storage, software staock, MLOps pipeline, and inference deployment.
* Working knowledge of NVIDIA DGX/HGX systems, CUDA, AI Enterprise software suite, and partner integration patterns.
* Experience with AI workloads across on\-premises, cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), and hybrid environments. Understanding of NCP models, GPU\-as\-a\-service, and sovereign AI infrastructure.
* Exceptional ability to translate technical complexity into business\-relevant narratives. Strong presentation and whiteboarding skills.
* Comfortable operating in a revenue\-generating, pre\-sales context. Understands that the purpose of technical engagement is to advance deals.
* Experience collaborating in co\-selling models with sales specialists, field account teams, and partner SE resources.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or related field required.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* NVIDIA\-certified or equivalent AI/ML platform certifications.
* Cloud architecture certifications (AWS SA Pro, Azure Solutions Architect, GCP PCA).
* Prior experience at a top\-tier solutions provider, related OEM, or cloud provider.
* Experience designing AI Factory / GPU cluster architectures at enterprise scale.
* Familiarity with WWT’s Advanced Technology Center model and lab\-led selling methodology.
* Masters or advanced degree in technology, analytics, or business preferred.

 The
 **Solutions Consultant \- Indirect Tax, India** 
 will play a key pre\-sales role in driving revenue growth for Thomson Reuters' tax technology portfolio across the India market.
   

  

 This role is responsible for partnering closely with Sales teams to identify, qualify, shape, and close strategic opportunities by bringing deep domain expertise in indirect tax, GST, e\-invoicing, compliance workflows, and tax technology solutions. The Solutions Consultant will act as a trusted advisor to customers, helping them understand how Thomson Reuters solutions can address their business, compliance, operational, and technology challenges.
   

  

 As a subject matter expert, you will lead customer discovery, solution positioning, product demonstrations, proposal support, and executive\-level conversations throughout the sales cycle. You will help translate customer pain points into compelling solution strategies that differentiate Thomson Reuters from competitors and support successful deal outcomes.
   

  

 This is a client\-facing, commercially focused pre\-sales role requiring strong tax domain knowledge, consultative selling skills, and the ability to influence both customers and internal stakeholders.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Pre\-Sales \& Solution Consulting
   

  

* Partner with Sales teams to support the full sales cycle from opportunity qualification through solution design, proposal development, negotiation support, and deal closure.
* Lead customer discovery sessions to understand business challenges, compliance requirements, current tax processes, technology landscape, and desired outcomes.
* Recommend the most appropriate Thomson Reuters tax solutions based on customer needs, business priorities, and regulatory requirements.
* Translate complex indirect tax, GST, and e\-invoicing requirements into clear, compelling solution narratives for customers.
* Develop differentiated value propositions that clearly position Thomson Reuters against competitors.
* Support Sales teams in qualifying opportunities, defining scope, identifying decision criteria, and progressing deals through the pipeline.
* Help develop and close new business opportunities to meet and exceed gross sales targets.


 Product Demonstrations \& Customer Engagement
   

  

* Own and deliver tailored product demonstrations aligned to customer pain points, use cases, industry requirements, and buying\-stage maturity.
* Present Thomson Reuters solutions confidently to a range of stakeholders, including tax, finance, IT, procurement, shared services, and executive leadership.
* Lead solution workshops, proof\-of\-concept discussions, and technical or functional deep\-dive sessions where required.
* Support complex customer engagements by providing subject matter expertise and solution credibility.
* Assist in strategic retention and renewal situations by reinforcing solution value and identifying expansion opportunities.


 Proposal, RFP \& Deal Support
   

  

* Support responses to RFPs, RFIs, tenders, and customer questionnaires with strong functional, domain, and solution input.
* Contribute to proposal development, solution architecture, business case creation, and commercial positioning.
* Work with Sales, Product, Legal, Commercial Policy, and other internal teams to support complex deal execution.
* Provide insight during bid strategy discussions and help shape winning proposals for strategic accounts.


 Market, Domain \& Thought Leadership
   

  

* Stay current on developments in indirect tax, GST, e\-invoicing, regulatory changes, digital tax transformation, and tax technology trends in India.
* Bring market insights and domain expertise into customer conversations to build credibility and trusted advisor status.
* Represent Thomson Reuters in customer meetings, industry events, webinars, internal enablement sessions, and public forums where appropriate.
* Share customer feedback, market trends, competitive insights, and product enhancement opportunities with Product and Business teams.
* Act as an internal advocate for customer needs and market requirements.


 Pipeline, Forecasting \& Internal Collaboration
   

  

* Maintain accurate and timely opportunity, activity, and customer information in Salesforce and other CRM systems.
* Collaborate closely with Sales to support pipeline progression, deal strategy, and forecast accuracy.
* Work cross\-functionally with Product, Marketing, Customer Success, Professional Services, and Support teams to ensure customer requirements are understood and addressed.
* Contribute to continuous improvement in pre\-sales processes, sales enablement, customer engagement models, and organizational effectiveness.


**About You**
 The successful candidate will be a commercially minded tax technology professional with strong pre\-sales, consulting, or solution\-selling experience. You will be comfortable engaging senior stakeholders, uncovering customer needs, positioning enterprise solutions, and helping Sales teams close complex opportunities.
   

  

* CA qualification
* Typically 10\+ years of relevant industry experience in indirect tax, GST, e\-invoicing, tax technology, finance transformation, consulting, pre\-sales, or enterprise software solutions.
* Strong understanding of Indian indirect tax regulations, GST compliance, e\-invoicing, e\-way bill processes, and related tax technology workflows.
* Proven experience in a customer\-facing role, ideally in pre\-sales, solution consulting, tax technology consulting, enterprise software sales support, or advisory services.
* Demonstrated ability to support or influence complex B2B sales cycles.
* Strong commercial acumen and understanding of the sales process, including opportunity qualification, discovery, solution positioning, objection handling, proposal support, and deal closure.
* Experience supporting RFPs, RFIs, tenders, proposals, demonstrations, or bid processes.
* Ability to understand customer business challenges and map them to appropriate solutions.
* Strong presentation, storytelling, and communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Ability to engage confidently with senior stakeholders across tax, finance, accounting, IT, procurement, and executive leadership.
* Consultative mindset with strong problem\-solving skills and a customer\-first approach.
* Ability to manage multiple opportunities, priorities, and pre\-sales projects simultaneously.
* Experience identifying cross\-sell and up\-sell opportunities across a broader tax, accounting, or compliance solution portfolio.
* Strong CRM discipline, preferably with Salesforce experience.


**Preferred Experience**
* Experience working with enterprise tax, ERP, compliance, or finance automation solutions.
* Prior experience with Thomson Reuters tax products or comparable tax technology platforms.
* Background in Big 4, tax consulting, tax technology implementation, enterprise SaaS, or regulatory compliance solutions.
* Exposure to large corporate tax and finance departments, shared service centers, or multinational compliance environments.

* Flexibility \& Work\-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work\-life balance.
* Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real\-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills\-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI\-enabled future.

d1a02f3b.title: Consultant | Site Reliability Engineering | Bengaluru | Engineering | Hybrid Cloud Engineering
d1a02f3b.description:
**Consultant \| Site Reliability Engineering \| Bengaluru**

  


**Overview**



We are looking for a highly skilled Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to manage and scale mission\-critical, production\-grade distributed systems running on AWS. The ideal candidate will focus on reliability, automation, observability, and operational excellence while minimizing toil and improving system availability. Maintaining and improving 4 Nines of uptime to 5 Nines with engineering efforts.



This role requires deep technical expertise in cloud\-native technologies, Kubernetes, infrastructure automation, Linux administration and TCP/IP fundamentals, and strong troubleshooting capabilities for distributed systems. The candidate needs to participate in the overall lifecycle management of mission critical banking services with a 24x7 operations mode in an rotational on\-call basis. The job requires the candidate to have strong troubleshooting skills in a distributed environment spread across multiple cloud environments. The bare minimum ask would be to maintain high level of agility, learnability and adaptability in different scenarios. An engineer with a zeal to learn fast and having a bias for action would be the best fit for the role.

  


**Key Responsibilities**

  


**Reliability \& Operations**


* Own end\-to\-end production systems reliability, availability, scalability, cost and performance.
* Troubleshooting EKS from SRE perspective
* Route53, Connectivity, Networking, RDS, S3
* Participate in 24x7 on\-call rotations and handle high\-severity incidents and document the learnings on ongoing basis.
* Establish and manage SLI, SLO, SLA, Error Budgets, and operational metrics for mission critical services and partner with engineering teams with full accountability for upholding the SLOs.
* Partner with the various engineering, operations and cloud management teams to deliver highly reliable service in a timely manner.


**Cloud \& Infrastructure**


* Design, deploy, and manage infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Work extensively on:
* GKE (Kubernetes Engine)
* Compute, networking, IAM, Load Balancers, TLS Certs
* BigQuery, Pub/Sub, cloud logging enhancement, metrics and logs analysis
* Implement and manage infrastructure using Terraform (Infrastructure as Code).


**Kubernetes \& Containers**


* Deploy and manage containerized workloads using Kubernetes (GKE).
* Troubleshoot issues related to:
* Pods, nodes, networking, storage, services on an ongoing basis
* Manage deployments using Helm, YAML, and rollout strategies (Canary/Blue\-Green).


**Automation \& CI/CD**


* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using:
* Jenkins (pipeline\-based, Groovy / Shell / Python scripting)
* Strong experience in using GitHub as a PowerUser
* Develop automation using Python and Shell scripting.
* Reduce operational toil through automation initiatives.


**Observability \& Monitoring**


* Implement and manage monitoring systems using:
* Dynatrace, Grafana, logs and metrics explorer
* Work with logs, metrics, and traces for deep observability to identify trends and arrest problems proactively.
* Define alerting strategies based on system behaviour and SLOs and create runbooks.
* Work alongside operations teams to identify, fix the production incidents and own the problem resolution.
* Work with engineering teams to isolate infra and application issues and set up right tooling for debugging production incidents.


**System \& Application Troubleshooting**


* Perform deep troubleshooting for:
* Distributed systems
* Microservices\-based architectures on containerised workloads
* Java and Golang applications
* Strong debugging of:
* Application issues
* Infrastructure issues
* Network\-related problems


**Plan and execute continuous improvement**


* Identify and eliminate repetitive manual tasks.
* Drive reliability engineering practices and culture. (DRY – Don’t Repeat Yourself)
* Collaborate with development teams to improve system design and resilience.

  


**Job Requirements**


**Experience**


* 3–5 years of relevant and progressive experience in SRE / DevOps / Cloud Engineering
* Hands\-on experience managing production\-grade systems (24x7 environments)

  


**Technical Skills**


* Troubleshooting EKS from SRE perspective
* Route53, Connectivity, Networking, RDS, S3


**Infrastructure as Code**


* Strong hands\-on experience with Terraform
* Ability to write and debug Terraform code from scratch


**Containers \& Orchestration**


* Deep expertise in:
* Kubernetes (GKE)
* Docker
* Strong troubleshooting experience in Kubernetes environments


**CI/CD \& Automation**


* Hands\-on experience with:
* Jenkins (pipeline\-based CI/CD)
* GitHub
* Strong scripting skills:
* Python (preferred)
* Shell scripting
* Experience with automation frameworks and tooling


**Observability**


* Experience with:
* Dynatrace / Grafana
* Log, metrics, and trace\-based monitoring


**Programming \& Debugging**


* Working knowledge of:
* Java and/or Golang applications
* Strong debugging skills across application and infrastructure layers


**Linux \& Networking**


* Strong Linux fundamentals
* Deep understanding of TCP/IP networking
* Ability to debug network issues in distributed systems


**Reliability Engineering Skills**


* Solid understanding of:
* SLI, SLO, SLA, Error Budgets
* Demonstrable and Proven Experience improving:
* MTTR, MTTA
* Experience handling incident management lifecycle


**Soft Skills**


* Strong analytical and troubleshooting mindset
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management
* Ability to work in high\-pressure production environments
* Ownership\-driven and proactive approach


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience in high\-scale distributed systems
* Exposure to banking/financial domain (optional but valuable)
* Understanding of security and compliance practices
* Experience with deployment strategies:
* Canary, Blue\-Green


**Ideal Candidate Profile in summary would be like**


* Strong AWS \+ Kubernetes \+ Terraform core
* Hands\-on production troubleshooting expert
* Good at automation \+ reducing toil
* Deep understanding of SRE principles
* Comfortable in 24x7 production environments

**Senior Consultant \| Hybrid cloud \| Hyderabad \| Engineering \| Hybrid Cloud Engineering**


**Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Mumbai (Client Office / On\-site)**

  


**Job Summary**



We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated MSSQL Database Specialist to take full ownership of our enterprise Microsoft SQL Server environment while providing secondary support across our open\-source and NoSQL database layers. The ideal candidate will focus primarily on maximizing the performance, security, high availability, and integrity of critical MSSQL instances, while possessing working knowledge of PostgreSQL, Redis, and modern NoSQL systems. You will drive production database operations, optimize complex architectures or lead enterprise database governance.

  




DBA resource should be capable of supporting database administration activities in cloud environments, including AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). The DBA should have hands\-on experience in managing, monitoring, troubleshooting, performance tuning, backup/recovery, high availability, and security of MSSQL databases across these cloud platforms.

  


**Key Responsibilities**


* Design, install, configure, patch, and upgrade enterprise Microsoft SQL Server instances (SQL Server 2016 through latest editions).
* Architect, deploy, and manage AlwaysOn Availability Groups, Failover Cluster Instances (FCI), and transactional replication setups.
* Profile server resource usage, tune complex T\-SQL queries optimize indexes, and resolve blocking or deadlocking issues.
* Implement strict security standards, including Transparent Data Encryption (TDE), data masking, server auditing, and Active Directory / RBAC configurations.
* Establish, document, and routinely execute robust disaster recovery (DR) plans and advanced backup configurations.
* Maintain and troubleshoot SQL Server Agent jobs, SSIS packages, SSRS reports, and core ETL pipelines.
* Participate in database architecture planning, code reviews, and schema migrations to ensure alignment with production best practices.
* *(For Associate Director)* Drive enterprise\-wide data governance strategy, manage team delivery, interface with senior client stakeholders, and map out long\-term infrastructure roadmaps.

  


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**


* **Primary Skill:** 100% focused expertise in Microsoft SQL Server (MSSQL) database administration, database engineering, and architecture.
* Mastery of **T\-SQL (Transact\-SQL)** development, including writing and optimizing stored procedures, functions, views, and complex triggers.
* Deep hands\-on experience using **SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS)**, SQL Profiler, and Extended Events.
* Solid technical understanding of Windows Server operating systems, Windows Failover Clustering, and Active Directory integration.
* Experience with native or third\-party database monitoring tools (e.g., Redgate, Idera, SolarWinds).
* Strong analytical, debugging, and query\-optimization troubleshooting capabilities.

  


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate or relevant legacy MSSQL certifications.
* Experience managing cloud\-managed MSSQL deployments (e.g., AWS RDS for SQL Server or Azure SQL Database).
* Exposure to automated database deployment scripts or infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform, Ansible).

  


**Soft Skills**


* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in high\-pressure client\-office environments.
* Excellent technical problem\-solving and rapid troubleshooting skills.
* Strong commitment to deliver quality, SLA management, and timeline discipline.

  


**Education**


* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related technical field.

Job description

**Company Description**

Thikedaar.Com, a construction tech\-startup launched in 2020, provides smart construction solutions in Delhi\-NCR, Patna \& Ranchi. The company ensures transparent costs and timely delivery of projects, backed by a team of experienced engineers, architects, and construction managers. Thikedaar.Com focuses on delivering high\-quality, customized designs to create happy homes for customers.

**Role Description**

This is a full\-time on\-site role for a **Architect** at Thikedaar.Com in Patna. Their role is to assist in the design and development of architectural projects, including drafting, planning, and coordinating various project elements.

**Responsibilities**

**Design Support**:

* Assisting in the creation of architectural designs, drawings, and models using software like AutoCAD, Revit, or SketchUp.
* Developing 2D and 3D visualizations to represent architectural concepts.
* Participating in design discussions and contributing creative solutions.

**Drafting and Documentation**:

* Preparing detailed construction drawings, layouts, and technical documentation.
* Creating floor plans, elevations, sections, and detailed schematics of architectural elements.

**Project Coordination**:

* Collaborating with engineers, contractors, and other team members to ensure designs align with project requirements.
* Coordinating with other disciplines like structural, mechanical, and electrical teams.

**Research and Material Selection**:

* Researching building materials, construction techniques, and sustainable design solutions.
* Assisting in the selection of materials, finishes, and fixtures that align with the design intent.

**Compliance and Regulations**:

* Ensuring designs adhere to local building codes, zoning laws, and safety regulations.
* Assisting in obtaining permits and necessary approvals from local authorities.

**Site Visits**:

* Visiting construction sites to monitor progress and ensure that work is being carried out according to plans.
* Identifying any issues or discrepancies and reporting them to senior architects.

**Client Communication**:

* Supporting senior architects in client meetings by preparing presentations and documentation.
* Communicating design updates or changes under the direction of senior team members.

**Learning and Development**:

* Keeping up\-to\-date with the latest architectural trends, tools, and technologies.
* Attending training and workshops to enhance skills and knowledge in architecture.

**Skills Required**

* Proficiency in architectural design software (AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp, etc.).
* Strong understanding of architectural principles and construction methods.
* Attention to detail and strong organizational skills.
* Ability to work in a team and take direction from senior staff.
* Good communication and presentation skills.

**Behavioral Skills**

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Ability to work effectively in a team environment
* Excellent problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities
* Adaptability and flexibility to handle changing project requirements
* Attention to detail and commitment to safety and quality

Pay: ₹11,238\.36 \- ₹52,000\.56 per month

Experience:

* total work: 1 year (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

**Role Description**
 The D365 Finance \& Operations Solution Architect is responsible for end to end solution definition, design, and governance for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance \& Supply Chain Management implementations in healthcare provider, payer, and life sciences environments across the USA and India. The role combines architecture leadership, domain consulting, and delivery oversight to ensure compliant, scalable, and high quality solutions for multi entity, multi country healthcare organizations.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the overall D365 F\&O/F\&SCM solution architecture for healthcare clients (hospitals, clinic networks, diagnostics, pharmacies, payers, and med device/life sciences), covering finance, supply chain, procurement, projects, and shared services.
* Translate healthcare business requirements (patient care operations, clinical supply, pharmacy, insurance/payer, capex/OPEX control) into scalable F\&O designs including integrations, data, and security.
* Lead discovery and fit gap workshops with clinical, operations, finance, and IT stakeholders in USA and India, aligning solution design with local regulatory, tax, and compliance requirements.


 Define environment, deployment, and ALM strategy for multi region programmes, including localisation for US GAAP/IRS, Indian GST, TDS/TCS, and statutory reporting.
   

  

 Design and govern integrations between D365 F\&O and EHR/EMR, HIS, LIS, pharmacy, insurance/payer systems, and healthcare ISVs using DMF, dual write, APIs, and Azure services.
   

  

 Drive data architecture and migration strategy including CoA harmonisation, item/master data, vendor/contract data, and patient billing related financial data with appropriate controls and anonymisation where required.
   

  

 Define security, role based access, and SoD aligned to healthcare processes and compliance needs (e.g., alignment with HIPAA principles where applicable on financial/operational data touchpoints, internal controls, audit).
   

  

 Provide design governance for customisations and extensions, ensuring use of standard capabilities, ISVs, and Microsoft best practices to minimise technical debt and simplify validation.
   

  

 Act as solution authority across the delivery lifecycle, managing design risks, change requests, and cross workstream dependencies (finance, supply chain, pharmacy, projects, integration, data, testing).
   

  

 Support pre sales for healthcare accounts: solution proposals, RFP/RFI responses, estimation, solution walkthroughs, and industry specific demos (e.g., centralised procurement, inventory optimisation for OT/ICU, pharmacy processes).
   

  

 Act as trusted advisor to CFOs, COOs, CIOs, and clinical operations leadership, shaping roadmaps for finance transformation, shared services, procurement consolidation, and cost optimisation.
   

  

 Mentor functional and technical teams in both USA and India, fostering reusable healthcare templates (process maps, configuration blueprints, data templates, test packs).
   

  

**Required Experience (5\-7 Years)**
 5\-7 years of overall IT/ERP experience with at least 10\+ years on Microsoft Dynamics AX / D365 F\&O / F\&SCM and a minimum of 5\+ years focused on healthcare or life sciences clients.
   

  

 Minimum 3\-5 years in a Solution Architect / Senior Solution Architect role on large, multi entity or multi country D365 F\&O programs.
   

  

 Strong experience with end to end implementations involving finance, procurement, inventory/warehousing, and project accounting for hospitals, clinic chains, diagnostics networks, or healthcare service organizations.
   

  

 Proven track record with USA and/or India rollouts, including localization for US and Indian finance, tax, and statutory requirements.
   

  

 Demonstrable experience in designing and governing integrations with EMR/EHR, HIS, LIS, pharmacy, or insurance/payer platforms and healthcare ISVs.
   

  

 Consulting or partner background with substantial client facing responsibilities, including steering committees and executive stakeholder management.
   

  

**Skills And Qualifications**
 Bachelor s or master s degree in business, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, or related field; healthcare, life sciences, or supply chain certifications are an advantage.
   

  

 Deep understanding of D365 F\&O/F\&SCM capabilities across GL, AP, AR, FA, Cash \& Bank, Project accounting, Procurement \& Sourcing, Inventory \& Warehouse, and basic manufacturing where relevant.
   

  

 Strong grasp of healthcare business processes: patient and clinical operations cost tracking, service line profitability, procurement and inventory for medical consumables and implants, pharmacy operations, and capital projects for hospital expansion.

**About Us**

We use AI to find audiences in a privacy\-first world using trillions of contextual bidding signals coupled with proprietary behavioral models. Our audience engagement platform includes a full\-service agency team and a Unified Creative Strategy that delivers ad creative ideation and execution. **Post\-Sales Technical Support**

**Technical Implementation**
* Support integrations with advertiser systems, data partners, attribution providers, and measurement vendors.
* Manage deployment of campaign features such as targeting, tracking pixels, audience ingestion, and reporting pipelines.

* Escalate and document product issues impacting customer deployments.

**Customer Success Enablement**
* Monitor and analyze campaign performance and system metrics.
* Proactively identify optimization opportunities and technical improvements.
* Create documentation and best practices for technical implementations.


**Required Skills / Experience**
* 4 \- 6 years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or other customer\-facing technical roles.
* Experience working with AdTech / MarTech platforms or similar data\-driven or real\-time systems is preferred. Basic understanding of programmatic advertising, DSP ecosystem, or similar distributed platforms is preferred.
* Familiarity with at least one programming language such as Python, Java, or JavaScript.
* Strong SQL skills for data analysis, debugging, and troubleshooting, along with experience in PostgreSQL or MySQL.
* Experience with APIs, data pipelines, and system integrations.

* Exposure to mobile apps, SDK integrations, or tracking implementations is preferred.
* Experience using logs, dashboards, or analytics tools for monitoring and debugging along with analytical thinking and structured problem\-solving ability.
* Customer\-first mindset with the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work cross\-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams.

 Job Details
   

  

**About Salesforce**
 Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
   

  

 Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include—but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
   

  

 You are both a big picture thinker and in\-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution, including knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality and accelerate design cycles. The solutions you design are built for the long\-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API's as well as a strong development background.

* Translate business requirements into well\-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform, including identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI capabilities using Agentforce
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases

* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed, utilizing AI coding assistants to help enforce standards and optimize code performance
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation, championing the team's use of tools like GitHub Copilot to accelerate the generation of Apex classes, mock data, and REST integrations
* Focus on Performance Evaluation \& ROI by collaborating with customers to develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance and business value for their specific use cases
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues, leveraging AI diagnostics to interpret system logs and isolate performance bottlenecks quickly

* Expert level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Community, Marketing, and Community Clouds, as well as an understanding of Agentforce architecture
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance\-driven solutions, including using AI platforms to evaluate architectural scaling and load limits

* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.), utilizing AI platforms to parse third\-party REST API documentation and map complex data schemas
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Practical fluency using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to accelerate delivery, document technical architecture, and maintain a high standard of code quality
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end\-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web\-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire.

ee8dcf3e.description:
**Req ID:** 
 379023
   

  

 NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
   

  

 We are currently seeking a SAP Client Delivery Manager to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN\-KA), India (IN).
   

  

**CDM Job Description**
 ABOUT THE TEAM
   

  

 SAP Customer Delivery Engagement (CDE) is part of SAP Enterprise Cloud Services (ECS) and delivers fixed\-scope, proactive and outcome\-based services across the entire SAP software stack to SAP’s PaaS and SaaS cloud and on\-premise customers.We manage a variety of customer engagements in HANA Enterprise Cloud, other SAP Cloud Offerings (like SuccessFactors) and on\-premise. The service portfolio includes infrastructure services and Application Managed Services like Managed Data, Testing and Security.
   

  

 We create a stable foundation for our customers’ IT operations and support customers on their digital transformation journey to the intelligent enterprise based on S4/HANA. With continuous access to our expertise and the broader SAP expert network, our customers can take advantage of the latest technologies to support continuous business innovation. SAP CDE helps customers accelerate their innovation adoption, delivering the flexibility to adapt to business changes, rapidly implement technologies and standardize and optimize operations of SAP centric solutions. The mission of the CDE Organization is to maximize the customer success by helping to manage complexity, ensure stable operations, mitigate risk and lowering total cost of operation, support customers on their journey to the intelligent enterprise powered by S4/HANA and releasing investment as well as customer resource capacity for innovation.
   

  

 THE ROLE
   

  

 The CDM is the voice of the client within SAP and recognized as the main contact and escalation point for all questions and issues with regards to the ECS engagement
   

  

 The Customer Delivery Manager (CDM) is the personal point of contact for all ECS customers, managing and coordinating all account activities with internal stakeholders and customers. The CDM cooperates closely with the Technical Service Managers (TSM) and the Project Lead (PL) during larger customer projects. The CDM builds a solid customer relationship and acts as a trusted advisor to the customer.
   

  

 The CDM ensures that SAP HANA Enterprise Cloud customers receive the best possible service by focusing on customer satisfaction, contract adherence and profitability. He/She is responsible for ensuring contractually agreed services are being rendered and that change requests are processed in a timely manner.
   

  

 The CDM cooperates closely with the customers’ IT department and business stakeholders, cooperatively planning and coordinating service requests. Also he is in contact with the Management / C\-Level and acts as trusted advisor who grows the business by driving the client’s digital transformation and generating higher customer value. The CDM shares monthly / quarterly reporting on the Service Level with the customer and advises on new services or other developments within SAP HANA Enterprise Cloud that increase the business value for the customer.
   

  

 The CDM role has variations depending on the customer’s contract type.
   

  

 CDM Tasks
   

  

 Some of the CDM’s task include:
   

  

* Actively drives the cloud transformation agenda with key client stakeholders to ensure adoption of S/4HANA and cloud standardization
* Lead the customer engagement and ensures seamless alignment across multiple internal and external stakeholders such as SAP Services, SAP Product support, ECS Partners and customer’s System Integrators or other Hosting Partners
* Perform administrative tasks required to manage the engagement (staffing, reporting \& controlling).
* Manage proactive delivery of service plans and reactive support requests
* Host regular status and governance meetings with customers and other SAP stakeholders (extended account team)
* Drive transformation and onboarding towards SAP Cloud Solutions
* Drives end\-to\-end customer engagement including commercial responsibility (costs and profitability), customer expectations, delivery team success, customer reporting and invoicing
* Achieve customer reference collateral and customer satisfaction responses
* Deliver best through proactive mindset and de\-escalate critical customer situations
* Protect and grow engagement scope and manage commercial change requests
* Participate in team\-internal knowledge sharing and coach other team members
* Expected to spend up to 20% of time onsite at client location


**Education And Qualification / Skills And Competencies**
 WORK EXPERIENCE
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred in Business Administration, Computer Science, Technical Engineering, Economics or related field
* Must have Knowledge of SAP’s cloud business, cloud and hybrid infrastructure and cloud operation processes
* Experienced in IT service providers and managing outsourcing engagements.
* SAP Basis, technology, and/or functional knowledge are very important.
* Technical infrastructure know\-how and technical understanding of virtualized system landscapes is critical for this role.
* Strong SAP technology stack expertise including SAP ECC, S/4HANA, NetWeaver, and SAP Basis administration.
* Experience with SAP HANA and enterprise databases (Oracle, SQL Server, DB2\).
* Knowledge of Linux, Unix, and Windows operating systems supporting SAP environments.
* Experience with hyperscaler platforms such as Microsoft Azure and/or AWS.
* Understanding of cloud and hybrid SAP landscapes, virtualization, and infrastructure architecture.
* Experience with SAP ECS, RISE with SAP, and cloud transformation programs.
* Knowledge of SAP Solution Manager and/or SAP Cloud ALM.
* Experience leading SAP upgrades, migrations, and technical transformation initiatives.
* Strong project management skills \& customer\-facing experience
* Strong ability to translate between technical and non\-tec hnical audience with confidence
* Strong engagement management, relationship building and de\-escalation skills
* Excellent presentation, communication and moderator skills
* High competency in multi\-tasking and ability to manage multiple engagements in parallel
* Accustomed to working in an international and global virtual matrix organization
* High proficiency in English. Additional languages are a big plus
* Knowledge and certifications in standards and methodologies for SAP IT operations (e.g. SAP CCoE, ITIL V4 Foundation or Expert Level, Run SAP standards, Solution Manager ALM) are beneficial.
* Certification in project management methodology (e.g. PMP) is beneficial
* Minimum 4\+ years of experience in project management or SAP Operations
* Minimum 4\+ years of experience in a customer\-facing role
* Minimum 4 to 6 years of experience in service management capacity managing multiple clients.

d958f400.title: Senior / Lead SAP Signavio Architect
d958f400.description:
**Role Summary**


We are seeking an experienced **SAP Signavio Architect** to lead business process transformation, process architecture, and process optimization initiatives using the SAP Signavio Business Transformation Suite.


The successful candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, enterprise architects, SAP functional teams, and transformation leaders to establish process architecture, identify improvement opportunities, and support SAP S/4HANA transformation programs.


The role requires a strong combination of **SAP Signavio expertise, business process management (BPM), process architecture, SAP S/4HANA knowledge, and stakeholder leadership**.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and own the **SAP Signavio architecture and implementation approach** across enterprise transformation programs.
* Design the overall **business process architecture**, including process hierarchy, process taxonomy, standards, governance, and modeling conventions.
* Lead implementation and adoption of relevant SAP Signavio capabilities, including:
* + SAP Signavio Process Manager
	+ SAP Signavio Process Collaboration Hub
	+ SAP Signavio Process Intelligence
	+ SAP Signavio Process Insights
	+ SAP Signavio Journey Modeler
	+ SAP Signavio Process Governance, where applicable
* Establish **end\-to\-end process models** covering areas such as Order\-to\-Cash, Procure\-to\-Pay, Record\-to\-Report, Hire\-to\-Retire, Plan\-to\-Produce, and other enterprise processes.
* Support **SAP S/4HANA transformation programs**, including greenfield, brownfield, and selective transformation scenarios.
* Facilitate process discovery, design, fit\-to\-standard, and process optimization workshops with business and IT stakeholders.
* Define **As\-Is and To\-Be business processes** and identify process gaps, bottlenecks, standardization opportunities, and automation opportunities.
* Leverage process mining and process analytics to identify deviations, inefficiencies, and opportunities for measurable business improvement.
* Define process KPIs and establish mechanisms for continuous process performance monitoring.
* Align business processes with **SAP Best Practices and S/4HANA capabilities**.
* Integrate SAP Signavio into the broader SAP transformation landscape and methodology.
* Collaborate with SAP functional, technical, integration, data, enterprise architecture, and change\-management teams.
* Define governance for process modeling, process ownership, approvals, publishing, and lifecycle management.
* Establish reusable process modeling standards, templates, naming conventions, and documentation guidelines.
* Provide architectural guidance for SAP Signavio integrations and data connectivity with SAP and non\-SAP systems.
* Lead stakeholder presentations and communicate transformation recommendations to senior management.
* Mentor process analysts, business architects, and SAP Signavio consultants.
* Drive SAP Signavio adoption across business and IT teams.

  

**Requirements** **Required Experience \& Skills**

* **10\+ years of overall SAP / Business Process Management / Enterprise Transformation experience.**
* **3\+ years of hands\-on SAP Signavio experience**, preferably in enterprise\-scale transformation programs.
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of SAP Signavio Process Manager and Collaboration Hub.
* Strong experience with **SAP Signavio Process Intelligence and/or Process Insights**.
* Strong understanding of **Business Process Management (BPM), process architecture, process modeling, and process governance**.
* Experience defining enterprise process hierarchies such as **L0–L4/L5 process models**.
* Strong understanding of **BPMN 2\.0** and process modeling standards.
* Good understanding of **SAP S/4HANA business processes and transformation programs**.
* Experience conducting process discovery, fit\-to\-standard, and process design workshops.
* Experience working with cross\-functional SAP processes and multiple business functions.
* Ability to translate business requirements and transformation objectives into scalable process architecture.
* Strong knowledge of process mining concepts, process KPIs, conformance analysis, and root\-cause analysis.
* Experience establishing process governance frameworks and process ownership models.
* Strong stakeholder management and workshop facilitation capabilities.
* Excellent communication, presentation, documentation, and leadership skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* SAP Signavio certification or relevant SAP certifications.
* Experience with **SAP S/4HANA transformation / RISE with SAP programs**.
* Experience with SAP Activate methodology.
* Experience with SAP LeanIX is highly desirable.
* Knowledge of enterprise architecture and business capability modeling.
* Experience integrating SAP Signavio with SAP S/4HANA and other enterprise applications.
* Experience working with large global organizations and multi\-country transformation programs.
* Consulting or system\-integrator experience is an advantage.

**Architecture Responsibilities**


The SAP Signavio Architect will be expected to define and govern:

**Business Architecture**

* Enterprise process hierarchy
* Value chains and value streams
* Business capabilities
* End\-to\-end process architecture
* Process ownership

**Signavio Architecture**

* Workspace structure
* Process modeling standards
* Dictionary and repository structure
* User and access model
* Collaboration approach
* Process governance
* Process lifecycle management
* Process intelligence/mining architecture
* Integration and data requirements

**Transformation Architecture**

* As\-Is To\-Be process transformation
* SAP Best Practice alignment
* Fit\-to\-standard approach
* Process standardization
* Process harmonization
* Process automation opportunities
* Continuous improvement framework

**Key Deliverables**

* SAP Signavio solution architecture
* Enterprise process architecture and hierarchy
* Process modeling standards and governance framework
* As\-Is and To\-Be process models
* Process taxonomy and modeling conventions
* Process mining and intelligence framework
* Process KPI framework
* Process improvement recommendations
* SAP S/4HANA process alignment
* Signavio implementation roadmap
* Adoption and governance model

You leverage your regional network and industry experience to identify local client opportunities, conduct site assessments, and manage client relations. **Rispri Labs handles the heavy lifting behind you.**

* **You bring:** Local client leads, site measurements, and project opportunities.
* **We provide:**
* Full engineering and technical consultancy (P\&IDs, process design, proposal drafting).
* Supply of all treatment chemicals, filtration equipment, plant hardware, and dosing systems.
* Laboratory testing support and analytical backing for client reports.
* **Earnings:** Attractive, transparent incentive\-and\-profit\-sharing model per completed project or ongoing chemical/O\&M supply contract.
