97699778.title: Presales Specialist
97699778.description:
**Presales Consultant (SaaS / IT Services)** 




**Location:** 
 India (Remote / Hybrid)
 



**Experience:** 
 3–5 Years
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Reports to:** 
 Growth Team Leadership
 



**Shift Alignment:** 
 US Shift / Overlapping US Business Hours
 



  





**Job Overview** 




 We are seeking a high\-energy, technically adept
 **Presales Consultant** 
 with 3–5 years of experience in the SaaS or IT Services domain. In this role, you will act as the crucial bridge between our technical capabilities and client requirements, driving technical discovery, solution design, high\-converting demo presentations, and strategic pitch sessions for enterprise prospects.
 



 The ideal candidate possesses a deep understanding of software architectures and cloud solutions, paired with exceptional storyboarding and presentation skills.
 **Prior experience supporting Orals presentations for US State, Local, or Federal Government (GovTech) prospects is highly preferred.** 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Solution Architecture, Storyboarding \& Demonstrations** 



* **Technical Discovery:** 
 Partner with Sales teams to lead discovery calls, unearthing technical pain points, security requirements, and business goals.
* **Deck \& Demo Content Creation:** 
 Build visually compelling, customized slide decks and interactive demo flows tailored to the prospect’s specific pain points and industry context.
* **Tailored Demos:** 
 Work with Product team to prepare and deliver high\-impact product demonstrations that clearly articulate complex technical features into intuitive business value for both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* **Proof of Concept (PoC):** 
 Scope, design, and manage PoCs and technical trials to validate value propositions for prospective clients.



**Pitching \& Orals Support** 



* **Orals Demonstration Support:** 
 Play a pivotal role in preparing for and executing formal "Orals" presentations, especially for competitive enterprise and public sector evaluations.
* **Demo Environment Preparation:** 
 Configure and maintain realistic, tailored demo environments that simulate real\-world customer workflows and showcase key differentiators during live presentations.
* **GovTech Alignment:** 
 Tailor presentation narratives and technical slide decks to align with US public sector priorities, compliance nuances, and procurement expectations.



**Strategic Collaboration** 



* **Product Feedback Loop:** 
 Act as the voice of the customer by providing structured feedback from sales presentations to Product and Engineering teams to help shape the product roadmap.
* **Cross\-Functional Alignment:** 
 Work closely with Professional Services and Customer Success teams to ensure a seamless handover post\-sale.



  





**Requirements \& Qualifications** 



* **Experience:** 
 3–5 years of hands\-on experience as a Presales Consultant, Solution Architect, or Technical Sales Engineer in B2B SaaS or IT Services.
* **Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* **GovTech / Orals Experience (Preferred):** 
 Track record of supporting live Orals presentations, pitch defense sessions, or shortlist demos for US State/Local/Federal government or enterprise deals.
* **Technical \& Deck Building Skills:**
* Proficiency in creating clean, visual, and narrative\-driven pitch decks (PowerPoint, Google Slides).
* Strong technical foundation in cloud architectures (AWS, Azure, GCP), REST APIs, integrations, and enterprise SaaS deployment models.
* Familiarity with data security, compliance standards (e.g., SOC2, FedRAMP, HIPAA), and identity management (SSO, SAML).
* **Communication Skills:** 
 Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to confidently present to C\-suite executives, public sector evaluation committees, and technical teams.
* **Schedule Flexibility:** 
 Willingness to work overlapping hours with US time zones (EST).

090dc78b.title: Lead I - Cloud Infrastructure Services
090dc78b.description:
**Role description**  


### **Lead I – Cloud Infrastructure (AWS \& DevOps)**


**Role Summary**  

Seeking a Cloud Infrastructure Lead with strong expertise in AWS, Jenkins CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and cloud operations. The role focuses on designing, implementing, and managing scalable, secure, and highly available cloud environments while driving DevOps best practices and mentoring engineering teams.


### **Key Responsibilities**


* Design, implement, and manage secure, scalable, and resilient AWS cloud infrastructure.
* Develop and optimize end\-to\-end CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, with strong expertise in Declarative Pipelines.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar).
* Manage application deployments, scaling, performance optimization, and cloud operations across AWS services.
* Collaborate with development, security, and architecture teams to enable seamless cloud integration.
* Implement monitoring, logging, ing, and observability solutions to ensure platform reliability and performance.
* Enforce cloud security, governance, compliance, and operational best practices.
* Lead incident management, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and operational runbooks.
* Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership across cloud and DevOps initiatives.
* Support capacity planning, disaster recovery, backup, and business continuity strategies.
* Evaluate emerging AWS technologies and drive cloud modernization efforts.

### **Required Skills**


* Strong hands\-on experience with AWS cloud services and infrastructure management.
* Expertise in Jenkins CI/CD and Declarative Pipeline development.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, etc.).
* Proficiency in Shell, Python, or PowerShell scripting.
* Hands\-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and Amazon EKS.
* Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as CloudWatch, ELK, Prometheus, and Grafana.
* Strong understanding of IAM, networking, security, and compliance best practices.
* Excellent troubleshooting, communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.

### **Preferred Certifications**


* AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate/Professional)
* AWS Certified DevOps Engineer

### **Leadership Expectations**


* Lead cloud infrastructure and DevOps transformation initiatives.
* Drive automation, operational excellence, and platform reliability.
* Mentor team members and promote cloud and DevOps best practices.
* Partner with business and technology stakeholders to deliver secure, scalable cloud solutions.


**Experience:** 10\+ years overall experience with strong AWS, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and cloud infrastructure leadership exposure.

  


  

**Skills**  

AWS, Jenkins, CI/CD, AWS IAM

 **About UST**  

UST is a global digital transformation solutions provider. For more than 20 years, UST has worked side by side with the world’s best companies to make a real impact through transformation. Powered by technology, inspired by people and led by purpose, UST partners with their clients from design to operation. With deep domain expertise and a future\-proof philosophy, UST embeds innovation and agility into their clients’ organizations. With over 30,000 employees in 30 countries, UST builds for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process.

ef48cea0.title: Manager - Cloud Data Platform Operations
ef48cea0.description:
**About Northern Trust**

  

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.  



  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.  



  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.  



  

  

**Position Overview**
---------------------


The *Manager, Cloud Data Platform* Operations is responsible for the operational management, reliability, security, governance, and continuous improvement of enterprise cloud data platforms, with primary ownership of Snowflake, Databricks, and other cloud data services. The role leads a team of platform engineers and operations specialists to deliver highly available, secure, scalable, and cost\-efficient data services supporting analytics, AI/ML, business intelligence, and enterprise data initiatives.


This position serves as the primary operational leader for cloud data platforms, driving service excellence, operational governance, platform stability, stakeholder engagement, and executive reporting. The role is accountable for providing leadership with actionable operational insights, platform health metrics, risk assessments, capacity forecasts, and service performance reviews to support strategic decision\-making.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Platform Operations \& Service Ownership**

* Own end\-to\-end operational support for Snowflake, Databricks, and other cloud data services.
* Ensure platform availability, performance, reliability, scalability, and operational stability.
* Lead Incident, Problem, Change, Capacity, and Availability Management processes.
* Establish operational standards, runbooks, support procedures, and service management frameworks.
* Drive operational readiness for platform upgrades, releases, and new service deployments.
* Ensure adherence to enterprise security, governance, compliance, and risk management requirements.

### **Reliability Engineering \& Operational Excellence**

* Define, measure, and report platform SLAs, SLOs, and operational KPIs.
* Lead major incident management, root cause analysis, and continuous service improvement initiatives.
* Drive automation and self\-healing capabilities to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual intervention.
* Partner with engineering and architecture teams to enhance platform resiliency, performance, and scalability.
* Ensure disaster recovery, backup, and business continuity strategies are regularly tested and maintained.

### **Executive Reporting \& Operational Metrics**

* Develop and present monthly and quarterly operational reviews to senior leadership.
* Create executive dashboards and scorecards covering:
	+ Platform Availability \& Uptime
	+ Service Health \& Incident Trends
	+ MTTR (Mean Time to Resolution)
	+ SLA/SLO Compliance
	+ Capacity \& Performance Utilization
	+ Platform Adoption \& Consumption Trends
	+ Cost \& Resource Optimization
	+ Security \& Compliance Metrics
	+ Support Backlog \& Service Request Metrics
	+ Customer Satisfaction Metrics
* Provide actionable recommendations based on operational trends, risks, and business needs.

### **Stakeholder \& Vendor Management**

* Build strong partnerships with Data Engineering, Architecture, Security, Infrastructure, Analytics, and Business teams.
* Act as the operational escalation point for critical service issues.
* Manage relationships with strategic platform vendors including Snowflake, and Databricks.
* Drive customer\-focused service improvements and operational maturity initiatives.

### **People Leadership**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a high\-performing Cloud Data Platform Operations organisation.
* Establish team objectives, performance expectations, and development plans.
* Support talent acquisition, succession planning, and capability development.
* Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and operational excellence.

### **Qualifications**

### **Education \& Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or related field (Master’s preferred).
* 10\+ years of experience in data engineering, cloud engineering, or platform engineering with 15\+ years of total work experience, including Azure and/or AWS environments.
* 5\+ years of leadership experience managing Platform Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure, or Operations Teams.
* Proven experience managing enterprise\-scale cloud data platforms, specifically:
	+ Snowflake
	+ Databricks
	+ Other Data Platform services
* Strong experience leading ITIL service management functions, including Incident, Problem, Change, and Service Request Management.
* Experience building and presenting executive operational dashboards and service reviews.
* Proven track record of driving platform reliability, operational transformation, and automation initiatives.
* Experience managing globally distributed teams and complex enterprise environments.
* Hands\-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS or Azure) and Cloud Data Services.
* Experience with big data and data processing frameworks (e.g., Spark, Databricks, Flink).
* Expertise in building data pipelines with tools like Apache Airflow, dbt, Kafka, or similar.

### **Skills \& Competencies:**

* In\-depth knowledge and experience with Snowflake, Databricks, or similar cloud data platforms.
* Extensive knowledge and real hands\-on experience on Github terraform pipelines and objects deployment management.
* Extensive knowledge and real hands\-on experience of AI/ML data pipelines and feature engineering.
* Exposure to regulated environments (financial services, healthcare, etc.).
* Proficiency in terraform, SQL and one or more programming languages (Python, Java, or Scala).
* Deep understanding of cloud\-native data services (e.g., AWS Redshift, Glue, S3, Athena; Azure Synapse, Data Factory; GCP BigQuery, Dataflow).
* Familiarity with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi).
* Knowledge of FinOps principles for cost\-efficient data platform design.
* Strong problem\-solving, communication, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* Excellent communication, mentorship, and ability to influence cross\-functional teams.

**Key Success Metrics**
-----------------------

* Snowflake, Databricks, and Microsoft Fabric platforms consistently achieve reliability and performance targets.
* Executive leadership receives timely, accurate, and actionable operational insights.
* Reduced service disruptions, lower operational risk, and improved customer experience.
* Increased automation, operational efficiency, and service maturity.
* High\-performing teams delivering resilient, secure, and scalable data platform
* Reduced data incidents and faster root‑cause resolution.
* Improved developer productivity through reusable frameworks and standards.
* Strong technical mentorship and uplift of data engineering capabilities.
* Trusted technical advisor to architecture, security, and business leadership.

 **Working with Us**

  

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.  



  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.  



  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

  

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.  

  



  

**About Our Pune Office**

  

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.

  

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000\+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

 AI Infrastructure Architect \- Manager
   

  

**Practice Overview**
**Skill / Operating Group**
 Technology Consulting \- AI Infrastructure Advisory
   

  

**Level**
 Manager
   

  

**Location**
 Gurugram / Mumbai / Bangalore / Pune / Kolkata
   

  

**Travel**
 Expected travel could be anywhere between 0–100%
   

  

**Why Technology Consulting**
 The Technology Consulting business within Global Network invents the future for clients by providing them with the right guidance, design thinking and innovative solutions for technological transformation. Specialise in AI infrastructure consulting to transform the world’s leading organisations by: Helping Clients rethink their AI compute, networking, retrieval, and agent orchestration layers to scale enterprise AI reliably. Enhancing your Skillset with hyperscaler AI infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP), Kubernetes, Terraform, MLOps/LLMOps tooling, and agentic AI architecture. Transforming Businesses by designing next\-generation AI infrastructure foundations that move clients from AI pilots to enterprise\-scale production deployments.
   

  

**Overview**
**Principal Duties \& Responsibilities**
 Design and deliver end\-to\-end AI infrastructure architecture for enterprise clients \- setting the architecture vision for compute, networking, retrieval, agent orchestration, and the tooling layers that underpin every AI and agentic workload.
   

  

 Serve as the trusted technical advisor to client architects and technology leads on AI infrastructure decisions, translating architectural choices into clear trade\-offs across cost, performance, scalability, and security.
   

  

 This is a design and architecture role, not a hands\-on build role. The mandate is to define standards, reference architectures, and governance frameworks that engineering teams implement.
   

  

 This role focuses on AI infrastructure, platform engineering, governance, and architecture. It does not focus on model development, prompt engineering, model fine\-tuning, or AI application development. Applications from AI Engineers, Prompt Engineers, or ML practitioners without infrastructure architecture experience are unlikely to be a strong fit.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* AI Compute \& Infrastructure Architecture
* Design cloud AI infrastructure for enterprise workloads \- GPU/CPU compute, Kubernetes (AKS, EKS, GKE), managed ML compute, networking, identity, and security across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Define reference architecture for AI Center of Excellence infrastructure \- model hosting, agent environments, and the compute and networking beneath them.
* Architect compute strategy \- GPU SKU selection, GPU economics and capacity planning, provisioned vs pay\-as\-you\-go inference, and shared vs dedicated capacity models.
* Design AI\-specific landing zones with network isolation, private connectivity for AI services, and AI guardrails at the workload boundary.
* AI Platform Architecture
* Design enterprise AI platform architectures using Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, and GCP Vertex AI.
* Define model catalog governance, model lifecycle management, platform operating models, and AI self\-service enablement patterns.
* Architect integration patterns between Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, and GCP Vertex AI and the underlying Kubernetes (AKS / EKS / GKE) compute and networking infrastructure.
* Inference Layer Architecture
* Architect model serving strategy across managed cloud endpoints and self\-hosted inference (e.g. vLLM/Triton on GPU\-backed Kubernetes) \- right pattern per use case.
* Design inference routing \- model fallback chains, multi\-model routing, and load balancing across provisioned and on\-demand deployments.
* Define latency and throughput architecture for real\-time and batch inference, including token\-level latency budgets and streaming response design.
* Architect inference\-layer caching \- prompt caching and semantic caching to reduce redundant model calls and control token economics and cost.
* Retrieval / RAG Architecture
* Design vector database architecture for RAG \- select and size across cloud AI search, vector\-enabled databases, and dedicated vector stores based on scale and latency needs.
* Architect embedding pipeline infrastructure \- embedding model selection, reindexing strategy, and compute/storage patterns for chunking at enterprise scale.
* Define hybrid search architecture (vector, keyword, metadata filtering) and the infrastructure to support it at scale.
* Architect multi\-tenant vector store isolation \- ensuring one business unit’s embedded data cannot leak into another’s retrieval results through index\- and access\-level boundaries.
* Design knowledge graph and GraphRAG infrastructure \- graph database hosting and its integration pattern with the vector retrieval layer.
* Agentic \& Tool Calling Architecture
* Architect tool calling infrastructure \- how agents securely discover, authenticate to, and invoke internal APIs, MCP servers, and third\-party connectors.
* Design MCP server hosting and governance \- versioning, security, and reuse across agents and business units.
* Define the integration security boundary \- scoped credentials, rate limiting per agent\-to\-tool call, and audit logging of every tool invocation.
* Architect agent runtime environments for agent orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI) on Kubernetes or serverless containers.
* Design multi\-agent orchestration infrastructure, including agent\-to\-agent communication patterns and short\-term/long\-term agent memory storage.
* Identity, Access \& AI Governance Architecture
* Define identity architecture for AI workloads \- Managed Identity strategy for model access and RBAC for AI resource governance.
* Design private connectivity for AI services \- ensuring inference traffic does not traverse the public internet.
* Architect network segmentation between inference, training, and agent orchestration workloads.
* Design infrastructure\-level Responsible AI controls and AI guardrails \- content filtering integration points, prompt\-injection mitigation, and data residency controls.
* Define model governance standards \- model registry architecture, version control, promotion gates, and audit trails for deployed models and agents.
* Resilience, Scalability \& Cost Optimisation
* Design multi\-region resilience patterns for AI workloads \- endpoint failover, model endpoint high availability, and project replication.
* Architect autoscaling for inference workloads, accounting for GPU cost sensitivity and cold\-start latency.
* Define capacity and quota management across subscriptions for shared AI services.
* Apply Well\-Architected cost optimisation principles to AI infrastructure \- rightsizing compute, reserved capacity planning, GPU utilisation efficiency, and token\-level consumption awareness.
* AI Observability, Governance \& MLOps Architecture
* Define the technical governance framework \- model registry architecture, endpoint lifecycle management, and model governance standards for deployed models and agents.
* Architect the MLOps/LLMOps foundation \- CI/CD for model and agent deployment using Terraform and native hyperscaler tooling, prompt versioning, and evaluation pipelines.
* Design AI observability architecture \- token usage, per\-inference latency, model drift signals, GPU utilisation monitoring, and hallucination\-tracking hooks.
* Define enterprise standards for how agents are hosted, secured, and connected to systems.
* Provide architecture design review for AI use cases proposed by business units, ensuring infrastructure is scalable, reusable, and aligned to enterprise standards.
* Track hyperscaler AI roadmaps (AWS, Azure, GCP) and proactively incorporate emerging capabilities into the reference architecture.


**Practice Building**
* Codify methods and frameworks into reusable AI infrastructure assets for use across engagements.
* Create differentiated infrastructure offerings, accelerators, and reference implementations.
* Mentor team members in AI infrastructure architecture.
* Support engagement budgets, forecasting, and financial proposals.


**Qualifications**
**Qualifications \& Certifications**
**Educational Background**
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline. A Master’s degree is preferred.
   

  

**Mandatory**
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, OR
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ\-305\), OR
* Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect


**Preferred**
* AWS Machine Learning Specialty, OR Azure AI Engineer Associate, OR Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer
* Azure OpenAI Service / AWS Bedrock / GCP Vertex AI specialisation


**Key Competencies \& Skills**
**Competencies**
**FUNCTIONAL COMPETENCIES**
* Technical stakeholder advisory \- advise client architects and technology leads on AI infrastructure strategy and architectural trade\-offs.
* Architecture strategy and roadmap development \- assess current\-state environments, identify gaps, define target\-state designs, and build pragmatic modernisation roadmaps.
* Structured problem\-solving under ambiguity \- frame AI infrastructure challenges, evaluate trade\-offs, and produce actionable recommendations.
* Practice building \- codify expertise into reusable frameworks, accelerators, and playbooks.


**TECHNICAL COMPETENCIES**
* Hyperscaler AI infrastructure \- deep expertise in at least one of: AWS (Bedrock, SageMaker, EKS, EC2 GPU), Azure (AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure ML, AKS), or GCP (Vertex AI, Gemini, GKE, Cloud Run). Working knowledge of a second hyperscaler is a strong advantage.
* AI platform architecture \- Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex AI; model catalog governance, lifecycle management, and self\-service enablement patterns.
* Container orchestration \- Kubernetes (AKS, EKS, GKE), Docker, and cloud\-native infrastructure design for AI workloads.
* Infrastructure as code \- Terraform, Ansible, and native hyperscaler IaC tooling; able to set IaC governance standards.
* Inference layer architecture \- model serving, routing, caching, latency budgets, and cost optimisation for real\-time and batch inference.
* Retrieval and RAG architecture \- vector databases, embedding infrastructure, hybrid search, GraphRAG, and multi\-tenant isolation at enterprise scale.
* Agentic architecture \- tool calling infrastructure, MCP server hosting, agent orchestration frameworks, multi\-agent systems, and agent memory patterns.
* MLOps/LLMOps architecture \- CI/CD for models, pipeline automation, model versioning, model governance, and evaluation pipelines.
* AI governance and Responsible AI \- model governance frameworks, AI guardrails, Managed Identity, RBAC, private connectivity, and Responsible AI controls as applied to AI workloads.
* AI observability \- token usage monitoring, per\-inference latency, model drift signals, GPU utilisation tracking, and cost attribution.
* Cloud cost optimisation \- Well\-Architected cost principles applied to AI workloads; compute rightsizing, reserved capacity, GPU utilisation efficiency, and consumption governance.
* AI Compute Infrastructure \- familiarity with NVIDIA GPU ecosystem, NVIDIA NIM, DGX platforms, GPU sizing strategies, AI accelerator technologies, and enterprise AI deployment patterns.


**Additional Information**
**Equal Opportunities**
 Accenture is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all sections of society and does not discriminate on grounds of race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

ddac7269.description:

**Durée du contrat :**  

Orange Business is here!
  
About usJoin us at Orange Business!
  
We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.
  
Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.
  
About the role
  
  

**Mission / Role Purpose:**  

The IT Asset Management (ITAM) Specialist is responsible for overseeing the full lifecycle of IT assets—both hardware (HAM) and software (SAM)across on\-premise, cloud, and hybrid environments. This role is critical in ensuring compliance, driving cost optimization, supporting vendor audits, managing licensing contracts, and integrating governance frameworks for enterprise\-wide asset visibility and control.
  
  

**Key Responsibilities:****Hardware Asset Management (HAM):**  

* As HAM Specialist , you would be responsible for managing IT Asset in Multicloud Environments
* Youwould be responsible for managing the lifecycle of IT hardware assets deployed across Azure, SecNumCloud\-compliant platforms, and other multi cloud or hybrid infrastructures.
* This role plays a key part in ensuring compliance with vendor requirements, optimizing cloud\-hosted asset usage, and maintaining governance across geographically distributed IT environments.
* You will collaborate with infrastructure, cloud, security, procurement, and compliance teams to enable effective visibility, lifecycle management, and financial control of virtual and physical infrastructure resources supporting business\-critical services.
* Maintain inventory and metadata of all hardware assets supporting Azure\-hosted and SecNumCloud\-certified environments (servers, appliances, firewalls, etc.).
* Ensure accurate tracking of cloud\-hosted physical assets provisioned by IaaS/PaaS providers across Azure, SecNumCloud, Bleu, Flexible Engine, and others.
* Support asset tagging, classification, and location mapping in alignment with regulatory (ANSSI, GDPR) and internal security policies.
* Partner with cloud operations to map physical hosting of virtual machines and containers to underlying assets for lifecycle governance.
* Oversee procurement, deployment, maintenance, and decommissioning of hardware used in cloud infrastructure (private racks, cloud interconnect, storage appliances).
* Track and manage hardware warranties, maintenance contracts, and refresh cycles to ensure uptime and optimal performance.
* Ensure compliance with group policies related to SecNumCloud and sovereign cloud obligations, including approved suppliers and contract restrictions.
* Coordinate hardware audits and ensure readiness for regulatory inspections (SecNumCloud, ISO/IEC 27001, etc.).
* Analyze usage data and cloud\-native metrics (e.g., Azure Cost Management, Log Analytics) to correlate hardware asset demand and optimize procurement plans.
* Identify opportunities for hardware reuse or redistribution across private cloud, DR, and backup zones to reduce CAPEX/OPEX.
* Develop and maintain dashboards (e.g., Power BI, ServiceNow HAM) to monitor asset compliance, utilization, and risk status.
* Collaborate with finance and procurement teams for budgeting, forecasting, and chargeback reporting.
* Act as the HAM point of contact for cloud infrastructure projects (including private and sovereign cloud deployments).
* Maintain interfaces between HAM tools and ITSM/CMDB platforms to ensure real\-time visibility and data integrity.
* Drive adoption of automation tools and scripts for asset onboarding, reconciliation, and reporting
* Maintain an accurate inventory of IT hardware assets across data centers, offices, and remote sites.
* Oversee hardware lifecycle processes: procurement, deployment, maintenance, decommissioning, and disposal.
* Optimize asset utilization and refresh strategies to reduce total cost of ownership (TCO).
* Manage warranty and support contracts, ensuring timely renewals and alignment with service coverage.
* Collaborate with infrastructure and procurement teams to align IT hardware with operational and budget needs.


**Software Asset Management (SAM):**  

* Manage and maintain the software asset repository and inventory across all platforms (on\-premises and cloud).
* Track software license purchases, entitlements, and deployments to ensure compliance and cost\-effectiveness.
* Collaborate with procurement, IT, legal, and finance teams to validate software contracts, renewals, and license metrics.
* Conduct regular audits and assessments of software usage to identify underutilized licenses and recommend reharvesting opportunities.
* Monitor and report on software compliance risks, usage trends, and optimization opportunities.
* Support vendor audits and internal controls by providing data and documentation as needed.
* Lead or contribute to the implementation of SAM tools (e.g., Flexera, ServiceNow, Snow, or equivalent).
* Establish and maintain SAM policies, procedures, and standards aligned with ITIL best practices.
* Liaise with stakeholders to educate on license compliance, contractual obligations, and cost\-saving strategies.
* Implement and govern software license lifecycle practices from procurement to retirement.
* Ensure compliance with license agreements and vendor terms (Microsoft, Oracle, Salesforce, Adobe, etc.).
* Analyze usage data to identify optimization and re\-harvesting opportunities.
* Lead internal readiness for vendor audits, license reconciliation, and contract renewal planning.
* Support cloud subscription optimization (SaaS, PaaS, IaaS) and hybrid environment licensing.
* Interpret licensing contracts and map usage for cost\-effective renewals.
* Work with Procurement, Legal, Finance, and IT to ensure alignment of contract obligations and deployment.
* Implement and maintain SAM/HAM tools
* Contribute to automation of license tracking, compliance reporting, and cost analytics.
* Provide dashboards and reporting on compliance status, usage, and financial risks.


About you
  
  

**Required Skills \& Experience:**  

* 3–7 years of experience in IT Asset Management (HAM \& SAM).
* Proven track record with enterprise software licensing with some key Software Editors (ServiceNow , PEGA , Cienna , CSG , Splunk , Salesforce , Microsoft MCA /EA, Oracle , Adobe, etc.).
* Strong knowledge of any of the ITAM tools: ServiceNow, Flexera, Snow, SCCM, OpenText, Lansweeper.
* Hands\-on experience in vendor audit preparation, license optimization, and IT contract negotiation.
* Deep understanding of ITIL, ISO/IEC 19770, FinOps, and cloud cost management principles.
* Experience managing physical IT assets in global enterprise environments.
* Behavioral:
* Strong analytical, communication, and negotiation skills.
* High attention to detail with data\-driven problem\-solving ability.
* Strong stakeholder engagement across technical and business teams.
* Ownership mindset with ability to lead initiatives and manage ambiguity.
* Ability to balance priorities and adapt to evolving business requirements.


·
  
  

* Preferred Certifications:
* CSAM (Certified Software Asset Manager)
* CHAMP (Certified Hardware Asset Management Professional)
* ITIL v4 Foundation
* FinOps Practitioner
* ServiceNow SAM Pro Certification


You bring open mindedness, ability to handle pressure, leading with courage and empathy, assertiveness and communicate effectively.
  
  

What we offer

8292473d.description:
**About Rippling**
 Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
   

  

 Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
   

  

 Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.8B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
   

  

 We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a highly accomplished Technical Program Manager (TPM) — at the Staff level — to play a pivotal role in spearheading our product development and geographic expansion initiatives. This strategic role requires a deep technical background to effectively partner with product managers and engineering managers, providing technical leadership to own the execution plan and deliver complex, cross\-team engineering initiatives. You will be the champion for predictable and timely delivery, able to take ownership of and drive the mitigation of risks to the program, and skilled in facilitating quantifiable success across diverse engineering and product teams. Your core responsibility is to ensure the predictable delivery of products by actively engaging in technical discussions, identifying and proactively resolving dependencies and technical blockers, mitigating architectural risks, and applying best\-in\-class program management practices.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 Technical Strategy \& Planning
   

  

* Drive strategic, cross\-functional planning and prioritization, partnering with Product and Engineering leadership to develop comprehensive program plans, including roadmap definition, dependency mapping, and resourcing models.
* Drive the process of translating high\-level business and product requirements into actionable, concrete engineering tasks, milestones, and technical specifications.
* Contribute to the definition and tracking of effective technical metrics, driving improvements that optimize engineering operating performance and system health.


 Technical Execution \& Delivery
   

  

* Lead and facilitate regular program\-level meetings and reviews with Product and Engineering leadership to ensure projects achieve successful outcomes.
* Proactively monitor program health, tracking status, risks, issues, and complex technical dependencies across engineering teams.
* Deep dive into technical issues to facilitate resolution, and drive appropriate executive\-level escalations and program\-level change management processes as\-needed.
* Take personal ownership of engineering roadblocks and technical delays, escalating issues appropriately and driving them to timely closure by working directly with engineering leads.


 Process \& Communication
   

  

* Manage high\-level program communications, ensuring all stakeholders—from delivery teams to executive management—are consistently informed of roadmap changes, release plans, and delivery status, with a clear explanation of technical trade\-offs and risks.
* Establish, document, and champion the adoption of new program frameworks, tools, and best practices across the R\&D organization.
* Act as an agent of change, helping to establish and strengthen the Technical Program Management function across the company.


**Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of experience as TPM, Engineering Lead, Manager, or equivalent working directly with software engineering teams.
* Proven track record to communicate technical issues effectively to technical and non\-technical partners at different levels of the organization.

 As a Technical Program Manager for Amazon Global Logistics (AGL), you'll lead complex cross\-organizational initiatives that revolutionize e\-commerce through innovative global logistics solutions. You'll drive programs that help break down barriers for selling partners, enabling them to reach hundreds of millions of customers worldwide through our highly\-available, scalable distributed systems.

* Lead and manage complex technical programs across multiple engineering teams and stakeholders
* Design and implement sustainable processes for cross\-functional program management
* Drive development of software solutions that optimize global fulfillment and cross\-border selling
* Establish and track key performance indicators (KPIs) and service level agreements (SLAs)

* Coordinate release schedules and ensure successful delivery of technical solutions

 A day in the life
   

  

 Your day might start with a strategic planning session with engineering teams, followed by coordination meetings with cross\-functional stakeholders. You'll spend time analyzing program metrics, identifying potential risks, and developing mitigation strategies. You'll collaborate with global teams to remove friction points in our fulfillment processes and work on innovative solutions to enhance the selling partner experience.

 The Amazon Global Logistics team is committed to creating the world's most efficient global logistics solutions. We offer comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage, parental leave options, paid time off, and a 401(k) plan. Our inclusive culture values diverse perspectives and encourages innovation. bfe75c21.title: Principal Solution Architect- Managed Services
bfe75c21.description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Principal Solution Architect \- Managed Services based in India.**
 This is a senior technical leadership role focused on designing and operating large\-scale, cloud\-native data platforms for global enterprise clients.
   

  

 You will combine deep data engineering expertise with strategic consulting and hands\-on architectural leadership.
   

  

 The role spans modern data ecosystems across Snowflake, AWS, Azure, Databricks, and a broad range of integration and orchestration technologies.
   

  

 You will translate complex business requirements into secure, scalable, and high\-performing platform architectures while driving measurable client outcomes.
   

  

 As a trusted technical advisor, you will work directly with senior stakeholders, lead architecture discussions, and influence long\-term data platform strategies.
   

  

 You will also mentor engineering teams and contribute to reusable frameworks, accelerators, and managed\-services best practices.
   

  

 This opportunity is ideal for an experienced cloud data leader who thrives in complex client environments and enjoys combining architecture, delivery, and technical innovation.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Own the architecture, provisioning, operationalisation, and continuous improvement of cloud\-native data platforms across AWS, Azure, and modern data ecosystems.
* Translate complex client requirements into scalable, secure, reliable, and high\-performing data platform architectures.
* Lead the design and delivery of solutions leveraging technologies such as Snowflake, Fivetran, dbt, Matillion, Azure Data Factory, and other modern data\-stack platforms.
* Manage multiple client engagements and technical environments simultaneously, ensuring delivery remains on time, within scope, and aligned with measurable business outcomes.
* Analyse complex customer environments, define and prioritise Epics, Stories, and Tasks, and drive initiatives that mature and improve data platforms.
* Identify opportunities to automate, optimise, modernise, and expand client platform capabilities and managed\-service offerings.
* Lead technical teams responsible for modern data platforms spanning data warehouses, data lakes, streaming, analytics, and distributed data technologies.
* Provide technical leadership during client workshops, discovery sessions, architecture reviews, and solution\-design discussions.
* Advise clients on technology selection and architecture decisions with a focus on performance, security, scalability, reliability, and user experience.
* Establish high\-quality engineering standards through code reviews, technical documentation, governance, performance tuning, and operational best practices.
* Act as a trusted advisor to senior and executive client stakeholders, helping shape data\-platform roadmaps and long\-term strategic initiatives.
* Mentor and coach engineers, delegate effectively, and foster a culture of technical excellence, learning, feedback, and continuous improvement.
* Partner with practice and account leadership to identify opportunities for engagement expansion and standardise successful delivery patterns.
* Contribute to internal intellectual property, accelerators, delivery frameworks, technical playbooks, and reusable engineering assets.
* Lead detailed technical presentations and architecture recommendations for both technical and executive audiences.
* Represent the organisation professionally in all client interactions and communicate effectively with stakeholders across different levels and functions.


**Requirements**
* 10\+ years of experience in data platform engineering, architecture, managed services, or related technical disciplines, with substantial hands\-on experience in enterprise cloud environments.
* Advanced expertise in cloud data platforms, particularly Snowflake, AWS, Azure, and/or Databricks.
* Extensive experience architecting and providing operational guidance for enterprise cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake and/or Amazon Redshift.
* Strong production experience with cloud and distributed data\-storage technologies, including S3, ADLS, Cassandra, or comparable NoSQL platforms.
* Hands\-on experience with modern data integration and streaming technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Matillion, Fivetran, HVR, AWS Database Migration Service, Azure Data Factory, or equivalent platforms.
* Strong knowledge of workflow orchestration technologies such as Airflow, AWS Managed Airflow, or Luigi.
* Advanced SQL skills, including the ability to write, debug, optimise, and troubleshoot complex queries.
* Extensive experience with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, CloudFormation, or comparable technologies.
* Experience developing automation for repetitive administrative and operational tasks using Python or a similar programming language.
* Strong understanding of CI/CD practices and experience with tools such as Bitbucket, GitHub, Flyway, and Liquibase.
* Exceptional troubleshooting and performance\-tuning skills across complex, multi\-technology environments.
* Demonstrated experience delivering projects for external clients within professional services, consulting, managed services, or similar environments.
* Ability to break complex technical and business problems into structured, actionable solutions and drive them through to resolution.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, including the ability to create and deliver technical presentations to executive audiences.
* Proven experience as a technical team lead, including mentoring, coaching, delegation, and engineering talent development.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively across distributed, cross\-functional, and geographically diverse teams.
* Strong ownership and organisational skills, with a proven ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high\-quality outcomes with minimal supervision.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguous and fast\-paced environments while proactively identifying opportunities to improve processes and technical solutions.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Snowflake SnowPro Core or Advanced Certification is preferred.
* Experience with data visualisation tools and exposure to data science or machine\-learning platform operations is an advantage.
* Experience across multiple industries or business domains within managed services or platform operations is desirable.
* Previous experience working with global or remote teams across US, LATAM, and/or India time zones is a plus.
* Contributions to open\-source projects, technical publications, conference presentations, or internal technical accelerators are valued.


**Benefits**
* Remote\-first working environment for candidates based in India.
* Opportunity to work with a globally distributed team across India, Latin America, and the United States.
* Exposure to large\-scale enterprise data and AI transformation initiatives across multiple industries.
* Opportunity to work with leading cloud and data technologies including Snowflake, AWS, Azure, Databricks, Fivetran, dbt, and modern AI platforms.
* Medical insurance coverage for employees and their families.
* Medical insurance coverage for parents.
* Term life insurance and personal accident coverage.
* Wellness allowance.
* Broadband reimbursement.
* Continuous learning and professional development opportunities.
* Paid professional certifications to support technical growth.
* Professional development allowance.
* Bonuses for creating approved technical or thought\-leadership content.
* Access to challenging client engagements and opportunities to influence enterprise data strategies.
* Strong opportunities for mentorship, technical leadership, and long\-term career development.
* Flexible working environment designed to support collaboration across global time zones.
* Opportunity to contribute to technical accelerators, reusable frameworks, and internal intellectual property.

73b0fdc3.title: Hosting Architect
73b0fdc3.description:
**Job Overview**
 The Hosting Architect will lead Fortrea’s enterprise transition from on premises datacenters to Hyperscaler, delivering a modern, resilient, and automated hosting platform that accelerates application delivery and business innovation. This role owns the target state Azure and hybrid hosting architecture, governs large scale cloud migration, and modernizes operations through automation, Infrastructure as Code, and AI driven operations. The objective is to increase speed to market, reduce operational friction, improve resiliency, and lower total cost of ownership. This is a hands\-on senior architecture role with accountability for measurable business and operational outcomes, operating in a regulated enterprise environment.
   

  

**Summary Of Responsibilities**
**Cloud Migration \& Hybrid Architecture**
* Define and own Fortrea’s target‑state Cloud hosting architecture aligned to business and technology strategy.
* Design and govern hybrid architectures during phased migration from on‑premises to Cloud.
* Lead workload migration strategies (rehost, re‑platform, refactor, retire) to balance speed, risk, and value.
* Act as the architectural authority for hosting and Cloud migration decisions.


**Cloud Platform \& Cloud‑Native Enablement**
* Architect Cloud platforms including landing zones, identity, networking, security, HA, and DR.
* Establish standardised Cloud reference architectures and blueprints to accelerate application onboarding.
* Enable self‑service, repeatable platforms that reduce delivery lead time for application and product teams.
* Drive adoption of cloud‑native services to simplify operations and improve scalability and cost efficiency.


**Automation, IaC \& AI‑Led Operations**
* Implement an automation‑first operating model across hybrid and Cloud environments.
* Build and govern Infrastructure‑as‑Code using Terraform, ARM/Bicep, PowerShell, Python, or Ansible.
* Introduce AIOps and intelligent automation for predictive monitoring, self‑healing, and faster incident resolution.
* Reduce environment provisioning time, manual effort, and operational cost through standardisation and automation.


**Operational Excellence, Resilience \& Governance**
* Embed resiliency, observability, and reliability engineering into all hosting designs.
* Improve platform availability, reduce incidents, and optimise recovery objectives (RTO/RPO).
* Ensure hosting platforms meet security, audit, and regulatory requirements.
* Provide architectural leadership across infrastructure, application, security, and compliance teams.


**Value \& Outcomes**
**The Hosting Architect Is Accountable For Delivering**
* Faster and safer Cloud migration at enterprise scale.
* Reduced time‑to‑provision and change lead times for applications.
* Improved platform reliability, availability, and recovery performance.
* Measurable reduction in hosting OPEX through automation and cloud optimisation.
* Hosting platforms that accelerate business capability delivery, not constrain it.


**Qualifications (Minimum Required)**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* Excellent communication and public speaking skills, with the ability to present complex architectural concepts to senior leadership, technical teams, and non‑technical stakeholders.


**Core Experience**
**Required skills (Minimum Required):**
* 10\+ years in hosting, infrastructure, or cloud architecture roles.
* Proven leadership of large‑scale Cloud migration programs.
* Strong foundation in enterprise datacentre technologies and hybrid architectures.


**Cloud \& Cloud Expertise**
* Deep hands‑on experience with Cloud compute, networking, storage, identity, and security.
* Experience designing hybrid connectivity and phased migration strategies.
* Cloud architecture and/or security certifications preferred.


**Automation \& AI**
* Strong experience with Infrastructure‑as‑Code and scripting.
* Exposure to AIOps or intelligent automation platforms.
* Demonstrated success in reducing operational effort and cost through automation.


**Professional Skills**
* Strong communication and stakeholder‑influencing skills.
* Comfortable operating in complex, regulated enterprise environments.
* Outcome‑driven mindset with a focus on business value and execution speed.


**Preferred Qualifications Include**
* Fortrea may consider relevant and equivalent professional experience in lieu of formal educational requirements.


**Physical Demands / Work Environment**
* Remote\-Based, as requested by the line manager
* Work Timings: 2:00 PM IST to 11\.00 PM IST
* Occasional drives to site locations with occasional travel both domestic and international.


 Learn more about our EEO \& Accommodations request here.

61f2d62a.title: Program Manager – Multimodal LLM Training
61f2d62a.description:
Job Title: Client Partner / Program Manager – Multimodal LLM Training
 



 Location: Chennai\-India
 



 Shift: US Shift
 



 Employment Type: Full\-time
 



 Experience: 4–8 years
 



 Job Summary
 



 We are looking for a client\-facing Client Partner / Program Manager with a strong understanding of Multimodal Large Language Model (LLM) training workflows. This person will serve as the primary point of contact between US\-based clients and internal AI training teams.
 



 The ideal candidate should be able to understand client requirements during live discussions, translate them into clear project workflows and trainer instructions, run client proof\-of\-concept (POC) projects, and ensure successful delivery. This role requires a combination of AI domain knowledge, client management, program execution, and excellent communication skills.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 Client and Requirement Management
 


* Serve as the primary point of contact for clients throughout the project lifecycle.
* Participate in client calls to understand business objectives, use cases, data requirements, quality expectations, and delivery timelines.
* Translate client requirements into structured workflows, project plans, annotation guidelines, and actionable tasks for internal teams.
* Ask relevant technical and operational questions to clarify ambiguous requirements.
* Set clear expectations with clients regarding scope, feasibility, timelines, dependencies, and deliverables.
* Conduct regular status calls, project reviews, and stakeholder updates.



 Multimodal LLM Training
 


* Understand workflows related to training and evaluating multimodal LLMs across text, image, audio, and video data.
* Work with AI trainers, annotators, subject\-matter experts, quality analysts, and technical teams.
* Help define annotation guidelines, rubrics, evaluation criteria, and quality standards.
* Understand concepts such as supervised fine\-tuning, preference data, RLHF, model evaluation, prompt\-response assessment, and human feedback workflows.
* Ensure trainers clearly understand project requirements, task instructions, edge cases, and quality expectations.
* Coordinate calibration sessions and resolve questions raised by trainers and quality teams.



 POC and Program Execution
 


* Own and manage client POCs from requirement gathering through final delivery.
* Convert POC requirements into staffing plans, workflows, milestones, and success criteria.
* Coordinate sample creation, pilot execution, quality reviews, feedback implementation, and final submission.
* Track project progress, productivity, accuracy, turnaround time, and other agreed metrics.
* Identify risks, dependencies, and delivery challenges early and communicate them to relevant stakeholders.
* Incorporate client feedback into workflows and ensure changes are communicated across the delivery team.
* Support the transition of successful POCs into larger, long\-term engagements.



 Account Growth
 


* Build strong relationships with client stakeholders and become a trusted partner.
* Identify opportunities to expand existing accounts based on evolving AI and data requirements.
* Collaborate with sales, solutions, operations, recruitment, and delivery teams on proposals and account plans.
* Support client presentations, solution discussions, scope documentation, and commercial conversations.
* Contribute to client retention, satisfaction, and revenue growth.



 Required Qualifications
 


* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
* 4–8 years of experience in client management, program management, account management, AI operations, data annotation, or a related field.
* Practical understanding of LLM and multimodal AI training workflows.
* Experience managing AI trainers, data annotators, quality analysts, or similar delivery teams.
* Experience handling client\-facing POCs, pilots, or technical programs.
* Ability to convert complex client requirements into clear operational instructions.
* Strong verbal and written English communication skills.
* Excellent presentation, documentation, stakeholder\-management, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work during US business hours.



 Preferred Qualifications
 


* Experience with generative AI, foundation models, or human\-in\-the\-loop AI programs.
* Knowledge of text, image, audio, and video annotation or evaluation workflows.
* Familiarity with supervised fine\-tuning, RLHF, preference ranking, red teaming, prompt engineering, and model evaluation.
* Experience creating project documentation, including statements of work, process flows, annotation guidelines, evaluation rubrics, and quality plans.
* Experience managing distributed or global AI training teams.
* Understanding of data privacy, confidentiality, responsible AI, and content\-safety requirements.



 Key Skills
 


* Multimodal LLM training and evaluation
* Client relationship management
* Requirement gathering and analysis
* POC and pilot management
* AI trainer and annotation operations
* Workflow and guideline development
* Quality assurance and calibration
* Cross\-functional stakeholder management
* Risk and escalation management
* Client presentations and status reporting
* Account growth and solution development



 Success Measures
 


* Successful and timely completion of client POCs
* Clear translation of client requirements into executable workflows
* Achievement of agreed quality, productivity, and turnaround\-time targets
* High client satisfaction and retention
* Effective trainer onboarding and calibration
* Successful conversion of POCs into long\-term engagements
* Growth of existing client accounts

d0ec1d16.description:
**Roles \& Responsibilities** 




**Solutioning** 



* Understand customer billing models and configure Zenskar contracts, pricing, metering, and invoicing accurately.
* Translate complex business requirements into clear, structured Zenskar workflows and setups.
* Design solutions for complex B2B SaaS products, focused on outcomes rather than features.



**Pre\-Sales \& Technical Discovery** 



* Run technical discovery with finance, RevOps, and engineering stakeholders. Understand their billing model, usage data, source systems, and rev rec requirements before anyone talks about features.
* Partner with Sales on live demos, sandbox setups, and RFP responses. Build demos tied to the prospect's real scenario, not a generic tour: set up metered plans, show usage ingestion and rated invoices, and point to where revenue is recognized.
* Design the integration. Map how usage flows from Postgres, Snowflake, or a warehouse into Zenskar, and flag idempotency, late\-arriving events, and reconciliation risks before they become implementation problems.
* Own the technical win. Qualify the deal, separate champion from economic buyer, multi\-thread to the CFO, and de\-risk the build so nothing falls apart post\-sale.



**Business Case \& Enablement** 



* Prepare business case documents and fill RFPs. Tie capability to a dollar saved or a risk removed, not a feature list.
* Create customer\-specific solution documentation and clear handoff references when transitioning deals.
* Communicate clearly, simple enough for a CXO, precise enough for technical teams.



**Internal Coordination** 



* Act as the voice of the customer internally, feeding structured patterns from discovery back to Product and Engineering.
* Raise and follow through on time\-sensitive issues so momentum is never lost.



  





**Ideal Candidate** 




**Mandatory** 



* Strong Senior Solutions Engineer (Pre\-Sales) Profile
* Mandatory (Experience 1\) – Must have 5\+ years of experience, with 3\+ years in a customer\-facing Pre\-Sales / Solutions Engineering role within a B2B SaaS company
* Mandatory (Experience 2\) – Must have spent the last 3 years in a Solutions Engineer, Solutions Consultant, Pre\-Sales Engineer, Product Specialist, or similar Pre\-Sales role. (Avoid Post\-Sales/Implementation profiles)
* Mandatory (Experience 3\) –Must have hands\-on experience conducting technical discovery sessions, product demos, proof\-of\-concepts (POCs), preparing business case documents, and responding to RFPs for enterprise or mid\-market customers
* Mandatory (Experience 4\) –Must have hands\-on experience in solutioning, configuring, and delivering technical demonstrations of SaaS products, while partnering closely with Account Executives to drive deal closure.
* Mandatory (Experience 5\) – Must have co\-owned sales cycles for $50K\+ ACV opportunities, where selling $50K\+ ACV deals was the core sales motion
* Mandatory (Experience 6\) – Must possess a strong understanding of APIs, SaaS architecture, integrations, and technical solution design, with the ability to engage confidently with technical stakeholders and CXOs.
* Mandatory (Company) – B2B SaaS (Avoid candidates from High Radius Company)
* Mandatory (Graduation Year) – Candidates should have graduated between 2018 \- 2021
* Mandatory (CTC) – Candidates' current CTC should be greater than 18L
* Mandatory (Experience 7\) – Must have worked primarily with US customers, with significant experience supporting North American sales cycles.



  





**Preferred** 



* Preferred (Experience 1\) \- Experience using CRM tools (Salesforce, HubSpot, etc.) to manage opportunities, customer engagements, and sales pipelines.
* Preferred (Experience 2\) – Experience in FinTech domains such as billing, accounting, or revenue recognition systems (e.g., invoices, contracts, receivables, pricing models).
* Preferred (Experience 3\) \- Experience working with Enterprise and Mid\-Market customers, including direct interactions with CXO\-level stakeholders.

**Company Description** 
 StatusNeo is a Silicon Valley–headquartered consulting and engineering firm focused on making AI real, scalable, and accountable for global enterprises. The company builds “Authentic AI” that is embedded into how businesses decide, build, and operate, rather than added as a superficial layer. Its approach combines the AuthenticAI™ framework with a “Decision Fabric” that unifies strategy, data, systems, and execution into measurable business outcomes. StatusNeo partners with organizations across the full transformation lifecycle, from strategic and domain consulting to product/platform engineering, AI\-native SDLC and DevSecOps, and managed transformation and operations. With global delivery across the US, EMEA, and APAC and clients in financial services, telecom, healthcare, travel, retail, and high\-tech, StatusNeo helps enterprises shift from digital ambition to AI\-native execution.

89f92560.title: Cloud Automation Architect
89f92560.description:
**Hiring for a client \- ConglomerateIT** 




  





**Roles \& Responsibilities** 




**1\. Ansible Automation** 
 Design and maintain enterprise\-grade playbooks, roles, and collections. Automate OS patching, configuration drift correction, security hardening, and compliance enforcement across AWS, Azure, VMware, and REST\-integrated environments. Combine Ansible with Terraform for seamless post\-provisioning configuration.
 



**2\. AWS Cloud Automation** 
 Architect serverless and event\-driven automation using Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, SNS/SQS, S3 triggers, and Systems Manager. Build scalable, cross\-account automation across AWS Organizations with proper IAM boundaries. Align all implementations with CIS, NIST, and AWS Well\-Architected standards.
 



**3\. Kubernetes \& Helm** 
 Develop and own custom Helm charts for multi\-environment Kubernetes deployments. Manage the full Helm lifecycle including upgrades, rollbacks, and canary releases. Drive GitOps adoption using ArgoCD or Flux. Automate namespace management, RBAC, secrets, and network policies.
 



**4\. Infrastructure as Code \& CI/CD** 
 Build reusable, versioned Terraform modules covering AWS networking, IAM, EKS, ECS, RDS, and security controls. Implement CI/CD pipelines for IaC using GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps — with automated testing, linting, drift detection, and policy enforcement baked in.
 



**5\. Security \& Compliance Automation** 
 Automate CIS benchmark enforcement, vulnerability remediation, and infrastructure hardening. Integrate with CyberArk, AWS Secrets Manager, and SSM Parameter Store. Implement policy\-as\-code using OPA, Gatekeeper, or Conftest. Automate certificate lifecycle management end to end.
 



**6\. Observability \& Auto\-Remediation** 
 Connect automation workflows to New Relic and LogicMonitor for telemetry\-driven triggers. Build self\-healing routines that detect, diagnose, and resolve incidents automatically. Convert operational runbooks into fully automated diagnostic workflows to cut MTTR significantly.
 



**7\. ITSM Integration** 
 Integrate automation into SymphonyAI\-driven ticketing, approval flows, CMDB updates, and change management processes. Build operational runbooks that map directly to ITSM workflows.
 



  





**Ideal Candidate** 




**Mandatory** 



* Strong Automation Architect Profile with cloud\-based automation strategy and framework architecture
* Mandatory (Experience 1\) – Must have 8\+ years of total experience with the last 6 years focused continuously on hands\-on automation, including automation strategy and framework architecture

Valenta is a global business solutions provider specializing in consulting, digital transformation, and managed services. We empower businesses to optimize operations, reduce costs, and achieve sustainable growth through strategic outsourcing and automation. With a global delivery model and deep expertise across industries, we deliver cutting\-edge solutions that help clients transform and scale their operations efficiently.  

Our Vision: Making life easier, one intelligent automation at a time, to empower people and businesses alike.

 **About the Role**

  

We are looking for an experienced **RPA Managed Services Lead (UiPath)** to lead our UiPath Managed Services team and ensure seamless operation of enterprise automation solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background in UiPath along with hands\-on experience managing production support, bot monitoring, client engagement, incident management, and service delivery.

  

This role requires someone who can lead support operations, optimize bot performance, manage SLAs, mentor team members, and work closely with global clients to maximize the value of their automation investments.

 **Key Responsibilities**

 **Managed Services Operations**

  

* Lead daily monitoring and support of UiPath automation environments.

* Monitor bot execution, queues, schedules, and unattended automation performance.

 **Incident \& Service Management**

* Optimize bot schedules, queues, and license usage.

 **Infrastructure \& Platform Management**

  

* Manage UiPath Orchestrator environments and bot deployments.
* Monitor VM utilization, robot availability, and license allocation.
* Support infrastructure upgrades, maintenance activities, and platform enhancements.

 **Team Leadership**

  

* Lead and mentor the Managed Services support team.
* Allocate work, monitor performance, and ensure quality service delivery.
* Coach team members on troubleshooting, best practices, and operational excellence.
* Foster a collaborative and customer\-focused culture.

 **Reporting \& Governance**

  

* Prepare operational dashboards and service reports.
* Track KPIs, SLAs, incident trends, bot utilization, and system performance.
* Present performance reports and improvement recommendations to internal leadership and clients.
* Drive continuous service improvement initiatives.

 **Required Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* **8\+ years of overall experience in Robotic Process Automation (RPA).**
* Minimum **5\+ years of experience in UiPath Managed Services, Production Support, or Automation Support.**
* Strong experience supporting enterprise automation environments.
* Experience working with global clients and managing service delivery.
* Knowledge of ITIL processes and support operations is an added advantage.

 **Required Technical Skills**

  

* Strong hands\-on experience with UiPath Orchestrator.
* Experience managing unattended robots, queues, assets, triggers, and schedules.
* Good understanding of UiPath Automation Cloud and On\-Premise environments.
* Knowledge of robot deployment, package management, and release processes.
* Experience with bot monitoring, production support, and troubleshooting.
* Strong understanding of exception handling and logging frameworks.
* Knowledge of SQL databases and basic database troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with REST APIs and system integrations.
* Experience with Windows Servers, Virtual Machines, and infrastructure monitoring.
