Orange Business is here!
About us
Join us at Orange Business!  

We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.  

Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.


About the role
Mission / Role Purpose:


The IT Asset Management (ITAM) Specialist is responsible for overseeing the full lifecycle of IT assets—both hardware (HAM) and software (SAM)across on\-premise, cloud, and hybrid environments. This role is critical in ensuring compliance, driving cost optimization, supporting vendor audits, managing licensing contracts, and integrating governance frameworks for enterprise\-wide asset visibility and control.


Key Responsibilities:


Hardware Asset Management (HAM):

* As HAM Specialist , you would be responsible for managing IT Asset in Multicloud Environments
* Youwould be responsible for managing the lifecycle of IT hardware assets deployed across Azure, SecNumCloud\-compliant platforms, and other multi cloud or hybrid infrastructures.
* This role plays a key part in ensuring compliance with vendor requirements, optimizing cloud\-hosted asset usage, and maintaining governance across geographically distributed IT environments.
* You will collaborate with infrastructure, cloud, security, procurement, and compliance teams to enable effective visibility, lifecycle management, and financial control of virtual and physical infrastructure resources supporting business\-critical services.
* Maintain inventory and metadata of all hardware assets supporting Azure\-hosted and SecNumCloud\-certified environments (servers, appliances, firewalls, etc.).
* Ensure accurate tracking of cloud\-hosted physical assets provisioned by IaaS/PaaS providers across Azure, SecNumCloud, Bleu, Flexible Engine, and others.
* Support asset tagging, classification, and location mapping in alignment with regulatory (ANSSI, GDPR) and internal security policies.
* Partner with cloud operations to map physical hosting of virtual machines and containers to underlying assets for lifecycle governance.
* Oversee procurement, deployment, maintenance, and decommissioning of hardware used in cloud infrastructure (private racks, cloud interconnect, storage appliances).
* Track and manage hardware warranties, maintenance contracts, and refresh cycles to ensure uptime and optimal performance.
* Ensure compliance with group policies related to SecNumCloud and sovereign cloud obligations, including approved suppliers and contract restrictions.
* Coordinate hardware audits and ensure readiness for regulatory inspections (SecNumCloud, ISO/IEC 27001, etc.).
* Analyze usage data and cloud\-native metrics (e.g., Azure Cost Management, Log Analytics) to correlate hardware asset demand and optimize procurement plans.
* Identify opportunities for hardware reuse or redistribution across private cloud, DR, and backup zones to reduce CAPEX/OPEX.
* Develop and maintain dashboards (e.g., Power BI, ServiceNow HAM) to monitor asset compliance, utilization, and risk status.
* Collaborate with finance and procurement teams for budgeting, forecasting, and chargeback reporting.
* Act as the HAM point of contact for cloud infrastructure projects (including private and sovereign cloud deployments).
* Maintain interfaces between HAM tools and ITSM/CMDB platforms to ensure real\-time visibility and data integrity.
* Drive adoption of automation tools and scripts for asset onboarding, reconciliation, and reporting
* Maintain an accurate inventory of IT hardware assets across data centers, offices, and remote sites.
* Oversee hardware lifecycle processes: procurement, deployment, maintenance, decommissioning, and disposal.
* Optimize asset utilization and refresh strategies to reduce total cost of ownership (TCO).
* Manage warranty and support contracts, ensuring timely renewals and alignment with service coverage.
* Collaborate with infrastructure and procurement teams to align IT hardware with operational and budget needs.

**Software Asset Management (SAM):**

* Manage and maintain the software asset repository and inventory across all platforms (on\-premises and cloud).
* Track software license purchases, entitlements, and deployments to ensure compliance and cost\-effectiveness.
* Collaborate with procurement, IT, legal, and finance teams to validate software contracts, renewals, and license metrics.
* Conduct regular audits and assessments of software usage to identify underutilized licenses and recommend reharvesting opportunities.
* Monitor and report on software compliance risks, usage trends, and optimization opportunities.
* Support vendor audits and internal controls by providing data and documentation as needed.
* Lead or contribute to the implementation of SAM tools (e.g., Flexera, ServiceNow, Snow, or equivalent).
* Establish and maintain SAM policies, procedures, and standards aligned with ITIL best practices.
* Liaise with stakeholders to educate on license compliance, contractual obligations, and cost\-saving strategies.
* Implement and govern software license lifecycle practices from procurement to retirement.
* Ensure compliance with license agreements and vendor terms (Microsoft, Oracle, Salesforce, Adobe, etc.).
* Analyze usage data to identify optimization and re\-harvesting opportunities.
* Lead internal readiness for vendor audits, license reconciliation, and contract renewal planning.
* Support cloud subscription optimization (SaaS, PaaS, IaaS) and hybrid environment licensing.
* Interpret licensing contracts and map usage for cost\-effective renewals.
* Work with Procurement, Legal, Finance, and IT to ensure alignment of contract obligations and deployment.
* Implement and maintain SAM/HAM tools
* Contribute to automation of license tracking, compliance reporting, and cost analytics.
* Provide dashboards and reporting on compliance status, usage, and financial risks.


About you
Required Skills \& Experience:* 3–7 years of experience in IT Asset Management (HAM \& SAM).
* Proven track record with enterprise software licensing with some key Software Editors (ServiceNow , PEGA , Cienna , CSG , Splunk , Salesforce , Microsoft MCA /EA, Oracle , Adobe, etc.).
* Strong knowledge of any of the ITAM tools: ServiceNow, Flexera, Snow, SCCM, OpenText, Lansweeper.
* Hands\-on experience in vendor audit preparation, license optimization, and IT contract negotiation.
* Deep understanding of ITIL, ISO/IEC 19770, FinOps, and cloud cost management principles.
* Experience managing physical IT assets in global enterprise environments.
* Behavioral:
* Strong analytical, communication, and negotiation skills.
* High attention to detail with data\-driven problem\-solving ability.
* Strong stakeholder engagement across technical and business teams.
* Ownership mindset with ability to lead initiatives and manage ambiguity.
* Ability to balance priorities and adapt to evolving business requirements.
* 

* Preferred Certifications:
* CSAM (Certified Software Asset Manager)
* CHAMP (Certified Hardware Asset Management Professional)
* ITIL v4 Foundation
* FinOps Practitioner
* ServiceNow SAM Pro Certification

  

You bring open mindedness, ability to handle pressure, leading with courage and empathy, assertiveness and communicate effectively.


What we offer* Global opportunities: Work in multi\-national teams with the opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and customers from all over the world
* Flexible work environment: Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working)

Across industries—from healthcare to finance to education—AI adoption is accelerating at record speed. Over 90% of business leaders are now reimagining their processes through AI, while developers and students across the country are building tools that are transforming the way India works and lives.
   

  

 At the heart of this movement stands
 **Neysa, India’s trusted AI Acceleration Cloud Provider** 
 .
   

  

 Neysa exists to democratize AI. Built in India for the world, Neysa carries the credibility of a leadership team that created Netmagic (now part of NTT Data). With a fully integrated system and deep local market insight, Neysa helps organizations across sectors confidently adopt, accelerate, govern, and scale AI.
   

  

**The Future of AI, Built on Trust and Expertise.** 
 Hence, Neysa understands and builds the Home for Your AI.
   

  

****What You Bring To The Table****
* Architect \& design end\-to\-end AI and Cloud solutions with a strong focus on GenAI, LLM\-driven applications, RAG workflows, ML workloads, and cloud\-native architectures.
* Engage directly with customers to understand business challenges, technical requirements, data landscape, and AI adoption goals.
* Enable customers to understand the architecture, functionality, and capabilities of proposed solutions.
* Lead technical discovery sessions, workshops, and design meetings, translating needs into scalable architectures.
* Deliver high\-impact demonstrations showcasing GenAI, LLM use cases, data\-to\-insight workflows, and automation.
* Guide customers through Proof of Concepts (PoCs), validating performance and real\-world value.
* Collaborate with sales on pre\-sales motions: presentations, demos, proposals, and RFP responses.
* Design and articulate RAG\-based workflows: intelligent search, document processing, chatbots, knowledge assistants, domain\-specific LLM apps.
* Advise customers on MLOps practices: model deployment, monitoring, governance, CI/CD for ML pipelines.
* Strong understanding of Cloud, Data Center infrastructure, enterprise networking (SDN, SD\-WAN, VPNs), hybrid/multi\-cloud designs.
* Provide deep technical guidance on cloud, containerized workloads, GPUs, and orchestration platforms for AI at scale.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor, simplifying complex concepts for business and technical stakeholders.
* Work closely with Product \& Engineering to share feedback and influence roadmap decisions.
* Stay current on trends across Cloud, AI, GenAI, ML, MLOps, and networking.


**Core Competencies**
* Hands\-on experience with LLM\-powered enterprise apps (chatbots, copilots, AI search, automation).
* Experience with GPU\-accelerated workloads and inference optimization.
* Ability to design scalable cloud\-native architectures with Docker and Kubernetes.
* Strong understanding of vector databases, embeddings, and search optimization.
* Proven track record supporting enterprises through complex AI/Cloud cycles.
* Experience collaborating with engineering and product teams.
* Ability to design custom infrastructure solutions aligned with customer environments.


**Strategic \& Analytical Competencies**
* Solution Thinking: Design AI, GenAI, ML, and cloud solutions aligned to business goals.
* Strategic Insight: Translate market trends and customer needs into impactful solution strategies.
* Data\-Driven Decisions: Evaluate options, metrics, and PoC outcomes to recommend scalable architectures.
* Problem\-Solving Excellence: Diagnose issues, identify root causes, and propose practical solutions.
* Experience leading PoCs and producing detailed documentation and architecture diagrams.
* Customer\-Centric Strategy: Map customer pain points to AI/cloud capabilities showing clear ROI.
* Cross\-Functional Thinking: Work seamlessly with sales, engineering, and product teams.


**Education \& Certifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or related fields.
* Preferred certifications in Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), AI/ML, or DevOps/Kubernetes.
* Additional certifications in TensorFlow, PyTorch, HuggingFace, MLflow, Kubeflow, etc., are advantageous.
* Strong continuous learning mindset.


**Your Mindset**
* Customer\-First \& Trusted Advisor
* Curious \& Innovative
* Collaborative \& Strategic


**Why This Role is a Unique Opportunity at Neysa**
 This role places you at the forefront of AI and Cloud innovation, enabling you to shape how enterprises leverage GenAI, ML, and advanced cloud solutions. You’ll influence key business decisions in a fast\-growing AI platform company.

2e61bd79.title: Associate Specialist – Presales
2e61bd79.description:
Ingram Micro is a leading technology company for the global information technology ecosystem.
   

  

 With the ability to reach nearly 90% of the global population, we play a vital role in the worldwide IT sales channel, bringing products and services from technology manufacturers and cloud providers to business\-to\-business technology experts.
   

  

 Our market reach, diverse solutions and services portfolio, and digital platform Ingram Micro Xvantage™ set us apart
   

  

**Position Summary:**
 We have a great opportunity available for a highly qualified Azure Cloud Presales Solutions Engineer. This role will provide technical expertise in support of pre\-sales activities, Migrations. The successful candidate will develop general knowledge across all Migration functions and assist in the assessment, architectural reviews, design, demonstration, and enhancement of cloud solutions as required by the partner. This role involves collaborating with sales teams to understand customer requirements, designing and architecting Cloud\-based solutions, and delivering compelling presentations and demonstrations. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of Azure services, excellent communication skills, and the ability to translate complex technical concepts into actionable solutions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Customer Engagement: Engage with prospective clients to understand their business requirements, technical needs, and project goals.
* Solution Design: Design and architect Azure solutions tailored to meet customer requirements, including compute, storage, database, networking, and security components.
* Technical Presentations: Deliver engaging and informative presentations, demos, and proof\-of concepts (POCs) to showcase cloud solutions and capabilities.
* Collaboration: Work closely with sales teams, product managers, and engineering teams to ensure alignment of solutions with customer needs and business objectives.
* Documentation: Develop detailed technical documentation, including solution designs, architecture diagrams, and implementation plans.
* Proposal Support: Assist in the preparation of proposals, RFP responses, and technical evaluations to support the sales process.
* Industry Trends: Stay current with Azure service updates, industry trends, and best practices to provide up\-to\-date guidance and recommendations.
* Customer Relationships: Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, providing technical expertise and support throughout the sales cycle.


**Required Qualifications:**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. Relevant certifications are a plus.
* Experience: 4\+ years of experience in a pre\-sales or technical consulting role with a focus on technologies.
* Technical Skills: Strong understanding of Azure services, including AKS, VM’s, Blob storage, VPC, IAM, and CloudFormation. Experience with architectural best practices.
* Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non\-technical audiences.
* Problem\-Solving: Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to design solutions that address customer needs and challenges.
* Presentation: Proven experience in delivering technical presentations and demonstrations to a variety of audiences. Preferred Qualifications:
* Certifications: Cloud Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or Professional, Certified DevOps Engineer, or other relevant certifications.
* Industry Knowledge: Experience in \[specific industry, if applicable] or with \[specific technologies or tools relevant to your business].
* Additional Skills: Familiarity with cloud migration strategies, DevOps practices, and containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).

cc19ee65.title: Senior DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
cc19ee65.description:
**Job Summary:**  
We are looking for a highly experienced Senior DevOps \& Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to be the sole owner of our cloud infrastructure, DevOps processes, security, and compliance. This is a hands\-on role for someone who enjoys building reliable systems from the ground up while ensuring operational excellence.

The ideal candidate should be capable of independently managing production infrastructure, deployments, monitoring, disaster recovery, cloud security, and regulatory compliance with minimal supervision.

**Key Responsibilities:** 

Cloud Infrastructure

* Design, deploy, and manage cloud infrastructure (AWS and/or Azure)
* Manage virtual machines, networking, storage, DNS, SSL certificates, and load balancers
* Configure high availability and disaster recovery strategies
* Optimize infrastructure for performance, reliability, and cost
* Plan infrastructure capacity as the company grows

DevOps \& Automation

* Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines
* Automate build, deployment, and release processes
* Implement Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Bicep, or CloudFormation
* Automate server provisioning and configuration management
* Standardize deployment processes across development, staging, and production

Kubernetes \& Containers

* Deploy and manage Docker\-based applications
* Manage Kubernetes clusters
* Implement rolling deployments and blue\-green deployment strategies
* Optimize container resource utilization
* Maintain container registry and image security

Security \& Compliance

* Implement cloud security best practices
* Manage Identity and Access Management (IAM)
* Configure firewalls, NSGs, security groups, VPNs, and private networking
* Implement vulnerability management and patching
* Manage secrets using secure vault solutions
* Ensure encryption of data in transit and at rest
* Conduct regular security reviews and audits

Compliance

Own and maintain technical compliance for standards such as:

ISO 27001

SOC 2

GDPR

HIPAA (if applicable)

PCI\-DSS (if applicable)

Responsibilities include:

* Maintaining infrastructure documentation
* Managing audit evidence
* Implementing security controls
* Supporting external audits
* Maintaining asset inventories
* Managing backup policies
* Disaster Recovery planning
* Business Continuity planning

Monitoring \& Reliability

* Implement centralized logging
* Configure monitoring dashboards
* Set up alerts and incident management
* Perform root cause analysis
* Improve system reliability and uptime
* Define and monitor SLAs and SLOs

Backup \& Disaster Recovery

* Design backup strategies
* Test disaster recovery plans regularly
* Ensure Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO) are met
* Manage backup retention policies

Database Infrastructure

* Support SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or MySQL infrastructure
* Configure backups and replication
* Monitor database performance
* Assist developers with infrastructure\-related database issues

Networking

* Design secure network architecture
* Manage DNS
* Configure VPNs
* Configure reverse proxies
* Implement WAF where required
* Troubleshoot networking issues

Cost Optimization

* Monitor cloud spending
* Recommend cost\-saving opportunities
* Right\-size infrastructure
* Manage reserved instances or savings plans where appropriate
* Produce monthly infrastructure cost reports

Developer Enablement

* Improve developer productivity
* Maintain build environments
* Troubleshoot deployment issues
* Create infrastructure documentation
* Establish DevOps best practices

**Required Skills**

* 7\+ years in DevOps or Cloud Infrastructure
* Strong experience with AWS and/or Azure
* Linux administration
* Windows Server administration
* Docker
* Kubernetes
* Terraform or Bicep
* GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI/CD, or Jenkins
* PowerShell and Bash scripting

Networking fundamentals

* SSL/TLS
* DNS
* Load balancing
* IAM
* Monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Monitor, CloudWatch, ELK, or Datadog
* SQL Server administration fundamentals
* Backup and disaster recovery
* Security hardening

**Preferred Skills**

* Microsoft Azure certifications or AWS certifications
* Experience supporting SOC 2 or ISO 27001 audits
* Experience with Microsoft 365 administration
* Experience with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD)
* Experience with vulnerability management tools
* Experience with incident response
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted infrastructure automation

**Soft Skills**

* Self\-driven and able to work independently
* Strong ownership mindset
* Excellent troubleshooting abilities
* Strong documentation skills
* Able to prioritize work in a fast\-paced startup environment
* Comfortable wearing multiple hats

**Success Metrics**

* 99\.9%\+ production availability
* Fully automated deployment pipeline
* Infrastructure documented and version controlled
* Successful completion of security and compliance audits
* Disaster recovery plan tested regularly
* Infrastructure costs optimized without compromising reliability
* Minimal production incidents and rapid incident resolution

a2b1169c.title: Solution Architect
a2b1169c.description:
Greetings from RSquareSoft Technologies

Who We Are

RSquareSoft Technologies is a Pune\-based software product company focused on AI, ML, and Data Analytics. We provide end\-to\-end solutions, including product development, outsourcing, and IT consulting. Our mission is to revolutionize outsourcing in India, empower young minds in software development, and offer dedicated service to every customer.

Key Aspects of RSquareSoft Technologies

* Focus on AI, ML, and Data Analytics: We specialize in building innovative and scalable solutions.
* Product Development: We develop software products that improve efficiency, productivity, and business performance.
* IT Services: We offer software development, database migration, and cloud solutions.
* Outsourcing Solutions: We aim to transform the outsourcing landscape in India.
* Employee Training and Mentoring: We nurture young talents with continuous mentorship.
* Customer\-centric Approach: We ensure transparent communication and dedicated service.
* Innovation and Excellence: We are driven by innovation and a commitment to quality.

Job Title: Solution Architect

Location: Pune  
Experience: 6–11 Years

Role Overview

We are looking for a Solution Architect with a strong Data Engineering background to drive the architecture, design, and technical direction of complex, cloud\-based data platforms. This role requires deep hands\-on expertise in big data technologies along with the ability to design scalable, secure, and high\-performance data solutions aligned with business needs.

Key Responsibilities

* Own end\-to\-end solution architecture for cloud\-native data platforms and big data ecosystems.
* Design scalable, resilient, and secure architectures using AWS and distributed data processing frameworks.
* Lead architecture and design discussions, including high\-level and low\-level design reviews.
* Provide hands\-on technical guidance in Python, PySpark, Spark, and Hadoop ecosystem.
* Design and optimize data pipelines, ETL/ELT workflows, and large\-scale data processing systems.
* Define and enforce architectural standards, best practices, and design principles for data engineering.
* Collaborate with engineering, data, product, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into data\-driven solutions.
* Review critical technical designs and implementations to ensure alignment with target data architecture.
* Identify and mitigate architectural risks related to performance, scalability, data quality, and cost optimization.
* Support teams in resolving complex data engineering and system design challenges.

Required Skills \& Expertise

* Strong experience in Cloud Architecture (preferably AWS) including data services (S3, EMR, Glue, Redshift, etc.).
* Solid background in Big Data technologies and distributed systems.
* Strong programming experience in Python with expertise in PySpark/Spark.
* Hands\-on experience with Hadoop ecosystem (HDFS, Hive, YARN, etc.).
* Expertise in building and optimizing large\-scale data pipelines and batch/stream processing systems.
* Strong SQL skills for data modeling, transformation, and performance optimization.
* Proven expertise in system design and data architecture for scalable and distributed systems.
* Experience creating and reviewing HLDs and LLDs.

Good to Have

* Experience with real\-time/streaming technologies (Kafka, Spark Streaming, etc.).
* Exposure to data lake / data warehouse architectures.
* Experience in financial services or regulated domains.
* Familiarity with data governance, security, and compliance in cloud environments.

Leadership \& Soft Skills

* Ability to influence technical direction across teams without direct people management.
* Strong communication skills to articulate architectural decisions to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Structured problem\-solving and decision\-making approach.

Pay: ₹3,000,000\.00 \- ₹5,000,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

99a7216f.title: Solution Architect – GenAI Applications
99a7216f.description:
**In this role you will:** 



* Focus on
 **architectural, conceptual, communication, and organizational** 
 aspects of GenAI application development.
* Partner with business and technology stakeholders to define
 **GenAI application and solution architecture** 
 , translating complex business challenges into scalable ML\- and LLM\-based designs (e.g. copilots, assistants, agents, smart workflows).
* **Own end\-to\-end GenAI solution architecture** 
 , covering data pipelines, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), model orchestration, LLM integration, vector stores, prompt and agent frameworks, deployment patterns, observability, security, and governance.
* **Architect and guide implementations on Microsoft Azure** 
 , including selection and integration of services for GenAI workloads and applications (e.g. Azure OpenAI Service, Azure Machine Learning, Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Event Hubs / Service Bus, Cosmos DB, Azure SQL, Azure Storage, Azure Cognitive Search).
* Lead complex, cross\-regional GenAI initiatives from
 **use\-case discovery and solution shaping** 
 to enterprise rollout, with a strong focus on business impact, reusability, and sustainability.

c0a36c3a.title: Senior Product Solutions Architect
c0a36c3a.description:
**About the Role** 




  





 We are seeking a visionary
 **Principal Product Solutions Architect** 
 to lead the technical design, configuration patterns, and system orchestration for our next\-generation Enterprise Financial Close, Reconciliation, and Anomaly Detection product.
 



 Our product is built on top of an advanced, internal, metadata\-driven low\-code platform featuring a highly interactive, spreadsheet like user interface. This is a specialized
 **product application and data modeling architecture** 
 role.
 



  





 Your core mandate is to translate intricate financial compliance logic into a scalable, high\-performance product application layer, utilizing an internal engine that abstracts out transformations to natively run on Datalakes. You will architect the application patterns that enable a fast\-moving engineering organization of a large team of developers to build concurrently while scaling to process hundreds of millions of transaction rows for global Fortune 500 enterprises.
 



  





**Not Required:** 
 Infrastructure, CI/CD, DevOps, security/authentication, raw ERP data ingestion pipelines, and the standalone machine learning engines are completely managed by dedicated horizontal engineering teams.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Metadata\-Driven Application Design:** 
 Architect the semantic data layer, defining how standard and complex custom objects interact within an enterprise\-wide low\-code data catalog. Ensure flexible configurations seamlessly support varied multinational financial structures out of the box.
* **Performance Engineering:** 
 Own the approaches to best column\-level transformation formulas. Ensure that complex data reconciliation mappings defined by users in an abstract UI adhere to highly efficient, parallelized, and cost\-effective Snowflake SQL paths that avoid performance degradation or runaway cloud compute expenses during the critical month\-end close window.
* **Cross\-Team Technical Orchestration:** 
 Act as the primary technical ambassador and contract negotiator for the product unit. Collaborate directly with adjacent engineering teams to define robust, production\-grade API contracts for ERP Data Ingestion, UI Widgets, and the AI/Rules anomaly detection engine.
* **Configuration Governance at Scale:** 
 Establish software development lifecycle (SDLC) best practices tailored for a low\-code metadata environment. Define patterns for version control, component modularity, testing, and dependency management to enable a large engineering organization to build simultaneously without conflict or regressions.
* **Technical Domain Liaison:** 
 Work closely with a team of Product Managers to dissect sophisticated accounting workflows (such as intercompany reconciliations and ledger\-to\-subledger matching) and translate them into robust, reproducible platform configurations.



  





**What We Are Looking For (Requirements)** 



* **Platform\-Native Architectural Experience:** 
 A proven track record of designing large\-scale, metadata\-driven systems. Deep familiarity with expanding or building heavy business applications on top of highly structured platforms (e.g., Salesforce Lightning/Apex, ServiceNow, Guidewire, SAP NetWeaver, or highly complex internal PaaS frameworks).
* **Expertise in Domain\-Driven Design (DDD):** 
 Superior capability to transform fluid business logic and accounting rules into immutable, structured entity relationships and declarative constraints.
* **Systems Orchestration Mindset:** 
 Exceptional capacity to design complex application state workflows, cross\-system dependency mappings, and cleanly isolated service contracts without managing raw infrastructure.
* **Outstanding Technical Communication:** 
 A proven history of writing clear, comprehensive RFCs and technical documentation, with the executive presence to negotiate architectural priorities across multi\-functional core platform teams.



  





**What You Will NOT Need to Do** 




 Because we have dedicated underlying infrastructure and core engine teams, your background does
 **not** 
 need to emphasize:
 


* Core cloud\-native infrastructure administration (Kubernetes, Docker, Service Meshes, Terraform).
* Low\-level systems programming or building Java/Go microservices from scratch.
* Writing raw Machine Learning training loops or building native ETL ingestion adapters.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Prior experience working in the financial technology space (Corporate Accounting, Auditing, Fintech SaaS, or ERP customizations).
* Experience designing software that complies with strict enterprise audit requirements (SOX compliance, data lineage, SOC 2\).

cdd7c4e2.title: Tenable Architect
cdd7c4e2.description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission\-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI\-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well\-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.  



  

**The Role**

We are looking for a **Tenable Security Architect / Administrator** to lead the end\-to\-end design, deployment, administration, and automation of our enterprise vulnerability management infrastructure across hybrid environments.


### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Architecture \& Design:** Design, scale, and maintain Tenable architecture (Security Center, Tenable.io/Tenable Vulnerability Management, and Nessus Scanners) across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid setups.
* **Platform Administration:** Oversee daily operations, including scan policies, repositories, RBAC, platform upgrades, plugin updates, and troubleshooting scan or connectivity issues.
* **Vulnerability Management:** Analyze scan results, prioritize vulnerabilities based on CVSS and business risk, and partner with IT/cloud teams to drive and validate remediation.
* **Automation \& Scripting:** Write scripts to automate health checks, reporting, and operational tasks using REST APIs and JSON payload processing.
* **Enterprise Integration:** Connect Tenable platforms with ServiceNow, SIEMs (Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel), and Active Directory.

  

  

Your Future at Kyndryl
  

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from a Junior Architect to Principal Architect – we have opportunities for that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands\-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms.  



  

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer\-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.


### **Required Skillsets**

* **Core Platform Experience:** 7–10\+ years in vulnerability management with deep hands\-on expertise in Tenable Security Center, Tenable.io (Tenable Vulnerability Management), and Nessus scanners.
* **Vulnerability Frameworks:** Solid knowledge of vulnerability management lifecycles, asset discovery, credentialed scanning, CVE, CVSS scoring, and CIS Benchmarks.
* **Scripting \& APIs:** Basic to intermediate proficiency in **Python, PowerShell, or Bash** , with practical experience utilizing **REST APIs** and processing JSON data for operational automation.
* **System Integration:** Proven experience integrating Tenable with **ServiceNow** , **SIEM solutions** (Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel), and **Active Directory** .
* **Operations \& Maintenance:** Hands\-on experience with platform upgrades, scanner deployment, policy configurations, and troubleshooting scan failures or network issues.

### **Preferred Skillsets**

* **Cloud Exposure:** Working knowledge of cloud security scanning mechanics in **AWS, Azure, or GCP** environments.
* **Certifications:** Tenable Certified Security Center Specialist/Architect, CISSP, CEH, or CISM.
* **Governance \& Compliance:** Experience supporting security audits, compliance mapping, and executive metrics reporting.

  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  

  

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  

  

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.


**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

d982d4c6.description:
**Job Overview:**

The Senior Architect will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining the overall architecture of our IT systems to support the organization's current and future needs. The Senior Architect will have a strong background in IT infrastructure, systems integration, and software development, with the ability to analyze complex problems and design innovative solutions. He/she will be responsible for providing strategic direction, designing complex IT solutions, and mentoring junior architects. This architect will be responsible for designing enterprise data models, defining metadata and governance standards, analyzing data quality issues, implementing MDM matching and survivorship strategies, evaluating emerging technologies, and enabling AI\-driven automation across the enterprise data ecosystem. Working closely with Data Engineers, Data Analysts, Data Stewards, and Business SMEs, the architect will translate complex business requirements into scalable technical solutions that improve data quality, governance, discoverability, and business value.


**Summary of Responsibilities:**

* Develop and maintain the organization's IT architecture framework, ensuring alignment with business objectives, industry best practices, and emerging technologies.
* Serve as the hands\-on technical architect and subject matter expert for Data Governance, Data Quality, Master Data Management (MDM), Metadata Management, Data Catalog, and AI\-enabled data management platforms.
* Design, implement, and maintain enterprise data architecture standards, canonical data models, metadata frameworks, and governance practices that promote trusted, discoverable, and reusable data assets.
* Lead technical design and configuration of MDM solutions, including data modeling, matching, survivorship, hierarchy management, and integration patterns across critical business domains.
* Analyze enterprise data quality issues through data profiling, root cause analysis, quality assessments, and measurement frameworks; define remediation strategies and business rules to improve data reliability and compliance.
* Architect and optimize enterprise Data Catalog and Metadata Management capabilities, including business glossary, lineage, classification, stewardship, and metadata enrichment processes.
* Identify and implement AI, machine learning, and intelligent automation capabilities to enhance data quality monitoring, anomaly detection, metadata enrichment, entity resolution, stewardship workflows, and governance operations.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance to architecture and development teams, ensuring adherence to architectural principles, standards, and guidelines.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions that meet functional and non\-functional requirements.
* Design end\-to\-end IT solutions, including infrastructure, applications, data, and security components, to support business processes and workflows.
* Evaluate and recommend technologies, tools, and methodologies to enhance the organization's IT capabilities and drive innovation.
* Lead architectural reviews and provide guidance to development teams to ensure adherence to architectural principles, standards, and guidelines.
* Identify and mitigate architectural risks and issues through proactive planning and effective communication with stakeholders.
* Define and maintain documentation related to IT architecture, including diagrams, standards, policies, and procedures.
* Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in IT architecture, and apply knowledge to drive continuous improvement.
* Measurably impact company performance by delivering high quality, scalable data products.
* And all other duties as needed or assigned.

**Qualifications (Minimum Required):**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
* Fortrea may consider relevant and equivalent experience in lieu of educational requirements.

**Experience (Minimum Required):**

* 10 years of experience in Enterprise, Business, Information, Systems and Application, Solution Architectures.
* Strong expertise in designing and implementing enterprise\-scale IT solutions across multiple platforms and technologies.
* Hands\-on experience designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise data architecture, Data Governance, Data Quality, Metadata Management, Data Catalog, MDM, or related data management solutions.
* Must have e xperience implementing data solutions in Microsoft Azure
* In\-depth knowledge of cloud computing platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and their services.
* Proficiency in system integration techniques, including API design, microservices architecture, and message queuing protocols.
* Hands\-on experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or Puppet.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively with stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications Include:**

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
* Experience in pharmaceutical R and D, clinical development and/or healthcare IT.

Learn more about our EEO \& Accommodations request here .

e49af77d.description:
Be a part of a high\-growth Customer and Employee Experience consulting firm that’s redefining digital engagement. Recognized by Inc. 5000, Great Place to Work and Deloitte Technology Fast 500 North America as one of the fastest growing companies, Altudo offers an environment where innovation, learning, and growth go hand in hand.
 



  





 Altudo has been awarded the Sales Performance Partner – XM Cloud Hero award by Sitecore in 2025\.
 



 As an Architect, you will provide technical leadership throughout the lifecycle of projects, with a strong focus on Sitecore and composable solutioning. You will guide design, user interface, and technology integration while interfacing with client technology and management teams to ensure solutions meet business and technical requirements. You will design end\-to\-end digital Sitecore technology solutions, participate in initial client conversations to identify needs, and provide pre\-sales support by bridging business goals with high\-value technical solutions.
 



  





**What will you do:** 



* Lead architecture and solution design for enterprise\-scale Sitecore and composable solutions, defining reference architectures, frameworks, and best practices for scalable, resilient implementations.
* Provide hands\-on guidance in implementing composable components, orchestrating microservices, integrating APIs, and deploying solutions on cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP).

* Design and implement CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), monitoring, observability, and API standards to support scalable, secure cloud deployments.
* Define and enforce API standards, manage API gateway configurations, and leverage event\-driven architectures for asynchronous communication between front\-end and back\-end systems.

* Serve as a thought leader—stay current with emerging technologies, drive strategic initiatives, develop internal IP, and train internal teams.



  





**Who you are:** 



* Strong experience with .NET/C\#, Sitecore AI (XM Cloud), Sitecore XP/XM (versions 9 and 10\), and end\-to\-end Sitecore upgrade and migration projects.
* Must be a certified Sitecore professional
* Experience creating Architectural Diagram and technical design
* Familiarity with Sitecore Headless / JSS / SXA

* Experience working with GraphQL / Sitecore Graph / Sitecore APIs
* Proficiency in modern front\-end frameworks (React, Nextjs) when integrating with headless Sitecore approaches.
* Performance tuning, caching strategies, and scalability in high\-traffic environments.
* Proficiency in Prompt engineering and using any AI tool for development

**What’s in it for you?** 



* Opportunity to work with a fast\-growing digital transformation and customer experience consulting that has been recognized internationally by Deloitte fast 500 \& INCE 5000 for this exceptional growth.
* Direct involvement in shaping enterprise Sitecore architectures for global brands.
* Competitive compensation structure
* Exposure to the latest in customer experience and digital commerce technologies.

Our commitment to excellence has been recognized with awards including Great Place to Work honor, Deloitte Technology Fast 500, and Inc. 5000 rankings. Our client work has been honored with top industry awards like Hermes, AVA, and Vega echoing our approach to help brand move from vision to value.

455ff562.title: Associate Project Delivery Leader
455ff562.description:
**Meet Our Team:**
------------------



PegaSystems is seeking Client Success Journey Designers who partner with executives and product/delivery teams to design and realize measurable client outcomes. You will blend strategy, service design, strong negotiation, and storytelling to align stakeholders, shape outcome\-led roadmaps, and guide squads from vision to value—ensuring adoption, satisfaction, and sustained impact.

**Picture Yourself at Pega:**
-----------------------------



Pegasystems is seeking Tech Project / Program managers to join our dynamic team of Delivery Leaders at multiple levels.

* Co\-design the client success journey—from vision to value —using the blueprints, journey maps, and testable value hypotheses as a Solution Designer.
* Champion Pega Blueprint based Rapid Delivery
* Deliver engagements to agreed client scope, timescales, budget, and quality metrics, as well as assisting clients to achieve the expected ROI.


At Pega, we actively explore and embrace emerging AI capabilities with curiosity, responsibility, and a drive for meaningful innovation. You will work in an environment where AI‑enabled tools are used to enhance learning, improve engineering efficiency, and support better decision‑making across the cloud platform.


We expect engineers to apply critical thinking to all AI‑generated outputs—validating accuracy, quality, and relevance before applying them in production environments. We view AI maturity as a spectrum, progressing from foundational adoption toward more strategic, advocacy‑driven integration, and you will play an active role in that journey.

**What You'll Do at Pega:**
---------------------------


* Typically be involved in between one and two projects, including Pega, partner, or client\-led implementations
* Deliver engagements to agreed client scope, timescales, budget, and quality metrics, as well as assisting clients to achieve the expected ROI
* Drive account hygiene (timely and accurate contractual documentation, Project Status Reports (PSRs), Engagement Status Dashboards (ESDs), forecasts, and A/R collections)
* Act as a trusted advisor to the client on all aspects of Pegasystems engagement, leading communication and providing thought leadership so that the best system possible is implemented
* Advise on Pegasystems’ delivery methodology and how this can be harmonized with a client’s methodology; demonstrate a thorough understanding of Agile, Waterfall, and Scrum approaches to delivery
**Who You Are:**
----------------


* 9\-12 years in consulting/professional services with 4\+ years leading cross\-functional engagements and/or product/program work; proven track record designing client journeys, conflict resolution, stakeholder mediation and landing measurable business outcomes.
* Experience in managing resources in Matrix or non\-direct reporting structures
* Knowledge of cloud migration strategies and legacy modernization approaches
* Demonstrated ability to build trusted advisor relationships at multiple organizational levels.
* Executive\-caliber written communication; storytelling; ability to simplify complex concepts into crisp narratives. Practical Agile experience (Scrum/Kanban); skilled in discovery\-to\-delivery orchestration and backlog management.
* Certifications (nice to have): PMP(preferred), PSM/CSM, PRINCE2, SAFe POPM/Lean Portfolio, Service Design (e.g., SDN)
**What You've Accomplished:**
-----------------------------


* Translate strategy into action with MVP definitions, outcome\-based road maps, and prioritized backlogs tied to OKRs/KPIs.
* Negotiate scope and priorities to protect outcomes while managing constraints; facilitate governance and issue resolution with senior stakeholders.
* Tell the story of value through executive\-ready narratives, data\-driven visuals, and compelling demonstrations that accelerate decisions and adoption.
* Coach teams on journey\-centric delivery and help mature practices, templates, and playbooks that scale success across accounts.
* Identify growth opportunities through realized outcomes, adoption signals, and stakeholder advocacy; contribute to proposals and SoWs.
* ***Step up to play Scrum Master or a Pega Business Architect role as required***


LI\-MC3

**Pega Offers You:**
--------------------


* A rapidly growing yet well\-established business
* The world’s most innovative organizations as reference\-able clients
* Analyst acclaimed technology leadership in a massive emerging market
* A fast\-paced, exciting, collaborative, and rewarding sales environment within innovative industries

  
**AI in Action – Responsible Use of AI in Recruitment**  

Pega embraces the responsible use of artificial intelligence (AI) to improve efficiency, consistency, and fairness across our business. We encourage thoughtful and ethical adoption of AI technologies that support people—not replace them. We may use AI‑enabled tools in our recruitment process. These tools are designed to assist us by providing insights and operational support.



All hiring decisions are made based on human review and judgment. You may have the right to request human review, provide additional information, or raise questions about how such tools are used.


**Culture**  

At Pegasystems, we foster an environment where people feel valued and empowered to contribute their best. With global clients across industries and regions, we know our success depends on the unique perspectives, experiences, and talents of our people. Ours is a workplace where everyone can grow, collaborate, and deliver meaningful outcomes.



We encourage candidates from all backgrounds and experiences and focus on the core competencies and mindset needed to thrive in a role.



As an Equal Opportunity employer, Pegasystems will not discriminate in its employment practices due to an applicant's race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, genetic information, veteran or disability status, or any other category protected by law.



This same mindset shapes how we work, encouraging curiosity, continuous learning, and smarter ways of working with AI. At Pegasystems, we believe the best ideas come from curious people who embrace change, learn continuously, and use AI to work smarter and move faster. Guided by our values, we bring a growth mindset to every challenge and create lasting impact together.


**Export Compliance**  

For positions requiring access to technical data subject to export control regulations such as this, Pegasystems may need to obtain export license approval from the U.S. Government and EU Authorities for certain individuals.


**Accommodations**  

If you require reasonable accommodations under the Americans with Disabilities Act (US only) or comparable regional regulations in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre\-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please contact us here or contact (US only) 1\-888\-PEGA\-NOW and/or 225 Wyman Street Waltham, MA 02451 ATTN: Benefits.

* Track milestones across cell line development, process development, comparability, clinical studies, and regulatory filings.

f5bd7f44.description:
**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for
 *all* 
 .**
 Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
   

  

 Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all. Join an inclusive team passionate about one thing: using their expertise in the relentless pursuit of innovation for customers and partners. The solutions we build help make everything from virtual reality experiences to breakthroughs in neural networks possible. We do it all while committing to integrity, sustainability, and giving back to our communities. Because doing so can fuel the very innovation we are pursuing.

We’re an international team of visionaries and scientists, developing groundbreaking technologies that are transforming how the world uses information to enrich life.

Candidate should be able to develop flows enhancing project management efficiency using industry leading AI tools or developing scripts.

* Establishing and maintaining communication with the project team, management, and stakeholders
* Coordinating project meetings and decision\-making processes
* Executing the work, coordinating and supervising the project team and ensuring that they have the tools required for delivering the project on time
* Completing the project and creating required documentation and reports for the management
* Drive special projects chosen as highest priority for alignment across organizations and overall product time to market.
* Develop, coordinate, and sustain top\-level organizational objectives with regular report\-outs to senior leaders.
* Implement and oversee key metrics to ensure deliverables are achieved and have desired impact.
* Promote collaboration, drive deliverable execution.
* Lead and develop executive\-ready presentations, team highlights/low\-light summaries, objective summaries, and all\-team communications.
* AI proficiency is a must \- candidate should be able to develop flows enhancing project management efficiency,
* Leveraging Artificial Intelligence.


**About Micron Technology, Inc.**
 We are an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life
 *for all* 
 . With a relentless focus on our customers, technology leadership, and manufacturing and operational excellence, Micron delivers a rich portfolio of high\-performance DRAM, NAND, and NOR memory and storage products through our Micron® and Crucial® brands. Every day, the innovations that our people create fuel the data economy, enabling advances in artificial intelligence and 5G applications that unleash opportunities — from the data center to the intelligent edge and across the client and mobile user experience.
   

  

 To learn more, please visit micron.com/careers
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.
   

  

 To request assistance with the application process and/or for reasonable accommodations, please contact hrsupport\_india@micron.com
   

  

 Micron Prohibits the use of child labor and complies with all applicable laws, rules, regulations, and other international and industry labor standards.
   

  

 Micron does not charge candidates any recruitment fees or unlawfully collect any other payment from candidates as consideration for their employment with Micron.

However, all information provided must be accurate and reflect the candidate's true skills and experiences. Misuse of AI to fabricate or misrepresent qualifications will result in immediate disqualification.

de8ec405.title: Presales Consultant / Solutioning Lead - Mining (Engineering Services)
de8ec405.description:
**Role Overview** 




 Senior Manager Presales acts as the bridge between customer business challenges and the technical solutions that address them. This role is responsible for driving solution strategy, shaping customer engagements, developing compelling proposals, and positioning value\-driven engineering services solutions within the Mining \& Energy industry.
 



 The Presales Consultant will partner closely with Sales, Delivery, Domain SMEs, and Solution Architects to understand customer requirements, identify business drivers, and create differentiated solutions that align with customers' operational and strategic objectives.
 



 This role requires a strong combination of industry expertise, solutioning capability, proposal management experience, commercial acumen, and executive\-level stakeholder engagement skills.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Customer Engagement \& Discovery** 



* Engage with prospective customers to understand business objectives, operational challenges, and transformation priorities.
* Lead customer discovery workshops, requirement gathering sessions, and solution discussions.
* Analyze customer pain points and translate them into solution opportunities.
* Build trusted advisor relationships with customer stakeholders, including engineering, operations, digital, and executive leadership teams.



**Solution Development \& Architecture** 



* Develop end\-to\-end solution strategies aligned with customer business outcomes.
* Collaborate with solution architects, technical SMEs, delivery teams, and business units to create winning solutions.
* Design innovative service offerings across:
* Engineering Services
* Digital Engineering
* Asset Management
* Smart Mining
* Energy Transition Solutions
* Plant Engineering
* Industrial Automation
* AI/Analytics Applications
* Remote Operations Centers
* Sustainability and ESG initiatives
* Ensure technical feasibility, scalability, risk assessment, and delivery readiness of proposed solutions.



**Proposal Management \& RFP Response** 



* Lead end\-to\-end proposal development activities for RFP, RFQ, RFI, and bid responses.
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams to develop compelling technical and commercial proposals.
* Develop executive summaries, solution narratives, value propositions, assumptions, effort estimations, and pricing inputs.
* Own proposal governance, compliance requirements, and submission timelines.
* Ensure proposals clearly map customer requirements to organizational capabilities and differentiators.



**Commercial \& Financial Analysis** 



* Develop business cases supporting proposed solutions.
* Perform:
* ROI Analysis
* Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) Analysis
* Cost Modeling
* Pricing Strategy Development
* Risk Evaluation
* Support leadership teams with Go/No\-Go assessments and opportunity qualification.



**Sales Support \& Deal Enablement** 



* Partner with Sales teams throughout the opportunity lifecycle.
* Support customer presentations, solution walkthroughs, and executive briefings.
* Participate in customer negotiations and commercial discussions where required.
* Create persuasive collateral including:
* Solution Presentations
* Capability Decks
* Case Studies
* Value Propositions
* Competitive Positioning Documents



**Market Intelligence \& Practice Development** 



* Track industry trends across Mining and Energy sectors.
* Analyze competitor offerings and develop strategic differentiators.
* Contribute to reusable solution assets, proposal repositories, accelerators, and best practices.
* Support creation of industry\-focused go\-to\-market strategies and offerings.



**Required Experience and Personal Attributes** 



* 12\-16 years of Presales, Solutioning, Bid Management, Proposal Development, or Consulting experience.
* Strong experience supporting Mining in Engineering Services environments.
* Proven experience in responding to large\-scale RFPs/RFIs/RFQs.
* Experience in creating solution architectures and transformation roadmaps.
* Demonstrated success in supporting large strategic pursuits and revenue growth initiatives.
* Experience working with geographically distributed teams and global customers.

* Autonomous Mining Technologies
* Mineral Processing
* Operational Excellence Programs
* Mine Digitization

* Energy Transition Programs

* Plant Engineering
* Mechanical Engineering
* Electrical Systems

* Product Engineering
* Digital Engineering
* Industrial IoT
* AI \& Analytics Applications



 Desired Skills \& Competencies

* Consultative Selling
* Strategic Thinking
* Customer Engagement
* Stakeholder Management
* Executive Communication
* Negotiation Skills
* Commercial Awareness



 Presales Skills
 


* Solution Design
* Proposal Management
* Bid Coordination
* Estimation and Pricing
* Value Engineering
* Business Case Development
* Workshop Facilitation



 Technical Skills
 


* Engineering Services Solutioning

* AI/ML and Analytics Concepts

dcaa6694.title: Google Cloud Generative AI Engineer (Vertex AI & Agentic AI)
dcaa6694.description:
We are seeking a highly motivated **Google Cloud Generative AI Engineer** with 4\-5 years of experience in designing, developing, and deploying AI\-powered applications on **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)**. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on expertise in **Google Agent Development Kit (ADK), Vertex AI, Gemini models, LLM integration, RAG architectures, and cloud\-native application development**. This role involves building scalable AI solutions, intelligent agents, and enterprise\-grade GenAI applications that drive business innovation.


Key Responsibilities


* Build and implement Generative AI applications leveraging **Vertex AI, Gemini models, Agent Builder, and other Google AI services**.
* Design, develop, and deploy AI agents and multi\-agent systems using **Google Agent Development Kit (ADK)**.
* Integrate AI agents with enterprise applications, APIs, databases, and third\-party systems.
* Develop orchestration workflows for autonomous, conversational, and task\-driven AI agents.
* Implement **Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG)** solutions using vector databases and enterprise knowledge sources.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, and product teams to gather requirements and translate them into scalable AI solutions.
* Optimize prompts, agent behavior, context management, and model performance to improve business outcomes.
* Ensure adherence to security, compliance, governance, and responsible AI practices.
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and enhance production AI applications for performance, reliability, and scalability.
* Participate in architecture reviews and recommend best practices for AI/ML and cloud\-native solutions.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, automation, and infrastructure deployment for AI workloads on GCP.
* Stay current with emerging GenAI technologies, frameworks, and Google Cloud innovations.

  

**Requirements**  



* 4\- 8 years of experience in software engineering, cloud application development, or AI/ML solutions.
* Hands\-on experience with **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)** services.
* Strong expertise in **Vertex AI**, Gemini models, Model Garden, and AI application deployment.
* Experience with **Google ADK (Agent Development Kit)** for building agentic AI systems.
* Proficiency in **Python** and experience with REST APIs and microservices.
* Experience implementing **RAG architectures**, vector databases (Vertex AI Vector Search, Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, etc.), and semantic search solutions.
* Understanding of prompt engineering, LLM evaluation, and AI agent orchestration.
* Experience with cloud\-native technologies including **Cloud Run, GKE, Pub/Sub, Cloud Functions, BigQuery, and Cloud Storage**.
* Knowledge of CI/CD practices, Git, Docker, and Kubernetes.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.




Preferred Qualifications


* Google Cloud certifications such as **Professional Cloud Developer**, **Professional Cloud Architect**, or **Professional Machine Learning Engineer**.
* Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or other agentic AI frameworks.
* Familiarity with enterprise integration patterns and API management.
* Experience implementing AI governance, observability, and monitoring frameworks.
* Understanding of MLOps and LLMOps best practices.

  

**Benefits**  

Competitive compensation and benefits package:

* Competitive salary and performance\-based bonuses
* Comprehensive benefits package
* Career development and training opportunities
* Flexible work arrangements (remote and/or office\-based)
* Dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally renowned group
* Private Health Insurance
* Pension Plan
* Paid Time Off
* Training \& Development

Note: Benefits differ based on employee level.

Capgemini is a global leader in partnering with companies to transform and manage their business by harnessing the power of technology. The Group is guided everyday by its purpose of unleashing human energy through technology for an inclusive and sustainable future. It is a responsible and diverse organization of over 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong 55\-year heritage and deep industry expertise, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to address the entire breadth of their business needs, from strategy and design to operations, fueled by the fast evolving and innovative world of cloud, data, AI, connectivity, software, digital engineering and platforms. The Group €22\.5 billion in revenues in 2023\.

The ideal candidate will have hands\-on expertise in **Google Agent Development Kit (ADK), Vertex AI, Gemini models, LLM integration, RAG architectures, and cloud\-native application development**. This role involves building scalable AI solutions, intelligent agents, and enterprise\-grade GenAI applications that drive business innovation.


Key Responsibilities


* Build and implement Generative AI applications leveraging **Vertex AI, Gemini models, Agent Builder, and other Google AI services**.
* Design, develop, and deploy AI agents and multi\-agent systems using **Google Agent Development Kit (ADK)**.
* Integrate AI agents with enterprise applications, APIs, databases, and third\-party systems.
* Develop orchestration workflows for autonomous, conversational, and task\-driven AI agents.
* Implement **Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG)** solutions using vector databases and enterprise knowledge sources.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, and product teams to gather requirements and translate them into scalable AI solutions.
* Optimize prompts, agent behavior, context management, and model performance to improve business outcomes.
* Ensure adherence to security, compliance, governance, and responsible AI practices.
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and enhance production AI applications for performance, reliability, and scalability.
* Participate in architecture reviews and recommend best practices for AI/ML and cloud\-native solutions.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, automation, and infrastructure deployment for AI workloads on GCP.
* Stay current with emerging GenAI technologies, frameworks, and Google Cloud innovations.

  

**Requirements**  



* 4\- 8 years of experience in software engineering, cloud application development, or AI/ML solutions.
* Hands\-on experience with **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)** services.
* Strong expertise in **Vertex AI**, Gemini models, Model Garden, and AI application deployment.
* Experience with **Google ADK (Agent Development Kit)** for building agentic AI systems.
* Proficiency in **Python** and experience with REST APIs and microservices.
* Experience implementing **RAG architectures**, vector databases (Vertex AI Vector Search, Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, etc.), and semantic search solutions.
* Understanding of prompt engineering, LLM evaluation, and AI agent orchestration.
* Experience with cloud\-native technologies including **Cloud Run, GKE, Pub/Sub, Cloud Functions, BigQuery, and Cloud Storage**.
* Knowledge of CI/CD practices, Git, Docker, and Kubernetes.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.




Preferred Qualifications


* Google Cloud certifications such as **Professional Cloud Developer**, **Professional Cloud Architect**, or **Professional Machine Learning Engineer**.
* Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or other agentic AI frameworks.
* Familiarity with enterprise integration patterns and API management.
* Experience implementing AI governance, observability, and monitoring frameworks.
* Understanding of MLOps and LLMOps best practices.

  

**Benefits**  

Competitive compensation and benefits package:

* Competitive salary and performance\-based bonuses
* Comprehensive benefits package
* Career development and training opportunities
* Flexible work arrangements (remote and/or office\-based)
* Dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally renowned group
* Private Health Insurance
* Pension Plan

**Mumbai \& Pune** 




 Experience \- 8 to 12 Years
 



  





**About Accops** 




 Accops is a leading provider of secure remote access, Zero Trust Access and Digital Workspace solutions helping enterprises enable secure work\-from\-anywhere environments. Our solutions are trusted by organizations across BFSI, Government, Healthcare, Manufacturing, IT/ITES and Enterprise sectors.
 



**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for an experienced and customer\-focused Presales Lead to drive technical solutioning, customer engagement and sales support for enterprise customers. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in virtualization, cybersecurity, endpoint management, networking and enterprise infrastructure along with excellent stakeholder management and presentation skills.
 



 The Presales Lead will work closely with Sales, Product, Engineering and Customer Success teams to understand customer requirements, design scalable solutions and support revenue growth through effective technical consulting.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Engage with enterprise customers to understand business, technical and security requirements.
* Work closely with sales teams during customer meetings, discovery sessions and technical discussions.
* Deliver product demonstrations, technical presentations, workshops and proof of concepts (POCs).
* Design and propose secure digital workspace and remote access solutions aligned with customer environments.
* Prepare solution architecture documents, technical proposals, BOMs and RFP/RFI responses.
* Lead technical discussions with CXOs, IT Heads, Security teams and infrastructure stakeholders.
* Coordinate with internal product and support teams to address customer requirements and technical escalations.
* Support channel partners and system integrators on solution positioning and technical enablement.
* Drive successful execution of POCs and ensure smooth transition to implementation teams.
* Stay updated with industry trends, cybersecurity practices and competitor offerings.
* Mentor and guide junior presales engineers and support team capability development.



**Experience \& Qualification** 



* 8\+ years of experience in Presales, Solution Consulting, Solution Architecture or Technical Sales roles.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology or related field.
* Relevant certifications in VMware, Microsoft, Networking or Cybersecurity would be an added advantage.



**Preferred Candidate Profile** 




 • Self\-driven and consultative professional with strong problem\-solving capabilities.
 



 • Experience working in a fast\-paced SaaS or cybersecurity environment.
 



 • Ability to build trusted advisor relationships with enterprise customers.
 



 • Comfortable with customer travel and onsite engagements when required.
 



**Why Join Accops?** 




 Opportunity to work with cutting\-edge cybersecurity and digital workspace solutions. Exposure to enterprise and strategic customer engagements. Collaborative and growth\-oriented work environment. Opportunity to influence solution strategy and customer transformation journeys.
