75efd000.title: Solution Architect
75efd000.description:
Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of “solutions” that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.
   

  

  

  

**There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.**
  

  

  

 Freshworks Inc. builds uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional employee and customer experiences. Our people\-first approach to AI eliminates friction, helping businesses reduce complexity, lower cost\-to\-serve, and deliver faster, more human support through enterprise\-grade yet easy\-to\-use CX and IT solutions. Nearly 75,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S\&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks to power their Employee Experience (EX) and Customer Experience (CX) operations.
   

  

  

  

**Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**



**Job Description**

 Solution Architect (SA) role is a critical internally and externally\-facing role within Freshworks Professional Services (FPS) which acts the senior technical SME heavily involved in Sales, Delivery and Expansion phases of the customer lifecycle.
   

  





 FPS SA is a trusted advisor internally and externally working with the highest level functional and technical resources within Freshworks and the customer organizations to translate business outcome requirements into scalable solutions.
   

  





**Your role and responsibilities:**



* During the Sales cycle, FPS SA will work closely with the Freshworks Presales team to understand a prospects pain points and solutions discussed to address them, and then directly interacts with the prospects leadership and functional owners to devise the best implementation approach for the identified solutions in line with industry and FPS best practices.
* During the Delivery phase, FPS SA will be the key resource who translates the high\-level solution provided during the sales cycle into detailed design information to meet the customer’s objectives and also for the FPS technical resources to implement the final solution.
* In the Expansion phase, FPS SA will work with the customer to adjust or expand their deployed capabilities by adjusting their implemented solutions to the customer’s updated needs and organizational changes.



**Some of the specific SA deliverables and activities are:**



* Product Champion: Act as a product leader in the region, instilling confidence in prospects during the sales cycle, devising innovative solutions during implementation, assessing existing enterprise customer health for improvement suggestions, and providing valuable customer feedback to the product team.
* Solution Design: Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and develop custom Freshworks product solutions in line with business goals and industry standards. Create architecture diagrams for proposed designs and deliver presentations.
* Technical Implementation: Configure, customize, and deploy Freshworks products, encompassing workflows, automation, integrations, and reporting.
* AI and Automation Solutioning: Identify opportunities for prospects and customers to leverage AI, automation, and agentic capabilities to achieve measurable business outcomes. Advise customers on the data readiness, governance, security, accuracy, adoption, and operational ownership required to successfully deploy and manage AI\-enabled solutions.
* Process Optimization: Identify areas for enhancement, proposing efficient solutions to improve operational efficiency.
* Training and Support: Provide training to customers’ support agents, administrators, and relevant teams, ensuring the proficient use of Freshworks products during deployments.
* Issue Resolution: Liaise with the Product and Engineering teams to troubleshoot and resolve technical challenges and implementation issues related to Freshworks products.
* Integrations Design: Create and integrate Freshworks products with other systems and third\-party applications to streamline 3rd\-party integrations and facilitate data flow.
* Documentation: Develop and maintain comprehensive technical and architectural documentation, covering system configurations, integrations, and customizations.
* Stay Informed: Stay updated on industry trends, Freshworks product updates, and best practices to continually enhance the capabilities of the customer support ecosystem.



**What success in this role looks like:**




 Success in this role means opportunities are accurately scoped, proposed solutions are technically feasible and supportable, delivery teams receive clear and actionable designs, architecture decisions are made quickly, risks are surfaced early, and customers have confidence in you and that the solution will meet their intended business outcomes.
   

  

  

  




**Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of professional experience in ITSM, ESM, ITOM, ITAM
* Strong technical background with custom script development and presales experience
* Ability to read complex situations with several competing constraints and identify solutions that benefit both the customers and Freshworks
* Excellent listening and presentation skills
* 5\+ years working directly with Functional and organizational leaders internally and externally
* Proficient in handling ambiguity and objections
* Skilled in negotiation and objection handling
* Experience with guiding customers in organization change management (OCM) to improve technology adoption is highly desirable.
* Experience navigating difficult technical decisions and communicating tradeoffs to executives, architects, administrators, and delivery teams.



**Required skills:**



* 7\+ years of Professional Services experience in software industry in SaaS platforms
* Previous roles in Solution Architect or Domain Architect within ITIL oriented / ITSM systems are advantageous
* A problem\-solving innovator with a knack for thinking outside the box
* Proficient at creating architecture diagrams, process maps, data\-flow diagrams, and clear design documentation.
* Extensive expertise in Enterprise landscapes across various domains, including ERP systems, Accounting Systems, HRMS, IDAM, and more
* Demonstrated experience in designing customer experience process flows
* Strong understanding of the Cloud Stack and SaaS products
* Proficiency in developing custom apps and REST API\-based integrations
* Preferred, though not mandatory, background in Javascript and NodeJS



  

  





**Preferred skills:**



* ITIL Certification
* Knowledge of Project Management principals


**Additional Information**

 At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business.
 **Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

1adeb084.title: Sr. Lead - Cloud Engineer
1adeb084.description:
**About Northern Trust**

  

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.  



  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.  



  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.  



  

  

**Sr. Lead \- Cloud Foundations Engineer**
==========================================


We are seeking a Sr. Lead \- Cloud Foundations Engineer to design, build, and maintain the core cloud infrastructure and shared services that enable our development and business teams to operate securely, reliably, and efficiently in the cloud. This role focuses on establishing the landing zones, automation, governance, and operational guardrails that form the foundation for all cloud workloads.


As a Cloud Foundations Engineer, you will work across multiple teams to ensure that our cloud environments follow best practices for security, scalability, automation, and cost optimization, while enabling self\-service adoption by application teams.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Cloud Platform Engineering**


	+ Design, implement, and maintain enterprise landing zones and shared cloud services.
	+ Manage account/subscription structures across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP.
	+ Build and enforce secure\-by\-default infrastructure patterns.
* **Infrastructure as Code \& Automation**


	+ Develop and maintain reusable IaC modules (Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep, or Pulumi).
	+ Build CI/CD pipelines to automate infrastructure deployment and updates.
	+ Enable self\-service provisioning capabilities for development teams.
* **Security, Governance \& Compliance**


	+ Implement identity and access management (IAM) best practices.
	+ Configure and maintain guardrails such as policies, SCPs, and monitoring controls.
	+ Ensure compliance with regulatory and internal security standards.
* **Networking \& Connectivity**


	+ Design and support VPC/VNet architectures, routing, firewalls, VPNs, and interconnects.
	+ Establish hybrid connectivity solutions with on\-premises environments.
* **Observability \& Cost Optimization**


	+ Deploy monitoring, logging, and auditing tools across the environment.
	+ Build dashboards to track cloud performance, security posture, and costs.
	+ Recommend and implement cost\-saving measures.
* **Collaboration \& Enablement**


	+ Partner with application, DevOps, and security teams to ensure smooth cloud adoption.
	+ Provide documentation, best practices, and training to engineering teams.
	+ Participate in incident response and troubleshooting when foundational services are impacted.

### **Qualifications**

* Education \& Experience


	+ Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
	+ 12\+ years of total work experience in Technology Infrastructure.
	+ 8\+ years of experience in cloud engineering, infrastructure, or platform operations.
* Technical Skills


	+ Deep expertise in at least one major cloud provider (Azure and AWS).
	+ Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) — Terraform preferred.
	+ Hands\-on knowledge of networking concepts (VPC, DNS, firewalls, load balancing, hybrid connectivity).
	+ Experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, etc.).
	+ Familiarity with cloud security principles and compliance frameworks.
	+ Proficiency in scripting languages (Python, Bash, PowerShell).
* Soft Skills


	+ Strong problem\-solving and troubleshooting abilities, cross\-functional collaboration skills.
	+ Excellent communication, mentorship, and ability to influence cross\-functional teams.
	+ Demonstrated ability to lead technically without direct authority.
	+ Ability to balance governance requirements with developer productivity.

### **Preferred Skills (Nice\-to\-Have)**

* Experience operating cloud platforms in regulated enterprise environments.
* Experience with multi\-cloud environments.
* Familiarity with Kubernetes and container orchestration (EKS, AKS, GKE).
* Knowledge of service mesh, API Gateways, or Serverless Platforms.
* Background in FinOps (cloud cost optimization practices).
* Cloud certifications (AWS Solutions Architect, Azure Solutions Architect, GCP Professional Cloud Architect).

### **Success Measures**

* Stable, secure, and scalable cloud foundation adopted across teams.
* Improved developer productivity through reusable frameworks and standards.
* Strong technical mentorship and uplift of data engineering capabilities.
* Reduced onboarding time and operational friction for application teams.
* Improved security posture and audit outcomes.
* Recognized as a trusted technical authority within the Cloud Foundation domain.

 **Working with Us**

  

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.  



  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.  



  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

  

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.  

  



  

**About Our Pune Office**

  

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.

  

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000\+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

**Company Profile**
**Lennox (NYSE: LII)** 
 Driven by 130 years of legacy, HVAC and refrigeration success, Lennox provides our residential and commercial customers with industry\-leading climate\-control solutions. At Lennox, we win as a team, aiming for excellence and delivering innovative, sustainable products and services. Our culture guides us and creates a workplace where all employees feel heard and welcomed. Lennox is a global community that values each team member’s contributions and offers a supportive environment for career development. Come, stay, and grow with us.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The Lead Architect owns the end\-to\-end technical design of enterprise applications built on Java and the Spring ecosystem. The role combines hands\-on architecture of cloud\-ready, event\-driven microservices with technical leadership across the software development lifecycle \- setting standards, mentoring engineers, driving engineering excellence and ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, resilient, and aligned with business goals. You will collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams, including developers, product managers, and business stakeholders, to deliver innovative and future\-proof solutions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the end\-to\-end architecture for assigned systems, from solution design through detailed component, integration, and deployment architecture.
* Translate business and product requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable technical solutions while collaborating closely with business, product, and delivery teams.
* Define and maintain architectural standards, best practices, governance frameworks, and technical roadmaps.
* Ensure non\-functional requirements including performance, scalability, security, availability, resilience, and fault tolerance are incorporated into all solutions.
* Design and oversee the development of Java\-based, cloud\-ready microservices using Spring Boot, REST APIs, and event\-driven architectures.
* Provide architectural guidance to development teams and ensure implementation aligns with the approved architecture.
* Partners with product and delivery leads to estimate effort, sequence work, and manage architectural dependencies and technical risks.
* Lead the development of new features, enhancements, and modernization initiatives across the application landscape.
* Participate in and provide technical leadership throughout the Software Development Lifecycle (requirements, design, development, testing, deployment, and support).
* Conduct architecture and code reviews to ensure compliance with coding standards, security guidelines, and quality best practices.
* Drive engineering excellence through Agile architecture, DevSecOps practices, CI/CD automation, and cloud adoption.
* Optimize application performance, troubleshooting complex technical issues, and continuously improving system reliability.
* Mentor architects and senior developers while fostering collaboration, innovation, and technical excellence.
* Promote knowledge sharing through technical documentation, architecture artifacts, workshops, and training sessions.
* Stay current with emerging technologies and evaluate their applicability to improve business outcomes and engineering capabilities


**Qualifications**
* 10–12 years of experience in enterprise application development, with at least 3\+ years in a Solution Architect or Technical Lead role.
* Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise\-scale, distributed applications and microservices.
* Strong expertise in Java SE/EE and Spring ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security).
* Proficiency in Java as the primary language, with working knowledge of Python or JavaScript as an advantage.
* Experience designing RESTful APIs, microservices, event\-driven architectures, and integration using SOAP where required.
* Experience with messaging platforms such as Kafka or RabbitMQ and API Gateway technologies.
* Strong knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server) and database design principles.
* Familiarity with front\-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and frameworks like React.
* Experience with Git and modern software development workflows.
* Experience implementing DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and cloud\-native deployment patterns.
* Hands\-on experience with a major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Familiarity with observability and monitoring tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) and SLO/SLA definition.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues.
* Ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions aligned with enterprise architecture.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience collaborating across engineering teams, business stakeholders, and senior leadership.
* Ability to influence technical decisions and drive architectural governance across multiple teams.

384ee647.title: Sr. Solution specialist
384ee647.description:
**Overview**
 Emmes Group: Building a better future for us all.
   

  

 Emmes Group is transforming the future of clinical research, bringing the promise of new medical discovery closer within reach for patients. Emmes Group was founded as Emmes more than 47 years ago, becoming one of the primary clinical research providers to the US government before expanding into public\-private partnerships and commercial biopharma. Emmes has built industry leading capabilities in cell and gene therapy, vaccines and infectious diseases, ophthalmology, rare diseases, and neuroscience.

We’re looking for talented professionals eager to help advance clinical research as we work to embed innovation into the fabric of our company. If you share our motivations and passion in research, come join us!

 **Solution Specialist – Clinical Systems \& EDC Services**

 This role will serve as a key bridge between Product, Sales, Clinical Operations, Delivery, and Technology teams to showcase platform capabilities, support customer engagements, and maintain high\-quality demo and sandbox environments for internal and external stakeholders.

* Project/Study configuration and manage sandbox/demo environments

 When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. You will blend sales skills, market knowledge, and technical engagement to prove the value of the Google Cloud portfolio.
   

  

 It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go\-To\-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. cefdbbda.description:
**Overview**
 Microsoft Industry Solutions Delivery is a global organization hosting over 6,000 strategic sellers, industry and security experts, elite engineers, world\-class data scientists and architects, consultants, and delivery specialists. Together with our partners, we help Microsoft’s most strategic customers worldwide to address their specific challenges and provide comprehensive and industry\-specific solutions that meet their unique needs.
   

  

 Our organization is at the forefront of innovation, driving value across the entirety of the customers’ digital and AI transformation journey through repeatable and customized cutting\-edge solutions powered by Microsoft Cloud and AI. We take pride in embodying Microsoft's mission of empowerment, promoting a growth mindset, inspiring excellence, and fostering a culture of inclusivity where everyone is encouraged to share their unique perspectives and be their authentic selves. By joining our team, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to life\-changing innovations that impact billions of people worldwide.
   

  

 The Solution Architect is responsible for translating the client’s business requirements into specific systems, applications, or process designs for very large complex technology solutions and architectures. You’ll act as an advocate for the client as the ultimate authority on the architecture designed to address client business problems. You’ll provide direction for design activities, often project\-based, sometimes working at customer sites.
   

  

 As a Solution Architect you’ll gather customer/partner insights from a broad range of stakeholders to shape and form both the definition and ongoing execution of projects. You’ll define and document the architecture to communicate the value proposition of the business solution along with the project approach. Collaborating with the Project Manager you’ll jointly drive project/technical governance of the design, build, and deployment into use. You’ll work with the business sponsor and customer/partner stakeholders to gather and ratify requirements and constraints and collaborating with the Account Team and/or Bid Team to understand the business solution/problem. This role is flexible in that you can work up to 50% from home.
   

  

 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Responsibilities \-
   

  

 You will gather customer/partner insights from a broad range of stakeholders as well as the main business sponsor to shape and form both the definition and ongoing execution of projects and work with customer/partner stakeholders and business sponsor to socialize both the business solution and the project approach to determine if changes are needed to the business solution.
   

  

* You will use evidence\-based approach to represent the customer/partner as a customer advocate and share insights with Product Engineering teams and the business with a view to improving Microsoft technologies, products, services and offerings such that they can better meet customer/partner needs across a territory.
* You will define and document the Architecture through an architecture description document, an architecture decisions log, and a requirements/constraints traceability matrix to communicate the value proposition of the business solution along with the project approach.
* You will work with customers to understand and demonstrate business value (e.g., release of revenue, cost savings) that the business solution realizes and manage and resolve ambiguity in the requirements and constraints and documents assumptions and implications where it cannot be resolved.

(AWS India) well within a customer environment and drive discussions with senior personnel within the company, as well as a technical background that enables them to easily interact and give guidance to software developers and architects in India. e7a89c3d.description:
**Company Profile**
**Lennox (NYSE: LII)** 
 Driven by 130 years of legacy, HVAC and refrigeration success, Lennox provides our residential and commercial customers with industry\-leading climate\-control solutions. At Lennox, we win as a team, aiming for excellence and delivering innovative, sustainable products and services. Our culture guides us and creates a workplace where all employees feel heard and welcomed. Lennox is a global community that values each team member’s contributions and offers a supportive environment for career development. Come, stay, and grow with us.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The Lead Architect owns the end\-to\-end technical design of enterprise applications built on Java and the Spring ecosystem. The role combines hands\-on architecture of cloud\-ready, event\-driven microservices with technical leadership across the software development lifecycle \- setting standards, mentoring engineers, driving engineering excellence and ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, resilient, and aligned with business goals. You will collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams, including developers, product managers, and business stakeholders, to deliver innovative and future\-proof solutions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the end\-to\-end architecture for assigned systems, from solution design through detailed component, integration, and deployment architecture.
* Translate business and product requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable technical solutions while collaborating closely with business, product, and delivery teams.
* Define and maintain architectural standards, best practices, governance frameworks, and technical roadmaps.
* Ensure non\-functional requirements including performance, scalability, security, availability, resilience, and fault tolerance are incorporated into all solutions.
* Design and oversee the development of Java\-based, cloud\-ready microservices using Spring Boot, REST APIs, and event\-driven architectures.
* Provide architectural guidance to development teams and ensure implementation aligns with the approved architecture.
* Partners with product and delivery leads to estimate effort, sequence work, and manage architectural dependencies and technical risks.
* Lead the development of new features, enhancements, and modernization initiatives across the application landscape.
* Participate in and provide technical leadership throughout the Software Development Lifecycle (requirements, design, development, testing, deployment, and support).
* Conduct architecture and code reviews to ensure compliance with coding standards, security guidelines, and quality best practices.
* Drive engineering excellence through Agile architecture, DevSecOps practices, CI/CD automation, and cloud adoption.
* Optimize application performance, troubleshooting complex technical issues, and continuously improving system reliability.
* Mentor architects and senior developers while fostering collaboration, innovation, and technical excellence.
* Promote knowledge sharing through technical documentation, architecture artifacts, workshops, and training sessions.
* Stay current with emerging technologies and evaluate their applicability to improve business outcomes and engineering capabilities


**Qualifications**
* 10–12 years of experience in enterprise application development, with at least 3\+ years in a Solution Architect or Technical Lead role.
* Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise\-scale, distributed applications and microservices.
* Strong expertise in Java SE/EE and Spring ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security).
* Proficiency in Java as the primary language, with working knowledge of Python or JavaScript as an advantage.
* Experience designing RESTful APIs, microservices, event\-driven architectures, and integration using SOAP where required.
* Experience with messaging platforms such as Kafka or RabbitMQ and API Gateway technologies.
* Strong knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server) and database design principles.
* Familiarity with front\-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and frameworks like React.
* Experience with Git and modern software development workflows.
* Experience implementing DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and cloud\-native deployment patterns.
* Hands\-on experience with a major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Familiarity with observability and monitoring tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) and SLO/SLA definition.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues.
* Ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions aligned with enterprise architecture.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience collaborating across engineering teams, business stakeholders, and senior leadership.
* Ability to influence technical decisions and drive architectural governance across multiple teams.

67d3ba6e.title: Solution Architect - ITS, IT/ITES Vertical
67d3ba6e.description:
**Description**
 Sales, Marketing and Global Services (SMGS)
   

  

 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.
   

  

 AWS Solutions Architects are trusted advisors to our customers, helping them solve some of their largest business challenges by designing and advising on some of the most scalable, flexible and resilient solutions in the world.
   

  

 Working closely with internal teams at AWS, you’ll identify how our customers push the boundaries and how we can improve our services to obsess over our customers.
   

  

 Being a thought leader who creates and presents content you’ll help all of our customers scale and grow in non\-linear ways, using AWS as their building blocks.
   

  

 In this role, you will push technology boundaries and help scale some of the Emerging companies across various Verticals in India. You will have the opportunity to partner with customers early in their cloud journey and help them scale as well as customers further in their cloud journey where you can have visible and measurable impact in their growth ambitions.
   

  

 You will test traditional thinking by pushing the boundaries for your customers and AWS to dream and deliver beyond what they think is possible.
   

  

 Our customers’ needs are moving fast, so you will too. Be part of the team helping our Emergin customers find innovative and transformative ways to reinvent their business!
   

  

 \#aws\-ags\-India
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Work directly with customers to accelerate their business outcomes and recommend best\-practice cloud architectures in line with their long\-term business needs.
   

  

* Drive technical solutions discussions with your customers, diving deep into the details to solve complex technical problems and use your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures.
* Scope and own customer engagements, with attention towards clear and well\-defined objectives and success criteria.
* Work backwards from your customer's business needs to accelerate adoption of the most appropriate AWS technology
* Define and execute on the strategy by engaging highly technical teams (Solutions Architects, Technical Account Managers, AWS professional services consultants and consulting/managed services partners).
* Act as a thought leader in the wider community, playing a key role in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops.
* Share the voice of the customer to influence the roadmap of new features and services for the AWS platform. Proactively work within the organisation to influence the evolution of the platform.
* Serve as a key technical member of the Solutions Architecture team through influencing decision makers across multiple domains to ensure customer success in building applications and services on the AWS platform which align to long\-term business goals.


 A day in the life
   

  

 Our solutions architects are experienced technologists with technical breadth and depth coupled with strong interpersonal skills. The variety of customers is huge as we work across all industries within the SMB segment, like FSI, Retail , IT\& ITeS , Media and Entertainment to name a few. On a daily basis you will work alongside people who are leading the way in designing cloud bases architecture. We are the trusted advisor to our customers, so challenge our customers to think differently, learn more build elegant, transformative solutions!
   

  

 As a Solutions Architect you’ll own the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS and make recommendations on security, cost, performance, reliability and operational efficiency. They work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. To do this they collaborate with other teams such as account management, professional services, support, product teams and the AWS partner ecosystem.
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of cloud architecture
* 3\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 7\+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
* 7\+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics) experience


**Preferred Qualifications**

**Cloud Infrastructure \& DevOps Engineer** 




  





 Peryx.ai · Ahmedabad · Full\-time · 2 – 4 years experience
 



**Candidates must be based in Ahmedabad or willing to relocate.** 




  





**About the role** 




  





 Peryx.ai is building a renewable energy intelligence platform for solar, wind and energy storage assets.
 



  





 We're looking for a hands\-on Cloud Infrastructure \& DevOps Engineer to build and manage the AWS infrastructure behind our platform. You'll work directly with the engineering team across deployments, automation, monitoring, security and production operations.
 



  





 This is a build\-and\-own role and not just maintaining pipelines or infrastructure tickets.
 



  





**What you'll work on** 




  





 \- Build and manage infrastructure on AWS
 



 \- Deploy containerised backend services using Docker
 



 \- Build and maintain infrastructure using Terraform
 



 \- Set up and improve CI/CD pipelines
 



 \- Manage VPCs, networking, IAM, DNS, TLS and secrets
 



 \- Deploy and operate databases, caching and storage services
 



 \- Support infrastructure for MQTT, IoT data ingestion and streaming
 



 \- Set up monitoring, logging and alerting
 



 \- Handle backups and basic disaster recovery
 



 \- Troubleshoot infrastructure and deployment issues
 



 \- Improve reliability, security, scalability and AWS costs
 



  





**What we're looking for** 




  





 \- 2–4 years of hands\-on AWS / DevOps / Cloud Infrastructure experience
 



 \- Good understanding of AWS architecture and core services
 



 \- Practical experience with Docker and Terraform
 



 \- Experience with CI/CD
 



 \- Comfortable with Linux, networking, VPCs, DNS and TLS
 



 \- Working knowledge of IAM and cloud security
 



 \- Experience with databases and cloud storage
 



 \- Basic scripting in Python or Bash
 



 \- Able to independently troubleshoot production issues
 



 \- Comfortable taking a requirement and implementing it end to end
 



  





**Good to have** 




  





 Experience with some of these is useful, but we don't expect you to know all of them:
 



  





 ECS/Fargate · PostgreSQL/TimescaleDB · Redis · MQTT · Kafka/MSK · GitHub Actions · CloudWatch · OpenTelemetry · Prometheus · Grafana
 



  





 Experience with IoT, SCADA or renewable energy systems is a bonus, but not required.
 



  





**How we use AI** 




  





 Peryx is an AI\-native engineering company. We expect engineers to use AI tools for implementation, debugging, testing and documentation where they help move faster.
 



  





 AI tools will be provided by us. What matters is that you understand, validate and take responsibility for what you ship.
 



  





**How we work** 




  





 We're a small engineering team, so you'll work directly with the founders and developers and have meaningful ownership of the infrastructure you build.
 



  





 We value people who can understand a problem, make sensible technical decisions, build the solution and operate it reliably.
 



  





**Apply** 




  





 Send your CV to careers@peryx.ai along with a short note about one cloud or infrastructure system you've personally built or operated, what you were responsible for, and one interesting problem you had to solve.

9210d72e.title: Delivery Manager
9210d72e.description:
**DASH TECHNOLOGIES**
*Dublin, Ohio \| ISO 9001\-Certified IT Services \& Staffing*
**Senior Delivery Manager – US Public Sector IT Talent Acquisition**
**Location: Remote (India)**
**Shift: US\-aligned evening/night hours only.**
**About Dash Technologies**
 Headquartered in Dublin, Ohio and founded in 2010, Dash Technologies Inc. is an ISO 9001\-certified, fast\-growing IT services and staffing organization serving enterprise and US government clients. Recognized by Inc. Magazine among Columbus's fastest\-growing private companies, Dash partners with 25\+ US state government agencies and federal stakeholders on mission\-critical technology programs — from AI strategy implementation and cloud modernization to large\-scale digital transformation.
   

  

 Our US Public Sector practice is in a high\-growth phase, and we're scaling our India\-based delivery engine to match. We're looking for a hands\-on senior leader to build, modernize, and run it — someone with deep US IT staffing experience who's excited about AI\-powered recruiting.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This is a senior, hands\-on leadership role for a recruitment professional who has spent years inside US IT staffing — specifically delivering against state, local, and federal government requisitions — and now wants to modernize a fast\-growing public sector practice with AI, automation, and a sharper pipeline strategy. You will own US public sector recruitment delivery from India, working in US time zones and partnering directly with Dash leadership on weekly cadence.
   

  

 You will not just run requisitions. You will redesign how they get run — choosing the ATS and AI tools that fit, building reusable benches, automating low\-value steps, and raising the quality bar on every candidate that goes to a client. You bring technology fundamentals, genuine curiosity about where the staffing industry is heading, and the self\-starter energy to turn a directive into a working system.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
**Public Sector Delivery (State, Local, Federal)**
* Run end\-to\-end contingent and contract\-to\-hire delivery across state agencies, county and city IT offices, and federal engagements.
* Manage requisition intake, sourcing, submissions, interview coordination, offer, and onboarding through MSP/VMS platforms — Beeline, SAP Fieldglass, VectorVMS, PeopleFluent, Dotstaff, and state\-specific portals.
* Own SLAs that matter: time\-to\-submit, submission\-to\-interview, interview\-to\-fill, fill rate, and 90\-day attrition. Target 95%\+ fill rate on priority requisitions.
* Lead account\-level QBRs with US client partners and translate scorecards into operational changes on the India delivery floor.


**AI, Automation \& Productivity — The Differentiator**
* Select, configure, and operate the modern recruitment tech stack: AI\-first ATS platforms, sourcing intelligence, and outreach automation.
* Deploy AI for resume parsing, candidate\-job match scoring, JD generation, screening note summarization, and interview transcription — with human\-in\-the\-loop controls.
* Build (or help build) lightweight AI agents and automated workflows — not just use off\-the\-shelf AI tools — to cut recruiter admin time by 30–40% and shift the team's focus to conversations, not data entry. This is a hands\-on capability we want to grow.
* Build dashboards and reusable templates that compound productivity across the team.


**Quality, Pipeline \& Bench Strategy**
* Run a structured QA/QC layer on every submission: technical fit, communication, location/clearance match, rate alignment, document compliance — before it touches a client portal.
* Lead candidate interview prep: behavioral coaching, client\-specific briefings, mock technicals, and follow\-up debriefs — so submitted candidates arrive ready.
* Build warm benches and named\-talent pools for repeat skill profiles (Mainframe, Salesforce public sector, ServiceNow, AWS/Azure cloud architects, data engineering, QA automation, cybersecurity, AI/ML).
* Identify and incubate bench projects — investing in a small, pre\-vetted cohort that can be deployed quickly when state requisitions drop.


**Compliance, Visa \& Documentation**
* Own end\-to\-end compliance for public sector hiring: E\-Verify, I\-9, state\-specific clearances, and background checks.
* Manage the visa landscape with confidence — and help the team stay current on compliance nuances.


**CEO Partnership \& Strategy**
* Work in a direct, regular cadence with Dash leadership — translating growth strategy into staffing plans, surfacing market signals from the floor, and shaping pricing and capacity decisions.
* Represent the India delivery engine in US client conversations when needed; comfortable presenting numbers, owning misses, and proposing fixes.
* Contribute to RFPs, capability statements, and case studies for new state pursuits.


**Team Leadership**
* Build and mentor a high\-performance recruiter pod — set standards for productivity, ethics, and client communication; invest in their growth.


**Tools \& Tech Stack You'll Work With**
*You'll be fluent in most of these by day one; we'll bring you fully current on the rest.*
* ATS / CRM: CEIPAL
* Bullhorn
* JobDiva
* MSP / VMS: Beeline
* SAP Fieldglass
* VectorVMS
* Dotstaff
* Sourcing \& Intelligence: LinkedIn Recruiter
* Apollo.io
* ZoomInfo
* Indeed Resume
* Dice
* AI \& Automation: Claude
* ChatGPT/GPT\-5
* Gemini
* Copilot
* Eightfold (FedRAMP\-Moderate)
* Paradox
* Textio
* HireVue
* Productivity \& Analytics: Excel (advanced)
* Power BI/Looker
* Microsoft 365
* Slack
* Zapier/Make
* Google Workspace


**What You Bring**
**Must Have**
* Experience: 7–8 years in US IT staffing delivery (recruiting, account management, bench sales, or delivery leadership). Ready to run point on delivery, ideally with at least 3–5 years in US public sector or federal hiring. If you have strong general US IT staffing experience, we'll deepen your public sector expertise on the job.
* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or related technology field — preferred. We weigh demonstrated capability over institute pedigree, but technical literacy is non\-negotiable (you should read a JD for a senior cloud architect and understand what it means).
* Tooling: Comfortable in at least one modern ATS platform. Familiarity with VMS/MSP concepts (Beeline, Fieldglass, VectorVMS, PeopleFluent) — hands\-on experience a plus, not a requirement.
* AI Fluency: You already use AI tools daily in your work (sourcing, screening, writing, summarization) and you're genuinely excited — not intimidated — by the idea of building your own lightweight AI agents or automations. This isn't just tool usage; it's the engine that will modernize how we recruit.
* Communication: Fluent, professional English — written and verbal — comfortable engaging directly with US stakeholders and the CEO.
* Ownership: Self\-starter, dynamic, and creative. Comfortable turning a one\-line directive into a working plan, sourcing the right tools, and hitting a deadline. No analysis paralysis.


**Strong Plus / Differentiators**
* 3–5\+ years of direct experience with US public sector or federal civilian hiring (state agencies, county/city IT offices, federal civilian programs, or GSA schedules).
* Hands\-on with 2\+ ATS and 2\+ VMS/MSP platforms — you've shipped change in these systems, not just used them.
* Built or rolled out an automation or AI\-agent playbook (Zapier, Make, custom GPT workflows, simple Claude\-based agents) inside a recruiting or delivery workflow.
* Track record mentoring or training recruiters into senior roles.
* Genuine curiosity about emerging tech trends — agentic AI, talent intelligence platforms, skills\-based hiring, gov\-tech modernization. You read, you experiment, you bring ideas back.


**What We Offer**
* A chance to modernize how a fast\-growing, $25M\+ staffing practice recruits for the US public sector — backed by strong leadership and real budget for tools and hiring.
* Direct partnership with Dash's CEO and leadership team — you'll have visibility, agency, and input on strategic decisions.
* The freedom to design your own workflow — choose your ATS, build your own automations, shape the bench strategy. This isn't a role where you inherit someone else's system; you get to build it.
* Competitive salary, performance bonus, and benefits package (details in a follow\-up conversation).
* Remote from India with hybrid flexibility — you pick your setup.

4fbb3122.title: Client Engagement Manager
4fbb3122.description:
Most agencies fail their clients quietly. Not by missing sprints, but by building exactly what was asked for while the underlying problem goes untouched. Axelerant exists to be the partner that doesn't do that: the one that understands a client's business well enough to tell them when the request is a symptom, and is credible enough on their platform to be believed.
 



  





 The Client Engagement Manager is where that promise either holds or breaks. You're the person closest to both the client's business and our delivery reality, and the only one positioned to keep them honest with each other.
 



  





 The role carries that responsibility both commercially and substantively. You own the client relationship and the health of an assigned portfolio across Axelerant's three engagement models — Managed Projects, Staff Augmentation, and CD\&M (Continuous Delivery \& Maintenance) — reframing what clients ask for into what they actually need, advising credibly on what their platform can and cannot do, protecting margin while growing the account, and turning delivery outcomes into narratives the rest of the business can use. Accountable for retention, engagement margin, and qualified growth within the portfolio.
 



  




**What you'll do** 

  




* **Business \& product intelligence**



 Reframe what clients ask for into what they actually need — connecting observed business pain points to defined problems, user needs, and expected outcomes before implementation begins. Validate commercially meaningful opportunities through user, task, or process research rather than accepting the obvious answer. Where investment decisions are in play, build the business case and quantify the ROI.
 



  




* **Platform \& transformation advisory**



 Hold credible architecture and feasibility conversations without a developer in the room, and never mislead a client about what their platform can do. Identify digital maturity gaps and sequence delivery initiatives against the client's transformation path, not just their backlog. Track platform and market shifts and advise how they should shape roadmap direction.
 



  




* **Stakeholder influence**



 Keep the delivery team aligned with clear requirements, clarifications, and risks, and keep the client aligned through structured options rather than status narration. Present risks and implications at the altitude the decision sits — analyst, manager, director, or executive. Lead alignment conversations with scenarios and business cases when the decision is strategic.
 



  




* **Delivery \& commercial ownership**



 Own both the outcome and the margin: maintain a ready backlog with clear acceptance criteria, run structured UAT, and ensure delivery holds to the agreed engagement model. Raise out\-of\-scope changes and budget risk early, and manage change requests through commercially aware decisions that protect margin while creating room to expand. Orchestrate multi\-team, multi\-workstream delivery and lead the change management that keeps it viable.
 



  




* **AI fluency**



 Automate the routine layer of delivery — summaries, status updates, risk logs, dependency tracking — so attention goes to judgement work. Integrate AI agents into engagement workflows for forecasting, risk detection, scenario modelling, and reporting to improve predictability and decision quality. At portfolio scale, govern how those agentified workflows operate and where they're trusted.
 



  




* **Advocacy**



 Maintain a running account of the meaningful moments, decisions, and outcomes inside each engagement, and share updates rich enough that progress is visible without being asked for. Distribute account context to the sales, marketing, and delivery people who need it rather than holding it in your head. Convert real outcomes into client\-approved case studies, quotes, and reference calls.
 



  




**What we're looking for** 

  




* **6\+ years in client\-facing delivery, with at least 3 years as the primary owner of a client relationship** 
 — meaning you, not a salesperson or a delivery head above you, were the person the client called about scope, budget, and escalations.



  




* **Direct accountability for engagement margin on $500K\+ of annual portfolio value.** 
 You should be able to describe a specific commercial decision you made — a change request you priced, a scope line you held, a model you switched — and what it did to margin.



  




* **Hands\-on ownership of Agile delivery** 
 across at least two of Fixed Price, Time \& Materials, Staff Augmentation, and CD\&M (Continuous Delivery \& Maintenance) — including backlog and acceptance criteria, UAT, release readiness, and how scope control differs by model.



  




* **Enough technical depth in a CMS or DXP ecosystem to advise a client without a developer present** 
 — Drupal strongly preferred, or comparable (Adobe, Sitecore, Contentful, WordPress VIP). You must be able to tell a client "no, and here's why, and here's the alternative" and be right.



  




* **A documented expansion you originated.** 
 Not an upsell you were handed — an opportunity you saw because you understood the client's business, qualified, and closed or handed to close.



  




* **Written communication that leads with decisions.** 
 Candidates will be asked to produce a short client\-facing options memo as part of the process; status\-narration writing will not pass.



  




* **Working overlap with US or EU business hours** 
 , and comfort operating as the conscious and value\-driven Axelerant voice in a room of client directors.

1ff28ac1.title: Sr. Engagement Manager, AWS Professional Services India
1ff28ac1.description:
**Description**
 AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
   

  

 We are looking for a Senior Engagement Manager to lead and deliver complex, multi\-workstream cloud transformation programs for AWS Professional Services (ProServe) India. In this role, you will own the end\-to\-end delivery lifecycle of large and complex customer engagements, shaping cloud strategies, driving business outcomes, and acting as a trusted advisor to senior customer stakeholders.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is an experienced program leader with deep IT consulting expertise, a proven track record in delivering complex technical programs across enterprise customers, and the ability to navigate ambiguity with limited guidance. You thrive in a fast\-paced, growth environment, insist on incredibly high standards, and are passionate about mentoring others and scaling delivery best practices across teams.
   

  

 You will lead matrixed teams of AWS consultants, partners, and customer resources across multiple workstreams simultaneously. You are expected to drive delivery excellence, maximize engagement value, manage risks proactively, and serve as a force multiplier for your peers and the broader organization. You will actively contribute to pre\-sales, build deep customer trust, and leverage AI/GenAI to drive delivery innovation.
   

  

 In this capacity you will be based in India and are expected to travel occasionally (30\-40%). You will report into the India ProServe Engagement Management Delivery Practice Manager.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Own and lead end\-to\-end delivery of complex, multi\-workstream cloud transformation programs, ensuring business outcomes are achieved within schedule, scope, and financial constraints.
* Shape and validate cloud delivery strategies for complex engagements, applying frameworks such as the Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF), Well\-Architected Framework (WAF), and Engagement Delivery Framework (EDF).
* Serve as a strategic advisor to senior customer stakeholders, leading steering committees, driving alignment, and building deep trusted relationships.
* Proactively identify, manage, and escalate risks and issues; develop and execute mitigation plans; redirect distressed programs to delight customers.
* Maximize engagement value by negotiating conditions of acceptance, managing scope changes, and amending contractual terms within project constraints.
* Drive delivery excellence across engagements by defining and sharing EM best practices, creating reusable mechanisms, and establishing operational excellence.
* Actively mentor and develop team members; perform Technical Promotion Assessments (TPAs) and coach Engagement Managers to raise the bar.
* Participate in pre\-sales activities, contributing to proposals, scoping, and business development for complex services engagements.
* Leverage Agentic AI and GenAI to optimize delivery processes, improve team productivity, and drive innovative customer outcomes.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional AWS teams including Delivery Consultants, Account Executives, Cloud Architects, and Partner teams to solution and deliver cloud programs.


**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale experience
* 7\+ years of leading and delivering enterprise\-level IT engagements experience
* Knowledge of the value proposition of the public cloud and cloud engagement delivery (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS)
* Experience with Agile and project management toolsets like Jira, Rally, VersionOne or Taiga
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 7\+ years of project/program management experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working with and presenting to C\-level executives, IT, and lines of businesses across organizations or equivalent
* PMP, Prince2, PgMP, SAFe or SCRUM/Agile certification
* 9\+ years of working with Data \& AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage experience
* AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification
* Partner delivery experience — enabling and managing delivery through third\-party partners


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

* Experience working in SaaS or subscription\-based business models, with a deep understanding of recurring revenue streams or enterprise customer lifecycles.
* Experience in software development workflows (code review, testing) and define quality metrics for automated systems.
* Experience managing end\-to\-end product lifecycles and large\-scale rollouts.


**About The Job**
 A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.
   

  

 Google Workspace is home to billions of users and millions of businesses. The Workspace Monetization (Commerce and Admin Experience) team is at the heart of our commercial strategy and enterprise customer lifecycle.
   

  

 As a Technical Program Manager on this team, you will lead complex, cross\-functional programs that define how we monetize the next generation of AI\-powered productivity.
   

  

 Our team is responsible for the end\-to\-end customer lifecycle journey in Workspace. We focus on developing value\-capture strategies, managing usage limits, mitigating abuse, optimizing purchase flows, and minimizing customer churn for millions of global businesses. Building core infrastructure for metering, billing, and invoicing based on SKUs and resource consumption. Modernizing our enterprise administration platforms, advancing mobile administration tools, and deploying AI agents and assistants to streamline IT operations. Building robust auditing and reporting platforms, deploying AI\-driven diagnostics, and designing seamless migration and onboarding pathways for enterprise and small business customers.
   

  

 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with team members and stakeholders to understand or identify defined work problems and program goals, obtain prioritized deliverables, and discuss program impact.
* Prioritize program goals, understand and translate other stakeholders’ needs into program goals and prioritized deliverables with minimal assistance, and contribute to decisions on prioritizing goals and deliverables.
* Define the scope of projects and develop, execute, or manage project plans for supported programs.
* Review key metrics pertaining to a program, monitor potential metric deviations, and define corrective actions for critical deviations.
* Identify, communicate, and collaborate with relevant stakeholders within one or more teams to drive impact and work toward mutual goals. Build, maintain and enhance business, operational, and management dashboards. Build relationships and manage complex dependencies across core product teams, Payments, Risk, Legal, and Privacy departments.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. a82e4bbd.title: Technical Program Manager, World Wide Returns & Recommerce
a82e4bbd.description:
**Description**
 No other single team in Amazon provide exposure to end to end life cycle of e\-commerce: Welcome to World Wide Returns, and Re\-commerce (WWR\&R). We redefines e\-commerce and start where the typical e\-commerce supply chain stops. We innovate to support net\-zero carbon, Amazon climate pledge and works backwards from there. In most cases, our work starts even before customer purchases: in providing information about return policies on detail page/search \& during check\-out. and developing products to support end to end post purchase support needs. We support all post purchase customer needs starting from product usage troubleshooting support to return experience, transportation, reverse\-fulfillment, reverse supply chain and reselling. We provide returns as a service to for WW Amazon business across all channels (Retail, FBA, Merchant Fulfillment) and subsidiaries (Zappos, Woot), Customer Service applications and Amazon physical stores.
   

  

 Amazon Returns policies \& experience are foundational to Amazon’s e\-Commerce and one of the primary reasons why customers love shopping on Amazon. Returns policy communication on the detail page is among the top detail\-page features that increases Customer confidence and the Customer Trust Perception Index (CTPI) for purchase decision. This team has revolutionized the returns for customers through simplest possible experience with no need to print label \& do packaging and quickest refund time. Providing Great Returns Experience is complex due to negative customer sentiments while returning the product. Our team has been very successful in ensuring the lowest return rates and best in class return experience for Amazon as against other E\-commerce competitors.
   

  

 Below are some of the videos explaining the journey and CX of our team :
   

  

* Main Video (https://broadcast.amazon.com/videos/415554\) (6m 40s): Overview of R\&R Business
* Introduction to Seller options (https://broadcast.amazon.com/videos/415558\) (1m 44s): Overview of Seller Return \& Recovery options
* Introduction to LFBF (https://broadcast.amazon.com/videos/416088\) (1m 46s): Introduction to Label\-Free/Box\-Free returns


 The team is expanding its charter and is going to hire 50\+ employees in 2022 across all tech roles to define returns \& recovery options as a service for its merchant, FBA, bulk and Amazon business customers and to solve hard technical problems related to optimization of reverse supply chain channel. As a member of this team, your mission will be to evolve returns \& re\-commerce systems as highly modular \& customizable multi\-tenet platform to enable growth of e\-commerce business \& volumes and not only reduce cost of reverse supply chain but to even make it profitable business. You will be using wide range of AWS services, Java, object\-oriented design patterns, and latest storage, workflow, orchestration and UI technologies to build and deliver software systems that support complex and rapidly evolving re\-commerce business requirements.
   

  

 We are looking for software engineers with 3\+ years of solid Software engineering experience involving solving complex problems. They will get to work on some of the key initiatives planned to support our rapid evolution and growth and in the process solve some of the most challenging problems. These engineers will provide the technical leadership to the team, drive best practices, mentor other engineers and drive continuous improvements in engineering excellence.
   

  

 We are a group that has fun at work while driving incredible customer, business, and environmental impact. We are backed by a strong leadership group dedicated to operational excellence that empowers a reasonable work\-life balance. As an established, experienced team, we offer the scope and support needed for substantial career growth.
   

  

 Amazon is earth’s most customer\-centric company and through WW R\&R, the earth is our customer too. Come join us and innovate with the Amazon Worldwide Returns, \& ReCommerce team!

* 5\+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

**Description**
 Amazon's Accounts Payables Technology team, part of FinAuto (Finance Automation), is transforming financial operations through next\-generation automation powered by agentic AI. We process trillions in annual transactions across every Amazon business worldwide, including AWS, Stores, and Digital. Our team is building intelligent systems that optimize the entire order\-to\-cash lifecycle, from sales through billing and collections. We're seeking a hands\-on technical leader to drive our automation vision forward.
   

  

 As Amazon's financial operations grow exponentially with business expansion, traditional approaches to scaling through human operations are no longer sufficient. Our team is at the forefront of solving this challenge through innovative automation solutions that combine artificial intelligence, machine learning, and enterprise\-grade workflows to transform how financial operations work.
   

  

 As a Technical Program manager,
   

  

* You are responsible for managing the lifecycle of a complex cross\-functional program with considerable impact.
* Your program may focus on a single product in a critical technology area or you may work more broadly, managing larger initiatives that span organizations or geographies in support of a larger business objective.
* You may also be responsible for the delivery of large and complex projects that may or may not be tied to a larger program.
* You may be assigned to manage the roadmap for an organization, which may include contributing to OP1/OP2 narratives, and ownership of one or more organizational goals.
* As a senior technology program owner, you are accountable for the overall strategy as well as driving teams inside and outside your organization to deliver.
* You are able to define the program (mission, vision, tenets), set objectives, analyze data, drive improvements that are quantified with metrics, and influence resource allocation.
* You understand the systems in your product or program space, their limitations, scaling factors, boundary conditions, and reasons behind architectural decisions


 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* To ensure business and technical stakeholder needs are aligned, you drive mindful discussions that lead to crisp decisions.
* You provide context (past, current, and future) for business/technology choices and a long\-term perspective.
* You partner with customers and engineering teams to determine which projects move forward and in what priority order.
* You use your technical judgment to question proposals and test assumptions (Q. Do we need to build this at all?).
* You enlist Senior/Principal Engineer to ensure architecture(s) scale (or will scale) to match the “think big” business case.
* You make smart trade\-offs (e.g., time vs. effort vs. features).
* You create plans that have clear, measurable success criteria. You clearly communicate progress and outcomes.
* You oversee the gap between teams, processes, and system architectures. You help teams/your organization reduce exposure to classic failure modes (e.g., requirements not sufficiently understood/documented, ineffective cross\-team collaboration, long\-term impact(s) from of the use of third\-party technologies, APIs not protected/hardened, insufficient testing/gaps in QA).
* You solve ambiguous problems and proactively identify and mitigate risks (before they become roadblocks). You demonstrate good judgment in how and when to escalate (without damaging relationships).
* You are data\-driven. You regularly review metrics and proactively seek out new and improved data/mechanisms for visibility. You ensure your program stays aligned with organizational objectives.
* You understand technical program management and engineering best practices. You may be asked to use your knowledge to assess development processes, test plans, and operations/maintenance requirements.
* You work with teams to improve concurrent project delivery. You streamline and/or eliminate excess process.
* You influence teams to decouple from dependencies and eliminate architecture problems that stifle innovation or cause user dissatisfaction, development collisions, and/or outages.
* You are an excellent communicator. You write effective narratives (Amazon 6\-pager) and present them effectively to Directors and VPs. You routinely deliver the right things with limited guidance. \* When confronted with discordant views, you are able to find the best way forward and influence others to follow that path (build consensus).

* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
