a984b114.title: Tech Infrastructure Program Manager, AWS Data Center Planning & Delivery
a984b114.description:
**Description**
 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 Amazon Web Service (AWS) is a comprehensive, evolving, and growing business unit within Amazon.com. Since early 2006, AWS has provided a highly reliable, scalable, low\-cost cloud infrastructure platform that empowers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries to innovate and invent.
   

  

 Do you have the business background, complex cross functional program management experience, financial expertise, legal/regulatory comprehension and technical understanding? Can you communicate effectively, find clarity in ambiguity, and simplicity in complexity ?
   

  

 If yes, then come and explore this exciting role. This role in Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (ADSIPL) Telangana builds infrastructure that hosts AWS cloud services. It delivers AWS cloud infrastructure in a challenging, high growth, fast paced and customer focused work environment. In this role, you will lead cross functional teams to deliver usable data center capacity. You will partner with senior stakeholders to develop, document, manage and deliver infrastructure designs, implementation schedules and budgets. You will earn trust of your partners in your ability to solve complex issues and steer teams in right direction to deliver results, on\-time and at\-cost.
   

  

 You must be an exceptionally strong communicator (both written and verbal), and possess relevant experience in managing technical and strategic programs. If you bring past experience in data center deployment programs, great. If not, then having a background in program and project management, architecture/design, mechanical/electrical engineering, software/hardware engineering with strong urge to learn will be essential.
   

  

 Come Join us, have fun, and create history!!
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Infrastructure TPM owns delivery of new DC across one or more availability zones in India. They manage 5\+ projects at any time. They bridge internal customers, business functions, (Planning, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Policy, Operations), and functional delivery teams (Construction, Commissioning, Controls, Fiber and Network) to enable on\-time and right sized delivery of new DC capacity.
   

  

 The scope begins with early expansion planning, which includes a feasibility analysis to approve expansion plans and associated build timelines. They evaluate multiple factors prior to approving a new plan of record, including owned/leased/collocated DC supply, utility delivery (power, water, and fiber), and long lead equipment (LLE) availability. It requires region\-wide knowledge and monitoring of in\-flight projects, major risks, and remediation efforts to ensure DC delivery is not only on track to meet supply commitments but also to meet customer demand, which is constantly changing.
   

  

 A successful TPM must be capable of managing a combination of metrics, tools, and mechanisms to remain aware of ongoing risks or issues that require their action, decision, mitigations, or effort to identify alternative solutions communicating up, down, and across the organization to align direction, gain support and drive remediation efforts
   

  

**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences:
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

**Work/Life Balance**
 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
   

  

**Inclusive Team Culture**
 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

**Mentorship And Career Growth**
 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of technical infrastructure management experience
* Knowledge of best practices and emerging technologies, related to infrastructure (i.e. network, data center, hardware, software)
* Experience leading the design, automation, deployment, and support of large\-scale infrastructure
* Knowledge of software development practices and data center/infrastructure/networking technologies


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with varying scenarios of infrastructure builds
* Experience in construction of data center delivery (design, commissioning and construction), mission critical facilities, or equivalent industrial/manufacturing facility builds
* Experience organizing, prioritizing and scheduling work assignments

93903482.title: Solution Architect, Startups
93903482.description:
**Description**
 AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer\-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.
   

  

 Do you like startups? Are you interested in Cloud Computing \& Generative AI? Yes? We have a role you might find interesting.
   

  

 Startups are the large enterprises of the future. These young companies are founded by ambitious people who have a desire to build something meaningful and to challenge the status quo. To address underserved customers, or to challenge incumbents. They usually operate in an environment of scarcity: whether that’s capital, engineering resource, or experience. This is where you come in.
   

  

 The Startup Solutions Architecture team is dedicated to working with these early stage startup companies as they build their businesses. We’re here to make sure that they can deploy the best, most scalable, and most secure architectures possible – and that they spend as little time and money as possible doing so.

The role will provide technical leadership across Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL and Sybase, while driving adoption of modern database, integration and data movement technologies. This is an application\-side architecture role. It is responsible for database design, application performance, middleware connectivity, resilience patterns, standards and modernization.
  
  

**Responsibilities include:**  

Define and govern database and database\-middleware architecture across MES, Test Solutions, Scheduling and Simulation, AI/ML and other manufacturing applications.
  
Establish standards for data modelling, schema design, SQL development, indexing, partitioning, transaction management and data retention.
  
Deep expertise in at least two of Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL and Sybase.
  
Provide technical leadership across Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL and Sybase.
  
Lead application and database performance optimisation, including query tuning, execution\-plan analysis, locking, deadlocks and connection management.
  
Define resilient application patterns for connection pooling, retries, failover, replication, change data capture and data synchronisation.
  
Review database designs for new applications, major releases, integrations and multi\-site deployments.
  
Drive database modernisation, platform migrations, legacy\-system rationalisation and adoption of appropriate modern database technologies.
  
Establish monitoring and observability across applications, middleware and databases.
  
Act as L3 technical authority for major incidents, root\-cause analysis, problem management and permanent corrective actions.
  
Develop reusable architecture patterns, deployment checklists, runbooks and troubleshooting guides for Site Teams.
  
Mentor database engineers and analysts and build cross\-platform capability within the team.
  
Partner with Site Teams for integration and deployment, and with IT Infrastructure Operations for database engine and infrastructure services.
  
This role does not own server hardware, operating systems, storage, database installation, infrastructure patching, backups or infrastructure\-level disaster recovery.
  
  

Qualifications
  
  

**Minimum Requirements:**  

10–15 years of experience in database engineering, application architecture or database performance engineering, including experience in a technical lead or architect role.
  
Strong expertise in at least two of Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL and Sybase, with working knowledge across the remaining platforms.
  
Advanced knowledge of SQL tuning, execution plans, indexing, stored procedures, transactions, locking and concurrency management.
  
Experience with JDBC/ODBC, connection pools, database proxies, replication, CDC and application integration technologies.
  
Strong understanding of database availability, scalability, security, performance and application\-side failover patterns.
  
Experience with database migrations, legacy modernization, automation and controlled database deployments.
  
Experience supporting high\-volume, business\-critical and 24x7 production applications.
  
Strong incident\-management, root\-cause analysis and structured problem\-solving capabilities.
  
Ability to work effectively across Platform Teams, Site Teams, Infrastructure Operations, cybersecurity and external vendors.
  
Experience in semiconductor manufacturing, MES, equipment integration, scheduling or manufacturing applications is preferred.
  
Working knowledge of ITIL incident, problem, change, availability and capacity\-management practices.
  
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline.

Strong verbal and written communication skills
  
Demonstrated strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
  
Ability to quickly troubleshoot and resolve complex problem situations and design/develop/test solutions and enhancements to keep databases available
  
Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different functions

Ability to take the initiative and drive for results

083fd694.title: Solutions Architect, ISV
083fd694.description:
**Description**
 AWS Global Sales (AGS) drives adoption of the AWS Cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud.
   

  

 Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer\-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud.
   

  

 AWS is where innovation, risks, and ideas are celebrated. We are builders; we try new things, imagine big dreams and reuse whenever we can. It is still Day 1 for us, and we are looking for curious people to be part of our diverse teams of thinkers, problem solvers, and doers. Come join us and work with AWS technologies that enable our Independent Software Vendor (ISV) customers and partners to adopt cloud\-based solutions.
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 This role is within the ISV team in Amazon Web Services India (AWS India) and can be based out of Bangalore, Delhi, Mumbai, Pune and Hyderabad locations.
   

  

 As a Solutions Architect, you’ll help your customers plan their successful cloud journey leveraging emerging technologies like GenAI to achieve business outcomes. You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures. You’ll drive or take part in technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.
   

  

 Building relationships to understand our customers and partners is key. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders from technical teams to executives. You’ll help ensure their short\-term technology decisions are aligned with their long\-term goals. Speeding up the adoption of our services will be part of your day to day.
   

  

 You’ll also act as thought leader in the wider community. This includes taking part in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops. You won’t just be part of an industry movement; you’ll be leading it.
   

  

 As a customer obsessed advisor, you’ll also have the chance to shape the direction of our products and services. This is through gathering feedback from customers whilst collaborating with our engineering and service teams.
   

  

 To be successful in this role you need to be passionate about ISV and cloud architectures. You are a builder with genuine curiosity about how technology can support your customers’ business models and objectives.
   

  

 Want to find out what it’s like to be a Solution Architect at AWS? Watch this video (https://bit.ly/3keYcC9\).
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 The Solutions Architect team at AWS is responsible for helping customers successfully implement cloud technologies. In a typical week you will meet multiple customers, and you will collaborate with them on designing and operating well\-architected solutions. You will earn their trust and show them the art of the possible, educating them around the capabilities of AWS. Partnering with internal teams and experts, leveraging a deep knowledge of our tools and products, you’ll craft highly scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures that address our customers’ business problems. As part of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to continuously learn and innovate daily.
   

  

**About The Team**
 ISV Solutions Architects work hand in hand with AWS customers to help drive AWS services adoption. They are at the crossroads of business and technology and engage with customers of different stages. Supporting the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS, they work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. Solutions Architects also have broader impact at scale, taking a supporting role in creating and presenting technical content and best practices.
   

  

 You will be part of a team that is responsible for driving adoption of AWS technologies while bringing differentiated value to customers. This is a team dedicated to ISV customers, an important and growing subset of customers for AWS India. ISV customers follow unique technology adoption patterns and growth trajectories that distinguish them from traditional businesses, so you will be employing engagement strategies and programs tailored to their business needs and technical preferences.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience in design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures
* Experience in a similar role such as technical account manager, consultant, solutions architect, platform engineer, systems engineer, cloud architect, or service delivery manager
* Experience in specific technology domain areas like software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data and analytics
* 4\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
* Experience communicating clearly and concisely with leadership, stakeholders, and cross\-functional teams
* Can create proof of concepts, demos, and/or scripts from scratch or leveraging reusable components.
* Able to create technical content that is easily adopted and reusable by others.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Knowledge of AWS services
* Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud
* Experience architecting/operating solutions built on AWS, or experience implementing a cloud\-based technology solution
* Experience implementing cloud services including migrations and modernization projects or similar
* AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification, or Cloud Technology Certification
* Able to present to technical and business audiences (training, workshops, publications)
* 4 years’ experience as a Solution Architect or related role.

da660bb8.title: Delivery Lead- GTM Services
da660bb8.description:
**About OneMetric** 




 We're a revenue enablement partner for B2B teams. We help GTM and RevOps leaders bring clarity and scale to their revenue engine, without the tool sprawl and scattered execution most teams end up with.
 



 In five years, we've tripled our team and gone global — helping mid\-market teams generate $3M in pipeline in under six months, rebuilding the revenue stack for a 1500\+ person enterprise, and running AI\-led efficiency plays for teams scaling lean. We're a HubSpot Elite Solutions Provider, in the top 1% of HubSpot partners worldwide.
 



  





**Who we're hiring for** 




 If you've done delivery at a B2B marketing or GTM agency, you know exactly what this job feels like. Five accounts running at once, none of them on the same timeline. A designer double\-booked across two of them. A client who moved the launch date and forgot to mention it. A retainer burning faster than the actual work is getting done.
 



 That's the job. We need someone who's lived through this before and doesn't panic when it happens again.
 



 Part project manager, part scrum master, part people manager. You're not updating a tracker — you know, off the top of your head, where every GTM project stands, why it's stuck if it's stuck, and what needs to happen next. You'll also run a small team of project coordinators, so growing people matters here as much as hitting deadlines.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* **Own delivery across GTM projects** 
 — plan, sequence, and track work across multiple concurrent client engagements, knowing exactly where every project stands
* **Run the rituals that actually help** 
 — standups, sprint planning, retros, backlog grooming, minus the ceremony for ceremony's sake
* **Manage capacity and resourcing** 
 — know who's overloaded and who has room before it becomes a fire drill
* **Own risk, dependency, and scope management** 
 — spot blockers early, manage change requests instead of letting scope quietly creep
* **Report status people can use** 
 — give GTM leadership a clear, honest read on project health before it turns into a surprise
* **Manage and grow your team** 
 — lead project coordinators, run 1:1s that matter, build people who get sharper over time
* **Own the client relationship on delivery** 
 — be the steady, credible point of contact on status and timelines
* **Keep improving how delivery works here** 
 — bring in what's worked elsewhere, run retrospectives that lead to real change



  





**What a typical week looks like** 




 A mix of: reviewing project health across your portfolio, running 2–3 standups or sprint ceremonies, one deep resourcing conversation about who's stretched thin, a status update to the head of GTM services or a client that requires you to actually know what's going on, a 1:1 with someone on your team, and at least one moment where you have to say "this isn't on track" before someone else notices.
 



  





**What we're looking for** 



* **Experience:** 
 7–8 years managing B2B marketing or GTM projects, at an agency specializing in B2B marketing/GTM, and people management experience (10\-12 minimum) is a must.
* **Delivery \& project management** 
 — sequencing, risk/dependency management, change control, budget and retainer tracking
* **Agile fundamentals** 
 — running ceremonies, managing a healthy backlog, reporting progress stakeholders actually understand
* **Resourcing** 
 —capacity planning across accounts and workstreams, including hiring decisions when the team needs to grow, without burning out the people you already have
* **People management** 
 — hiring, coaching, feedback that lands, accountability without micromanaging
* **Client\-facing communication** 
 — the calm, clear voice when a project isn't going to plan
* **Tooling** 
 — comfortable in Asana, monday.com, ClickUp, Jira, or similar



  





**How you think** 




 Calm under deadline pressure — the kind that comes from having seen this before. Structured, but not rigid; you adapt processes to the team, not the other way around. Comfortable delivering uncomfortable status updates early, rather than optimistic ones late.
 



  





**How success is measured** 



* Projects land on time and within scope, with surprises caught early instead of discovered late
* Your team's capacity is genuinely visible — no one finds out someone's overloaded after a missed deadline
* Clients trust your updates enough that they don't feel the need to double\-check with someone else
* Your team is measurably better at delivery six months in than the day you started managing them



  





**Why join us** 



* Real ownership — you're running delivery for GTM, not updating someone else's tracker
* People leadership from day one — this role comes with a team, not just a backlog
* A top\-tier ecosystem — HubSpot Elite status means serious tooling, serious clients, top 1% globally
* Growth that compounds — we've tripled in five years, and early joiners are now running functions
* Outcomes over hours — we care what ships, not how long you were logged in

776df061.description:

WNS, part of Capgemini, is an Agentic AI\-powered leader in intelligent operations and transformation, serving more than 700 clients across 10 industries, including Banking and Financial Services, Healthcare, Insurance, Shipping and Logistics, and Travel and Hospitality. We bring together deep domain excellence – WNS’ core differentiator – with AI\-powered platforms and analytics to help businesses innovate, scale, adapt and build resilience in a world defined by disruption.Our purpose is clear: to enable lasting business value by designing intelligent, human\-led solutions that deliver sustainable outcomes and a differentiated impact. With three global headquarters across four continents, operations in 13 countries, 65 delivery centers and more than 66,000 employees, WNS combines scale, expertise and execution to create meaningful, measurable impact.

 **Job Description** **Role Summary**


The Technical Manager is responsible for leading a cloud\-based data science program and managing a cross\-functional team of data engineers, data scientists, cloud architects, and technical professionals. The role oversees the end\-to\-end delivery of scalable, secure, and high\-performance cloud solutions while ensuring alignment with business objectives. The successful candidate will drive technical strategy, manage project execution, collaborate with stakeholders, and ensure the delivery of high\-quality data science and machine learning solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**


Lead, mentor, and manage a multidisciplinary technical team, fostering collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning.


Oversee the design, development, and optimization of cloud\-based data platforms, machine learning solutions, and data pipelines, ensuring scalability, performance, security, and reliability.


Manage the complete project lifecycle, including planning, execution, resource allocation, risk management, timelines, budgets, and successful delivery.


Collaborate with product managers, business analysts, and technical stakeholders to prioritize work, align technical solutions with business goals, and ensure seamless deployment of cloud\-based analytics and machine learning solutions.


Establish and promote best practices for cloud architecture, software development, data engineering, model deployment, code quality, testing, monitoring, and operational excellence.


Continuously evaluate system performance, recommend improvements, and stay current with emerging technologies in cloud computing, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and data engineering.

Experience with cloud services such as AWS S3, Redshift, BigQuery, Databricks, Google Cloud AI/ML services, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, Terraform, and Jenkins.


Excellent leadership, project management, communication, stakeholder management, and problem\-solving skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences.

Experience managing multi\-cloud or hybrid cloud environments. Knowledge of Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, and other big data technologies.


Cloud certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect or Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert are preferred.


Experience with data governance, data privacy compliance, business intelligence tools including Tableau and Power BI, data visualization best practices, and Agile methodologies is an advantage.

ab43a5ab.title: Principal Technical Program Manager, Prime Video Commerce Tech
ab43a5ab.description:
**Description**
 Prime Video is how hundreds of millions of customers around the world discover, buy, and watch the content they love. Behind every offer a customer sees \- every subscription, channel, rental, purchase, bundle, and deal \- is a set of world\-class systems built and owned by our Commerce team in Bengaluru.
   

  

 We are the Prime Video Offers team: the front of the funnel for Prime Video's global commerce. We own critical services that determine what every customer in all countries can purchase, rent, or subscribe to \- what price they see, what promotions apply, and how offers are composed across product lines. Our systems process billions of requests per day and sit on the critical path for every Prime Video transaction globally.
   

  

 We are at an inflection point. We're expanding Prime Video Commerce into dozens of new markets while simultaneously transforming the underlying architecture \- evolving to deliver flexibility across our products and offers more than ever. These aren't sequential bets; they're happening in parallel, across multiple engineering teams and partner organizations, each with their own roadmaps and constraints. The TPM who owns this will navigate that complexity and make it land.
   

  

 We are looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to own the end\-to\-end delivery of these programs. You will operate at the intersection of engineering, product, and business — making trade\-off decisions, unblocking cross\-org dependencies, driving operational cadence that gives executive leadership confidence without requiring their intervention, and delivering complex multi\-org programs.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Strategic Leadership: Own the delivery strategy for programs with senior leadership visibility \- international expansion across new markets, architecture transformation milestones, and cross\-product capability launches. Define the sequencing, the critical path, and the trade\-offs.
   

  

 Cross\-Org Program Execution: Coordinate delivery across multiple engineering teams and partner organizations. Own the workback plans, dependency maps, risk registers, and escalation paths that keep multi\-quarter programs on track across organizational boundaries.
   

  

 Architecture Transformation Delivery: Drive the program execution of a multi\-year architecture plan — platform buildout, API migration across dozens of consumers, interface harmonization across services, and shared capability rollouts. Sequence these against feature delivery so they compound rather than compete.
   

  

 Operational Cadence \& Mechanisms: Build and run the review cadences and launch readiness mechanisms that drive accountability across stakeholder teams. Give leadership clear, honest visibility — with a path to green, not just a status report.
   

  

 Capacity \& Resource Strategy: Map engineering bandwidth against the launch calendar, surface gaps well before they become blockers, and drive trade\-off decisions when demand exceeds capacity.
   

  

 Efficiency \& Automation: Drive programs that reduce manual launch effort dramatically — automation targets, test coverage milestones, and effort reduction metrics that turn multi\-quarter launches into repeatable, scalable processes.
   

  

 Stakeholder Influence: Partner with senior leaders across multiple organizations to align priorities, negotiate timelines, and resolve structural blockers. Represent program health in leadership forums with clarity and conviction.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 Your morning starts with a launch readiness review for a new territory — multiple teams on the call, you're making the go/no\-go call. Before lunch, you're reviewing a migration burndown with engineering and deciding whether to re\-sequence. In the afternoon, you're in a roadmap discussion with Product and senior leadership, making trade\-off decisions on what to prioritize. You end the day preparing a status update for the leadership staff meeting — clear, honest, with a path forward. You operate across time zones, hold teams accountable without being adversarial, and know when to push versus when to pull in leadership.
   

  

**About The Team**
 We are the Prime Video Commerce Offers team in Bengaluru \- engineers and program managers across all levels who build and own the commerce experiences that customers across the globe interact with every day. We operate as a worldwide team with genuine empathy across time zones. Inclusivity is how we work \- we believe the best ideas come from diverse perspectives, and we actively create space for every voice to be heard.

* 10\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 5\+ years of software development experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

8706026d.title: Technical Program Manager
8706026d.description:
**Location:** 

 Vijayawada (On\-site)
 




**Type:** 

 Full\-Time
 




**Experience:** 

 5\+ Years (Launch Vehicle/ Spacecraft / Re\-entry Vehicle / Aerospace Systems)
 




**Start Date:** 

 Immediate
 




  




**ABOUT US** 


 At AnduraX, we’re building India’s first private Re\-entry vehicle designed to fly to space, carry experiments and payloads, and return them safely to Earth. We believe the future of space isn’t just about going farther; it’s also about coming back safer. By building a platform that can fly frequently, recover gently, and serve a wide range of commercial and defence needs, we’re opening doors to a space\-powered industrial future. As part of our growing team, you will gain direct experience working on multidisciplinary flight systems that integrate aerodynamics, avionics, guidance, propulsion, structures, recovery systems, and mission operations.
 



**ROLE OVERVIEW** 


 As a
 
**Program Manager** 

 , you will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and driving the execution of AnduraX's reusable re\-entry vehicle development program. You will ensure that multidisciplinary engineering teams remain aligned with technical, financial, and schedule objectives while enabling rapid and effective decision\-making across the organization. Working closely with the Founders, Systems Engineering, GNC, Avionics, Structures, Propulsion, Flight Software, Manufacturing, Testing, and Business teams, you will own program planning, milestone tracking, risk management, resource coordination, and stakeholder communication. You will ensure that technical progress translates into successful demonstrations and program deliverables.
 





 This role demands exceptional organizational skills, technical understanding, leadership, and the ability to manage complex engineering programs in a fast\-paced startup environment.
 





 This role combines office\-based program management with laboratory, workshop, integration, supplier, and field\-test activities. Candidates should be comfortable coordinating engineering activities across design offices, manufacturing facilities, and flight\-test locations.
 




  





  





**RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  





**Program Planning \& Execution** 



* Develop and maintain the overall program execution plan for the reusable re\-entry vehicle.
* Break down long\-term company objectives into measurable engineering milestones.
* Develop detailed schedules covering design, procurement, manufacturing, testing, integration, and flight demonstrations.
* Track project progress and ensure timely execution of technical deliverables.
* Coordinate cross\-functional activities to ensure milestones are achieved within schedule and budget.
* Support strategic planning for future demonstration and orbital missions.



  





**Project Coordination \& Resource Management** 




  






 Coordinate engineering activities across:
 



* Systems Engineering
* Guidance, Navigation \& Control
* Avionics
* Flight Software
* Structures
* Aerodynamics
* Propulsion
* Recovery Systems
* Manufacturing
* Integration \& Testing
* Business Development



  




* Manage engineering priorities and resolve inter\-team dependencies.
* Coordinate procurement schedules and supplier timelines.
* Ensure resources are allocated efficiently across multiple concurrent projects.
* Support hiring plans, onboarding schedules, and team growth.



  





**Risk \& Configuration Management** 



* Maintain the overall program risk register.
* Identify schedule, technical, procurement, and operational risks.
* Coordinate mitigation plans with the technical team.
* Monitor configuration baselines and engineering change requests.
* Ensure documentation remains current throughout the development lifecycle.
* Track action items arising from design reviews and technical meetings.



  





**Program Reviews \& Reporting** 




  






 Plan and coordinate major technical reviews including:
 



* System Requirements Review (SRR)
* Preliminary Design Review (PDR)
* Critical Design Review (CDR)
* Test Readiness Review (TRR)
* Flight Readiness Review (FRR)
